*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      --> E_ROW_ID                                 
*&      --> E_COLUMN_ID                                &n
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM HOTSPOT_CLICK  USING    PS_ROW TYPE LVC_S_ROW
                             PV_COLUMN
                             PV_SENDER.

  CASE PV_SENDER.
    WHEN GO_GRID.
      READ TABLE GT_DATA INTO DATA(LS_DATA) INDEX PS_ROW-INDEX.
      IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
        CASE PV_COLUMN.
          WHEN 'VBELN_VF'.
            IF LS_DATA-VBELN_VF IS NOT INITIAL.
              SET PARAMETER ID 'VF' FIELD LS_DATA-VBELN_VF.
              CALL TRANSACTION 'VF03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.
            ENDIF.
        ENDCASE.
      ENDIF.

    WHEN GO_GRID2.
      READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO DATA(LS_DATA2) INDEX PS_ROW-INDEX.
      IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
        CASE PV_COLUMN.
          WHEN 'VBELN_VL'.
            IF LS_DATA2-VBELN_VL IS NOT INITIAL.
              SET PARAMETER ID 'VL' FIELD LS_DATA2-VBELN_VL.
              CALL TRANSACTION 'VL03N' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.
            ENDIF.

          WHEN 'VBELN'.
            IF LS_DATA2-VBELN IS NOT INITIAL.
              SET PARAMETER ID 'AUN' FIELD LS_DATA2-VBELN.
              CALL TRANSACTION 'VA03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.
            ENDIF.

          WHEN 'VGBEL'.
            IF LS_DATA2-VGBEL IS NOT INITIAL.
              SET PARAMETER ID 'AUN' FIELD LS_DATA2-VGBEL.
              CALL TRANSACTION 'VA03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.
            ENDIF.

          WHEN 'VBELN_VL2'.
            IF LS_DATA2-VBELN_VL2 IS NOT INITIAL.
              SET PARAMETER ID 'VL' FIELD LS_DATA2-VBELN_VL2.
              CALL TRANSACTION 'VL03N' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.
            ENDIF.

          WHEN 'VBELN_VF'.
            IF LS_DATA2-VBELN_VF IS NOT INITIAL.
              SET PARAMETER ID 'VF' FIELD LS_DATA2-VBELN_VF.
              CALL TRANSACTION 'VF03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.
            ENDIF.

          WHEN 'BELNR'.
            IF LS_DATA2-BELNR IS NOT INITIAL.
              SET PARAMETER ID 'BLN' FIELD LS_DATA2-BELNR.
              SET PARAMETER ID 'GJR' FIELD LS_DATA2-GJAHR.
              SET PARAMETER ID 'BUK' FIELD LS_DATA2-BUKRS.
              CALL TRANSACTION 'FB03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.
            ENDIF.

          WHEN 'PVINNO' OR 'FVINNO'.
            IF LS_DATA2-PVINNO NE 0 OR LS_DATA2-PVINNO IS NOT INITIAL.
              PERFORM CALL_VIN_POPUP USING LS_DATA2
                                           'V'.
            ENDIF.

          WHEN 'FVINNO'.
            IF LS_DATA2-FVINNO NE 0 OR LS_DATA2-FVINNO IS NOT INITIAL.
              PERFORM CALL_VIN_POPUP USING LS_DATA2
                                           'V'.
            ENDIF.

          WHEN 'PVINNO_SHIP'.
            "--* 팝업 출력 _DS4K910339 *--------------------------------
            IF LS_DATA2-PVINNO_SHIP IS NOT INITIAL.
              PERFORM CALL_VIN_POPUP USING LS_DATA2
                                           'V'.
            ENDIF.
            "--* 팝업 출력 _DS4K910339 *--------------------------------

          WHEN 'FVINNO_SHIP'.
            "--* 팝업 출력 _DS4K910339 *--------------------------------
            IF LS_DATA2-FVINNO_SHIP IS NOT INITIAL.
              PERFORM CALL_VIN_POPUP USING LS_DATA2
                                           'V'.
            ENDIF.
            "--* 팝업 출력 _DS4K910339 *--------------------------------

          WHEN 'FVINNO_EXCEL'.
            IF LS_DATA2-FVINNO_EXCEL NE 0 OR LS_DATA2-FVINNO_EXCEL IS NOT INITIAL.
              PERFORM CALL_VIN_POPUP USING LS_DATA2
                                           'E'.
            ENDIF.
        ENDCASE.
      ENDIF.

    WHEN GO_GRID3.
      READ TABLE GT_DATA3 INTO DATA(LS_DATA3) INDEX PS_ROW-INDEX.
      IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
        CASE PV_COLUMN.
          WHEN 'VBELN'.
            IF LS_DATA3-VBELN IS NOT INITIAL.
              SET PARAMETER ID 'VF' FIELD LS_DATA3-VBELN.
              CALL TRANSACTION 'VF03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.
            ENDIF.

          WHEN 'VGBEL'.
            IF LS_DATA3-VGBEL IS NOT INITIAL.
              SET PARAMETER ID 'VL' FIELD LS_DATA3-VGBEL.
              CALL TRANSACTION 'VL03N' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.
            ENDIF.

          WHEN 'AUBEL'.
            IF LS_DATA3-AUBEL IS NOT INITIAL.
              SET PARAMETER ID 'AUN' FIELD LS_DATA3-AUBEL.
              CALL TRANSACTION 'VA03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.
            ENDIF.

          WHEN 'BELNR'.
            IF LS_DATA3-BELNR IS NOT INITIAL.
              SET PARAMETER ID 'BLN' FIELD LS_DATA3-BELNR.
              SET PARAMETER ID 'GJR' FIELD LS_DATA3-GJAHR.
              SET PARAMETER ID 'BUK' FIELD LS_DATA3-BUKRS.
              CALL TRANSACTION 'FB03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.
            ENDIF.

          WHEN 'BELNR2'.
            IF LS_DATA3-BELNR2 IS NOT INITIAL.
              SET PARAMETER ID 'BLN' FIELD LS_DATA3-BELNR2.
              SET PARAMETER ID 'GJR' FIELD LS_DATA3-GJAHR2.
              SET PARAMETER ID 'BUK' FIELD LS_DATA3-BUKRS2.
              CALL TRANSACTION 'FB03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.
            ENDIF.
        ENDCASE.
      ENDIF.
  ENDCASE.


ENDFORM.

                GO_EVENT_RECEIVER->HANDLE_DATA_CHANGED           FOR PO_GRID,
                GO_EVENT_RECEIVER->HANDLE_DATA_CHANGED_FINISHED  FOR PO_GRID.

  CALL METHOD PO_GRID->REGISTER_EDIT_EVENT
    EXPORTING
      I_EVENT_ID = CL_GUI_ALV_GRID=>MC_EVT_MODIFIED.

ENDFORM.

  __CLEAR : GT_FCODE.

            CL_GUI_ALV_GRID=>MC_FC_LOC_COPY           TO  GT_FCODE,
            CL_GUI_ALV_GRID=>MC_FC_LOC_COPY_ROW       TO  GT_FCODE,
            CL_GUI_ALV_GRID=>MC_FC_LOC_DELETE_ROW     TO  GT_FCODE,
            CL_GUI_ALV_GRID=>MC_FC_LOC_APPEND_ROW     TO  GT_FCODE,
            CL_GUI_ALV_GRID=>MC_FC_LOC_INSERT_ROW     TO  GT_FCODE,
            CL_GUI_ALV_GRID=>MC_FC_LOC_MOVE_ROW       TO  GT_FCODE,
            CL_GUI_ALV_GRID=>MC_FC_HELP               TO  GT_FCODE,
            CL_GUI_ALV_GRID=>MC_FC_GRAPH              TO  GT_FCODE,
            CL_GUI_ALV_GRID=>MC_FC_INFO               TO  GT_FCODE,
            CL_GUI_ALV_GRID=>MC_FC_LOC_CUT            TO  GT_FCODE,
*            CL_GUI_ALV_GRID=>MC_FC_SUBTOT             TO  GT_FCODE,        &
*            CL_GUI_ALV_GRID=>MC_FC_MAXIMUM            TO  GT_FCODE,         
*            CL_GUI_ALV_GRID=>MC_FC_MINIMUM            TO  GT_FCODE,         
            CL_GUI_ALV_GRID=>MC_FC_AVERAGE            TO  GT_FCODE,
            CL_GUI_ALV_GRID=>MC_FC_REFRESH            TO  GT_FCODE.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form SEARCH_HELP                                     &nbs
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      --> P_VARI                                 &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM SEARCH_HELP  USING    PV_FIELD.

  DATA: LS_VARIANT TYPE DISVARIANT,
        LV_EXIT.

  LS_VARIANT-REPORT = SY-REPID.

  CASE ABAP_TRUE.
    WHEN R_01.
      LS_VARIANT-HANDLE = '01'.
    WHEN R_02.
      LS_VARIANT-HANDLE = '02'.
  "--* 프로그램 분리 _DS4K911267 *--------------------------------------
*    WHEN R_03.                                    
*      LS_VARIANT-HANDLE = '03'.                              &nb
*    WHEN R_04.                                    
*      LS_VARIANT-HANDLE = '04'.                              &nb
  "--* 프로그램 분리 _DS4K911267 *--------------------------------------
  ENDCASE.

  CALL FUNCTION 'REUSE_ALV_VARIANT_F4'
    EXPORTING
      IS_VARIANT    = LS_VARIANT
      I_SAVE        = GC_A
    IMPORTING
      E_EXIT        = LV_EXIT
      ES_VARIANT    = LS_VARIANT
    EXCEPTIONS
      NOT_FOUND     = 1
      PROGRAM_ERROR = 2
      OTHERS        = 3.
  IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
    MESSAGE ID SY-MSGID TYPE 'S' NUMBER SY-MSGNO
            WITH SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4.
  ELSE.
    IF LV_EXIT EQ SPACE.
      PV_FIELD = LS_VARIANT-VARIANT.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form DATA_CHANGED                                     &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      --> ER_DATA_CHANGED                               &nbs
*&      --> SENDER                                 &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM DATA_CHANGED  USING    PT_MODI TYPE REF TO CL_ALV_CHANGED_DATA_PROTOCOL
                            PV_SENDER.
  LOOP AT PT_MODI->MT_MOD_CELLS INTO DATA(LS_MODI).
    CASE PV_SENDER.
      WHEN GO_GRID.

      WHEN GO_GRID2.
        READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO DATA(LS_DATA2) INDEX LS_MODI-ROW_ID.
        IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
          CASE LS_MODI-FIELDNAME.
            WHEN 'CHK'.
              LS_DATA2-CHK = LS_MODI-VALUE.

              MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING CHK WHERE KUNSB = LS_DATA2-KUNSB
                                                               AND WAERK = LS_DATA2-WAERK.
          ENDCASE.
        ENDIF.

        PERFORM SET_REFRESH USING GO_GRID2
                                  GS_LAYO2.

      WHEN GO_GRID3.

      WHEN GO_GRID4.
        READ TABLE GT_0400 INTO DATA(LS_0400) INDEX LS_MODI-ROW_ID.
        IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
          CASE LS_MODI-FIELDNAME.
            WHEN 'FKDAT'.
              LS_0400-FKDAT = LS_MODI-VALUE(4) && LS_MODI-VALUE+5(2) && LS_MODI-VALUE+8(2).

              MODIFY GT_0400 FROM LS_0400 TRANSPORTING FKDAT WHERE FKDAT <> LS_0400-FKDAT.

            WHEN 'KUNRG'.
              LS_0400-KUNRG = LS_MODI-VALUE.

              MODIFY GT_0400 FROM LS_0400 TRANSPORTING KUNRG WHERE KUNRG <> LS_0400-KUNRG.
          ENDCASE.
        ENDIF.

        PERFORM SET_REFRESH USING GO_GRID4
                                  GS_LAYO4.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb

*& text                                        &nb

FORM CREATE_ALV_0400 .

  CREATE OBJECT GO_CUST
    EXPORTING
      CONTAINER_NAME = 'CONT1'.

  CREATE OBJECT GO_GRID4
    EXPORTING
      I_PARENT = GO_CUST.

ENDFORM.

*& Form DISPLAY_ALV_0400                                     
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb

*& <--  p2        text                             &

  PERFORM SET_LAYOUT.
  PERFORM SET_FIELDCAT2.
  PERFORM SET_TOOLBAR.
  PERFORM SET_SORT.
*  PERFORM SET_VARIANT.                                    &
  PERFORM SET_EVENT USING GO_GRID4.

  CALL METHOD GO_GRID4->SET_TABLE_FOR_FIRST_DISPLAY
    EXPORTING
      IS_LAYOUT            = GS_LAYO4                " Layout
      IT_TOOLBAR_EXCLUDING = GT_FCODE
*     IS_VARIANT           = GS_VARIANT2                     &nbs
*     I_SAVE               = GC_A                   &nb
    CHANGING
      IT_OUTTAB            = GT_0400                 " Output Table
      IT_FIELDCATALOG      = GT_FCAT4                " Field Catalog
      IT_SORT              = GT_SORT4.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form SET_FIELDCAT2                                     &n
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& -->  p1        text                             &
*& <--  p2        text                             &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM SET_FIELDCAT2 .

  DATA : LV_TEXT(50).

  CLEAR : GT_FCAT4, GV_POS.

  CASE ABAP_TRUE.
    WHEN R_07.
      LV_TEXT = TEXT-F40.

    WHEN R_08.
      LV_TEXT = TEXT-F41.
  ENDCASE.

  PERFORM FIELDCAT USING GT_FCAT4 :
              'AUART'             ''                'VBAK'             'AUART'           ''               '',
              'FKDAT'             ''                'VBRK'             'FKDAT'           ''               'X',
              'KUNAG'             ''                'VBRK'             'KUNAG'           ''               '',
              'KUNAG_NM'          ''                'KNA1'             'NAME1'           ''               '',
              'BSTKD_E'           TEXT-F09          'VBKD'             'BSTKD_E'         ''               '',
              'KUNRG'             TEXT-F07          'VBPA'             'KUNNR'           ''               'X',
              'MATNR'             ''                'LIPS'             'MATNR'           ''               '',
              'MAKTX'             ''                'MAKT'             'MAKTX'           ''               '',
              'LFIMG'             LV_TEXT           'LIPS'             'LFIMG'           ''               '',
***              'KULAB'             ''             &nb
***              'VRKME'             ''             &nb
              'NETWR'             ''                'VBAP'             'KZWI1'           ''               '',
              'MWSBP'             ''                'VBAP'             'MWSBP'           ''               '',
              'WAERK'             ''                'VBAP'             'WAERK'           ''               ''.


  LOOP AT GT_FCAT4 INTO DATA(LS_FCAT).
    CASE LS_FCAT-FIELDNAME.
      WHEN 'LFIMG' OR 'KULAB' OR 'NETWR' OR 'MWSBP'.
        LS_FCAT-DO_SUM = ABAP_TRUE.

        MODIFY GT_FCAT4 FROM LS_FCAT TRANSPORTING DO_SUM.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDLOOP.



ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form APPROVAL                                      &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& -->  p1        text                             &
*& <--  p2        text                             &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM APPROVAL .
  DATA : LS_HEAD   TYPE ZSDS0010,
         LS_ITEM   TYPE ZSDS0020,
         LT_ITEM   TYPE TABLE OF ZSDS0020,
         LS_COND   TYPE BAPICOND,
         LT_COND   TYPE TABLE OF BAPICOND,
         LS_CONDX  TYPE BAPICONDX,
         LT_CONDX  TYPE TABLE OF BAPICONDX,
         LT_RETURN TYPE TABLE OF BAPIRET2,
         LV_VBELN  TYPE VBAK-VBELN,
         LV_SEQ    TYPE I,
         LV_POSNR  TYPE VBAP-POSNR.

  DATA : LV_KUNSB TYPE VBPA-KUNNR,
         LV_WAERK TYPE VBAK-WAERK.

  DATA : LV_ERR,
         LV_MSG(100).

  TYPES : BEGIN OF TY_CHK,
            VBELN_VL TYPE LIPS-VBELN,
            POSNR_VL TYPE LIPS-POSNR,
          END OF TY_CHK.
  DATA : LS_CHK TYPE TY_CHK,
         LT_CHK TYPE TABLE OF TY_CHK.

  RANGES : LR_BSTKD FOR VBKD-BSTKD.

  " 청구일 비어있는지 확인
  DATA(LT_FKDAT) = GT_0400.
  DELETE LT_FKDAT WHERE FKDAT IS NOT INITIAL.

  IF LT_FKDAT IS NOT INITIAL.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E09.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  " 기간 체크
  DATA(LT_PERIOD) = GT_0400.
  SORT LT_PERIOD BY VBELN_VL.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_PERIOD COMPARING VBELN_VL.
  LOOP AT LT_PERIOD INTO DATA(LS_PERIOD).
    PERFORM PERIOD_CHECK USING LS_PERIOD-FKDAT
                               LS_PERIOD-VBELN_VL
                               LV_ERR
                               LV_MSG.

    IF LV_ERR EQ GC_E.
      DATA(LV_PERIOD_CHK) = ABAP_TRUE.
      EXIT.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

  IF LV_PERIOD_CHK EQ ABAP_TRUE.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH LV_MSG.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  " 납품수량 > 가용수량이면 에러
  CLEAR : GS_0400.
***  LOOP AT GT_0400 INTO GS_0400.                                
***    IF GS_0400-LFIMG > GS_0400-KULAB.                             &nb
***      DATA(LV_AMOUNT) = ABAP_TRUE.                             &nbs
***      EXIT.                                   &
***    ENDIF.                                     
***  ENDLOOP.                                      &nbs
***                                          
***  IF LV_AMOUNT EQ ABAP_TRUE.                                 &
***    MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E17.                               
***    EXIT.                                     &
***  ENDIF.                                       

  " MAIN
  DATA(LT_HEADER) = GT_DATA2.
  DELETE LT_HEADER WHERE CHK IS INITIAL.

  SORT LT_HEADER BY VBELN_VL POSNR_VL BSTKD_E.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_HEADER COMPARING VBELN_VL POSNR_VL BSTKD_E.

  DATA(LT_DATA2) = LT_HEADER.
  SORT LT_HEADER BY KUNAG KUNSB WAERK VBELN POSNR.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_HEADER COMPARING KUNAG KUNSB WAERK.

  SORT LT_DATA2 BY KUNAG KUNSB WAERK VBELN POSNR.

  " 파트너
  SELECT DISTINCT A~VGBEL, A~VGPOS,
         B~KUNNR AS KUNAG,
         C~KUNNR AS KUNWE,
         D~KUNNR AS KUNZA,
         E~KUNNR AS KUNZ2
    FROM @LT_DATA2 AS A
    LEFT JOIN VBPA AS B  ON B~VBELN = A~VGBEL
                        AND B~POSNR = A~VGPOS
                        AND B~PARVW = 'AG'
    LEFT JOIN VBPA AS C  ON C~VBELN = A~VGBEL
                        AND C~POSNR = A~VGPOS
                        AND C~PARVW = 'WE'
    LEFT JOIN VBPA AS D  ON D~VBELN = A~VGBEL
                        AND D~POSNR = A~VGPOS
                        AND D~PARVW = 'ZA'
    LEFT JOIN VBPA AS E  ON E~VBELN = A~VGBEL
                        AND E~POSNR = A~VGPOS
                        AND E~PARVW = 'Z2'
   ORDER BY A~VGBEL, A~VGPOS
    INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_PARTNER).

  " 헤더
  SELECT DISTINCT A~VGBEL,
         B~KUNNR AS KUNZA,
         C~KUNNR AS KUNZ1,
         D~KUNNR AS KUNZ2,
         E~KUNNR AS KUNWE
    FROM @LT_DATA2 AS A
    LEFT JOIN VBPA AS B  ON B~VBELN = A~VGBEL
                        AND B~POSNR = '000000'
                        AND B~PARVW = 'ZA'
    LEFT JOIN VBPA AS C  ON C~VBELN = A~VGBEL
                        AND C~POSNR = '000000'
                        AND C~PARVW = 'Z1'
    LEFT JOIN VBPA AS D  ON D~VBELN = A~VGBEL
                        AND D~POSNR = '000000'
                        AND D~PARVW = 'Z2'
    LEFT JOIN VBPA AS E  ON E~VBELN = A~VGBEL
                        AND E~POSNR = '000000'
                        AND E~PARVW = 'WE'
    INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_VBPA).

  " 판매오더 생성 여부 확인
  SELECT SINGLE A~VBELN
    FROM VBAP AS A
    JOIN @LT_HEADER AS B  ON B~VGBEL = A~VGBEL
                         AND B~VGPOS = A~VGPOS
    INTO @DATA(LV_CHK).

  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E06.
    LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  " 정가 / 세액
  SELECT DISTINCT A~VBELN, A~POSNR,
         D~KSCHL, D~KBETR, D~WAERS,
         D~STUNR, D~WAERK
    FROM LIPS AS A
    JOIN VBAP AS B  ON B~VBELN = A~VGBEL
                   AND B~POSNR = A~POSNR
    JOIN VBAK AS C  ON C~VBELN = B~VBELN
    JOIN PRCD_ELEMENTS AS D  ON D~KNUMV = C~KNUMV
                            AND D~KPOSN = B~POSNR
                            AND D~KSCHL IN ( 'ZPR2', 'ZIR2', 'ZFR2', 'ZFR1', 'ZIR1' )
    JOIN @LT_DATA2 AS E  ON E~VBELN_VL = A~VBELN
                        AND E~POSNR_VL = A~POSNR
    INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_PRICE).

  " 몇번째인지 확인용
  CLEAR : GS_0400.
  READ TABLE GT_0400 INTO GS_0400 INDEX 1.
  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
    DATA(LV_TXT) = GS_0400-FKDAT(4) && '.' && GS_0400-FKDAT+4(2) && | | && TEXT-M01 && '*'.
    DATA(LV_TXT2) = GS_0400-FKDAT(4) && '.' && GS_0400-FKDAT+4(2) && | | && TEXT-M01.
    __RANGE : LR_BSTKD LV_TXT '' 'CP'.

    SELECT DISTINCT BSTKD, VBELN, POSNR
      FROM VBKD
     WHERE BSTKD IN @LR_BSTKD
      INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_BSTKD).

    SORT LT_BSTKD BY BSTKD DESCENDING.
    READ TABLE LT_BSTKD INTO DATA(LS_BSTKD) INDEX 1.
    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
      DATA(LV_BSTKD) = LS_BSTKD-BSTKD.
      REPLACE LV_TXT2 WITH '' INTO LV_BSTKD.
      CONDENSE LV_BSTKD.
      LV_SEQ = LV_BSTKD.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT LT_HEADER INTO DATA(LS_HEADER).

    LV_SEQ += 1.

    LS_HEAD-AUART   = GS_0400-AUART.
    LS_HEAD-VKORG   = LS_HEADER-VKORG.
    LS_HEAD-VTWEG   = LS_HEADER-VTWEG.
    LS_HEAD-SPART   = LS_HEADER-SPART.
    LS_HEAD-VKGRP   = LS_HEADER-VKGRP.
    LS_HEAD-VKBUR   = LS_HEADER-VKBUR.
    LS_HEAD-BSTKD   = GS_0400-FKDAT(4) && '.' && GS_0400-FKDAT+4(2) && | | && TEXT-M01 && LV_SEQ .
    LS_HEAD-WAERK   = LS_HEADER-WAERK.
    LS_HEAD-KUNAG   = LS_HEADER-KUNAG.
    LS_HEAD-KUNRG   = GS_0400-KUNRG.
    LS_HEAD-KUNRE   = GS_0400-KUNRG.
    LS_HEAD-KUNSB   = LS_HEADER-KUNSB.
    LS_HEAD-VGBEL   = LS_HEADER-VGBEL.
    LS_HEAD-AUDAT   = GS_0400-FKDAT.
    LS_HEAD-VDATU   = GS_0400-FKDAT.
    LS_HEAD-PRSDT   = GS_0400-FKDAT.

    READ TABLE LT_VBPA INTO DATA(LS_VBPA) WITH KEY VGBEL = LS_HEADER-VGBEL.
    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
      LS_HEAD-KUNZA = LS_VBPA-KUNZA.
      LS_HEAD-KUNZ1 = LS_VBPA-KUNZ1.
      LS_HEAD-KUNZ2 = LS_VBPA-KUNZ2.
      LS_HEAD-KUNWE = LS_VBPA-KUNWE.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT SINGLE VBTYP
      FROM VBAK
     WHERE VBELN = @LS_HEADER-VGBEL
      INTO @LS_HEAD-VBTYP_V.

    LOOP AT LT_DATA2 INTO DATA(LS_DATA) WHERE KUNAG = LS_HEADER-KUNAG
                                          AND KUNSB = LS_HEADER-KUNSB
                                          AND WAERK = LS_HEADER-WAERK.
      LV_POSNR += 10.

      READ TABLE GT_0400 INTO GS_0400 WITH KEY VBELN_VL = LS_DATA-VBELN_VL
                                               POSNR_VL = LS_DATA-POSNR_VL.

      LS_ITEM-POSNR       = LV_POSNR.
      LS_ITEM-MATNR       = LS_DATA-MATNR.
      LS_ITEM-KWMENG      = GS_0400-LFIMG.
      LS_ITEM-VRKME       = LS_DATA-VRKME.
      LS_ITEM-BSTKD_E     = LS_DATA-BSTKD_E.
      LS_ITEM-POSEX_E     = LS_DATA-POSEX_E.
      LS_ITEM-IHREZ_E     = LS_DATA-IHREZ_E.
      LS_ITEM-VGPOS       = LS_DATA-VGPOS.
      LS_ITEM-PRSDT_ITM   = LS_DATA-PRSDT.
      LS_ITEM-BSTDK_E     = LS_DATA-WADAT_IST.
      LS_ITEM-MVGR1       = LS_DATA-MVGR1.
      LS_ITEM-EDATU       = GS_0400-FKDAT.
      LS_ITEM-VGBEL       = LS_DATA-VGBEL.
      LS_ITEM-VGPOS       = LS_DATA-VGPOS.

      READ TABLE LT_PARTNER INTO DATA(LS_PARTNER) WITH KEY VGBEL = LS_DATA-VGBEL
                                                           VGPOS = LS_DATA-VGPOS.
      IF LS_PARTNER-KUNAG IS NOT INITIAL.
        LS_ITEM-KUNAG_ITM = LS_PARTNER-KUNAG.
      ELSE.
        LS_ITEM-KUNAG_ITM = LS_DATA-KUNAG.
      ENDIF.
      LS_ITEM-KUNRG_ITM   = LS_DATA-KUNRG.
      LS_ITEM-KUNWE_ITM   = LS_PARTNER-KUNWE.
      LS_ITEM-KUNSB_ITM   = LS_DATA-KUNSB.
      LS_ITEM-KUNZ1_ITM   = LS_DATA-KUNZ1.
      LS_ITEM-KUNZA_ITM   = LS_PARTNER-KUNZA.
      LS_ITEM-KUNZ2_ITM   = LS_PARTNER-KUNZ2.

      SELECT SINGLE VBTYP
        FROM VBAK
       WHERE VBELN = @LS_HEADER-VGBEL
        INTO @LS_ITEM-VBTYP_V.

      " 체크용
      LS_CHK-VBELN_VL = LS_DATA-VBELN_VL.
      LS_CHK-POSNR_VL = LS_DATA-POSNR_VL.

      " 금액
      LOOP AT LT_PRICE INTO DATA(LS_PRICE2) WHERE VBELN = LS_DATA-VBELN_VL
                                              AND POSNR = LS_DATA-POSNR_VL.
        IF LS_PRICE2-KBETR IS NOT INITIAL.
          LS_COND-ITM_NUMBER  = LV_POSNR.
          LS_COND-COND_ST_NO  = LS_PRICE2-STUNR.
          LS_COND-COND_COUNT  = '01'.
          LS_COND-COND_TYPE   = LS_PRICE2-KSCHL.
          LS_COND-COND_VALUE  = LS_PRICE2-KBETR.
          LS_COND-CURRENCY    = LS_PRICE2-WAERS.

          LS_CONDX-ITM_NUMBER = LV_POSNR.
          LS_CONDX-COND_ST_NO = LS_PRICE2-STUNR.
          LS_CONDX-COND_COUNT = '01'.
          LS_CONDX-COND_TYPE  = LS_PRICE2-KSCHL.
          LS_CONDX-UPDATEFLAG = GC_U.
          LS_CONDX-COND_VALUE = ABAP_TRUE.
          LS_CONDX-CURRENCY   = ABAP_TRUE.

          IF LS_PRICE2-KSCHL EQ 'MWST'
            OR LS_PRICE2-KSCHL EQ 'ZGRS'.
          ELSE.
            APPEND LS_COND TO LT_COND.
            APPEND LS_CONDX TO LT_CONDX.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

        CLEAR : LS_COND, LS_CONDX.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND : LS_ITEM TO LT_ITEM,
               LS_CHK TO LT_CHK.
      CLEAR : LS_ITEM, LS_DATA, LS_CHK.
    ENDLOOP.


    CALL FUNCTION 'ZSD_SALESORDER_CREATE2 '
      EXPORTING
        IS_HEADER     = LS_HEAD                 " [SD] Sales Order header
      IMPORTING
        EV_VBELN      = LV_VBELN                " Sales Document
      TABLES
        IT_ITEM       = LT_ITEM                 " [SD] Sales Order Item
        IT_CONDITION  = LT_COND
        IT_CONDITIONX = LT_CONDX
        ET_RETURN     = LT_RETURN.       " Return

    IF LV_VBELN IS INITIAL.
      " 에러 여부 확인
      DATA(LV_MESSAGE) = ZCL_SD_UTIL=>MESSAGE_TEXT_BUILD( IT_RETURN = LT_RETURN TYPE = GC_E ).

      IF LV_MESSAGE IS INITIAL.
        LV_MESSAGE = ZCL_SD_UTIL=>MESSAGE_TEXT_BUILD( IT_RETURN = LT_RETURN TYPE = GC_A ).
      ENDIF.

      IF LV_MESSAGE IS INITIAL.
        LV_MESSAGE = ZCL_SD_UTIL=>MESSAGE_TEXT_BUILD( IT_RETURN = LT_RETURN TYPE = GC_X ).
      ENDIF.

      IF LV_MESSAGE IS INITIAL.
        LV_MESSAGE = ZCL_SD_UTIL=>MESSAGE_TEXT_BUILD( IT_RETURN = LT_RETURN TYPE = GC_I ).
      ENDIF.

      LS_DATA-ICON = ICON_RED_LIGHT.
      LS_DATA-MSG = LV_MESSAGE.

      MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA TRANSPORTING ICON MSG
                                          WHERE KUNAG = LS_HEADER-KUNAG
                                            AND KUNRG = LS_HEADER-KUNRG
                                            AND KUNSB = LS_HEADER-KUNSB
                                            AND WAERK = LS_HEADER-WAERK.

    ELSE.
      LS_DATA-ICON  = ICON_GREEN_LIGHT.
      LS_DATA-VBELN = LV_VBELN.
      LV_MESSAGE = ZCL_SD_UTIL=>MESSAGE_TEXT_BUILD( IT_RETURN = LT_RETURN TYPE = GC_S ).

      "--* ZSDT0180 변경일 갱신 로직 추가 _DS4K909741 *-----------------
      PERFORM UPD_OUTTAB_N_LOG USING LS_HEADER
                                     GT_DATA2
                                     GT_DATA2_B4_COMPRESS
                                     LV_VBELN.
      "--* ZSDT0180 변경일 갱신 로직 추가 _DS4K909741 *-----------------

      LOOP AT LT_CHK INTO LS_CHK.
        READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO LS_DATA WITH KEY VBELN_VL = LS_CHK-VBELN_VL
                                                  POSNR_VL = LS_CHK-POSNR_VL.
        IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
          LS_DATA-ICON       = ICON_GREEN_LIGHT.
          LS_DATA-MSG        = LV_MESSAGE.
          LS_DATA-VBELN      = LV_VBELN.

          SELECT SINGLE A~ERDAT,
                 A~ERZET, A~AUART,
                 B~POSNR
            FROM VBAK AS A
            JOIN VBAP AS B  ON B~VBELN = A~VBELN
           WHERE A~VBELN = @LV_VBELN
             AND B~VGBEL = @LS_DATA-VGBEL
             AND B~VGPOS = @LS_DATA-VGPOS
            INTO ( @LS_DATA-ERDAT_SO, @LS_DATA-ERZET_SO,
                   @LS_DATA-AUART, @LS_DATA-POSNR  ).

          MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA TRANSPORTING ICON MSG VBELN ERDAT_SO ERZET_SO AUART POSNR
                                              WHERE VBELN_VL = LS_DATA-VBELN_VL
                                                AND POSNR_VL = LS_DATA-POSNR_VL.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.

    CLEAR : LS_HEADER, LS_HEAD, LT_ITEM, LT_COND, LT_CONDX, LT_RETURN, LV_POSNR, LT_CHK.
  ENDLOOP.

***  DATA : LS_ITEM   TYPE ZSDS0110,                              
***         LT_ITEM   TYPE TABLE OF ZSDS0110,                      &nb
***         LS_COND   TYPE BAPICOND,                         &nbs
***         LT_COND   TYPE TABLE OF BAPICOND,                      &nb
***         LS_CONDX  TYPE BAPICONDX,                          &n
***         LT_CONDX  TYPE TABLE OF BAPICONDX,                       &
***         LS_RETURN TYPE ZSDS0120,                           &n
***         LV_SEQ    TYPE I,                          
***         LV_POSNR  TYPE VBAP-POSNR.                          &
***                                          
***  DATA : LV_KUNSB TYPE VBPA-KUNNR,                               &n
***         LV_WAERK TYPE VBAK-WAERK.                           &
***                                          
***  DATA : LV_ERR,                                    
***         LV_MSG(100).                               
***                                          
***                                          
***  TYPES : BEGIN OF TY_CHK,                                &nbs
***            VBELN_VL TYPE LIPS-VBELN,                        &
***            POSNR_VL TYPE LIPS-POSNR,                        &
***          END OF TY_CHK.                            
***  DATA : LS_CHK TYPE TY_CHK,                                &n
***         LT_CHK TYPE TABLE OF TY_CHK.                         
***                                          
***  RANGES : LR_BSTKD FOR VBKD-BSTKD.                               &
***                                          
***  " 청구일 비어있는지 확인                                   &
***  DATA(LT_FKDAT) = GT_0400.                                  &
***  DELETE LT_FKDAT WHERE FKDAT IS NOT INITIAL.                            
***                                          
***  IF LT_FKDAT IS NOT INITIAL.                                &
***    MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E09.                               
***    EXIT.                                     &
***  ENDIF.                                       
***                                          
***  " 기간 체크                                     &
***  DATA(LT_PERIOD) = GT_0400.                                  
***  SORT LT_PERIOD BY VBELN_VL.                                 
***  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_PERIOD COMPARING VBELN_VL.                         
***  LOOP AT LT_PERIOD INTO DATA(LS_PERIOD).                              &
***    PERFORM PERIOD_CHECK USING LS_PERIOD-FKDAT                            &nb
***                               LS_PERIOD-VBELN_VL        
***                               LV_ERR          
***                               LV_MSG.          
***                                          
***    IF LV_ERR EQ GC_E.                                &nb
***      DATA(LV_PERIOD_CHK) = ABAP_TRUE.                             
***      EXIT.                                   &
***    ENDIF.                                     
***  ENDLOOP.                                      &nbs
***                                          
***  IF LV_PERIOD_CHK EQ ABAP_TRUE.                                &nb
***    MESSAGE I000 WITH LV_MSG.                               &n
***    EXIT.                                     &
***  ENDIF.                                       
***                                          
***  " 납품수량 > 가용수량이면 에러                                 &
***  CLEAR : GS_0400.                                   &nbs
***  LOOP AT GT_0400 INTO GS_0400.                                
***    IF GS_0400-LFIMG > GS_0400-KULAB.                             &nb
***      DATA(LV_AMOUNT) = ABAP_TRUE.                             &nbs
***      EXIT.                                   &
***    ENDIF.                                     
***  ENDLOOP.                                      &nbs
***                                          
***  IF LV_AMOUNT EQ ABAP_TRUE.                                 &
***    MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E17.                               
***    EXIT.                                     &
***  ENDIF.                                       
***                                          
***  SELECT DISTINCT A~VBELN, A~POSNR,                                
***         D~KSCHL, D~KBETR, D~WAERS,                           
***         D~STUNR, D~WAERK                             &nb
***    FROM LIPS AS A                                 &
***    JOIN VBAP AS B  ON B~VBELN = A~VGBEL                         &n
***                   AND B~POSNR = A~POSNR                 
***    JOIN VBAK AS C  ON C~VBELN = B~VBELN                         &n
***    JOIN PRCD_ELEMENTS AS D  ON D~KNUMV = C~KNUMV                        
***                            AND D~KPOSN = B~POSNR        
***                            AND D~KSCHL <> 'ZPR1'       
***                            AND D~KSCHL <> 'ZIS1'       
***    JOIN @GT_0400 AS E  ON E~VBELN_VL = A~VBELN                        &
***                       AND E~POSNR_VL = A~POSNR            &nb
***    INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_PRICE).                                
***                                          
******  " 몇번째인지 확인용                                    
******  CLEAR : GS_0400.                                   &
******  READ TABLE GT_0400 INTO GS_0400 INDEX 1.                            
******  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                                  &
******    DATA(LV_TXT) = GS_0400-FKDAT+(4) && '.' && GS_0400-FKDAT+4(2) && | | && TEXT-M01 && '*'.            
******    DATA(LV_TXT2) = GS_0400-FKDAT+(4) && '.' && GS_0400-FKDAT+4(2) && | | && TEXT-M01.              &nbs
******    __RANGE : LR_BSTKD LV_TXT '' 'CP'.                           &nbs
******                                         &nb
******    SELECT DISTINCT BSTKD, VBELN, POSNR                            &n
******      FROM VBKD                                 &
******     WHERE BSTKD IN @LR_BSTKD                              
******      INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_BSTKD).                             &n
******                                         &nb
******    SORT LT_BSTKD BY BSTKD DESCENDING.                            &nb
******    READ TABLE LT_BSTKD INTO DATA(LS_BSTKD) INDEX 1.                        &nb
******    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                                &
******      DATA(LV_BSTKD) = LS_BSTKD-BSTKD.                            &nb
******      REPLACE LV_TXT2 WITH '' INTO LV_BSTKD.                         
******      CONDENSE LV_BSTKD.                               &nbs
******      LV_SEQ = LV_BSTKD.                               
******    ENDIF.                                    &nb
******  ENDIF.                                      &nb
***                                          
***  LOOP AT GT_0400 INTO DATA(LS_0400) GROUP BY ( KUNSB = LS_0400-KUNSB                    &nb
***                                          
***                                     ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(&l
***    LOOP AT GROUP <FS_GROUP> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<FS_0400>).                      
***                                          
***      LV_KUNSB = <FS_0400>-KUNSB.                             
***      LV_WAERK = <FS_0400>-WAERK.                             
***                                          
***      " 금액 관련                                 &
***      READ TABLE LT_PRICE INTO DATA(LS_PRICE) WITH KEY VBELN = <FS_0400>-VBELN_VL               
***                                          
***                                          
***      " 메인 데이터                                 
***      READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO DATA(LS_DATA2) WITH KEY VBELN_VL = <FS_0400>-VBELN_VL              &nb
***                                          
***      IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                              &nbs
***        " 메세지용                                &
***        LS_CHK-VBELN_VL = LS_DATA2-VBELN_VL.                          &n
***        LS_CHK-POSNR_VL = LS_DATA2-POSNR_VL.                          &n
***        APPEND LS_CHK TO LT_CHK.                           &nb
***                                          
***        LV_SEQ += 1.                              &n
***        LV_POSNR += 10.                              
***                                          
***        IF LS_DATA2-VBELN IS NOT INITIAL.                         &
***          LS_ITEM-VBELN = LS_DATA2-VBELN.                         &
***          LS_ITEM-POSNR = LS_DATA2-POSNR.                         &
***        ENDIF.                                 
***                                          
***        LS_ITEM-AUART     = <FS_0400>-AUART.                      
***        LS_ITEM-VKORG     = LS_DATA2-VKORG.                       &
***        LS_ITEM-VTWEG     = LS_DATA2-VTWEG.                       &
***        LS_ITEM-VKBUR     = LS_DATA2-VKBUR.                       &
***        LS_ITEM-VKGRP     = LS_DATA2-VKGRP.                       &
***        LS_ITEM-SPART     = LS_DATA2-SPART.                       &
***        LS_ITEM-BSTKD     = <FS_0400>-FKDAT+(4) && '.' && <FS_0400>-FKDAT+4(2) && | | && TEXT-M01 . "&& LV_SEQ
***        LS_ITEM-KUNAG     = <FS_0400>-KUNRG.                      
***        LS_ITEM-KUNSB     = LS_DATA2-KUNSB.                       &
***        LS_ITEM-VGBEL     = LS_DATA2-VGBEL.                       &
***                                          
***        SELECT SINGLE VBTYP                             &
***          FROM VBAK                             &nbs
***         WHERE VBELN = @LS_DATA2-VGBEL                         &nbs
***          INTO @LS_ITEM-VBTYP_V.                           &nb
***                                          
***        LS_ITEM-POSNR     = LV_POSNR.                        &
***        LS_ITEM-MATNR     = LS_DATA2-MATNR.                       &
***        LS_ITEM-KWMENG    = LS_DATA2-LFIMG.                        
***        LS_ITEM-VRKME     = LS_DATA2-VRKME.                       &
***        LS_ITEM-BSTKD_E   = LS_DATA2-BSTKD_E.                        &nb
***        LS_ITEM-POSEX_E   = LS_DATA2-POSEX_E.                        &nb
***        LS_ITEM-IHREZ_E   = LS_DATA2-IHREZ_E.                        &nb
***        LS_ITEM-VGPOS     = LS_DATA2-VGPOS.                       &
***        LS_ITEM-WADAT_IST = <FS_0400>-FKDAT.                         &n
***        LS_ITEM-PRSDT_ITM = LS_DATA2-PRSDT.                          &nb
***        LS_ITEM-BSTDK_E   = LS_DATA2-WADAT_IST.                        &
***        LS_ITEM-MVGR1     = LS_DATA2-MVGR1.                       &
***        LS_ITEM-WAERK     = LS_PRICE-WAERS.                       &
***        LS_ITEM-EDATU     = <FS_0400>-FKDAT.                      
***                                          
***        APPEND LS_ITEM TO LT_ITEM.                           &
***                                          
***        " 금액                                &nb
***        LOOP AT LT_PRICE INTO DATA(LS_PRICE2) WHERE VBELN = LS_DATA2-VBELN_VL                
***                                          
***          IF LS_PRICE2-KBETR IS NOT INITIAL.                       
***            LS_COND-ITM_NUMBER  = LV_POSNR.                      &n
***            LS_COND-COND_ST_NO  = LS_PRICE2-STUNR.                     &
***            LS_COND-COND_COUNT  = '01'.                       
***            LS_COND-COND_TYPE   = LS_PRICE2-KSCHL.                    &n
***            LS_COND-COND_VALUE  = LS_PRICE2-KBETR.                     &
***            IF LS_PRICE2-WAERS IS NOT INITIAL.                     
***              LS_COND-CURRENCY    = LS_PRICE2-WAERS.                 &nb
***                                          
***            ELSE.                             &
***              LS_COND-CURRENCY    = LS_PRICE2-WAERK.                 &nb
***            ENDIF.                             
***                                          
***            LS_CONDX-ITM_NUMBER = LV_POSNR.                       &
***            LS_CONDX-COND_ST_NO = LS_PRICE2-STUNR.                      
***            LS_CONDX-COND_COUNT = '01'.                        
***            LS_CONDX-COND_TYPE  = LS_PRICE2-KSCHL.                     &
***            LS_CONDX-UPDATEFLAG = GC_U.                        
***            LS_CONDX-COND_VALUE = ABAP_TRUE.                       
***            LS_CONDX-CURRENCY   = ABAP_TRUE.                     &n
***                                          
***            IF LS_PRICE2-KSCHL EQ 'MWST'.                      &nbs
***            ELSE.                             &
***              APPEND LS_COND TO LT_COND.                     &
***              APPEND LS_CONDX TO LT_CONDX.                     
***            ENDIF.                             
***          ENDIF.                               
***                                          
***          CLEAR : LS_PRICE2, LS_COND, LS_CONDX.                      &nb
***        ENDLOOP.                                &nbs
***      ENDIF.                                   
***                                          
***      CLEAR : LS_DATA2, LS_PRICE, LS_CHK.                           
***    ENDLOOP.                                    &nbs
***                                          
***    CALL FUNCTION 'ZSD_SD_ALL_PROCESS'                              &nbs
***      EXPORTING                                  &nb
***        IV_CHK        = ABAP_TRUE                      &n
***      IMPORTING                                  &nb
***        ES_RETURN     = LS_RETURN                 " [SD] 일괄처리 return  &n
***      TABLES                                   
***        IT_DATA       = LT_ITEM                 " [SD] 일괄처리 input &
***        IT_CONDITION  = LT_COND                 " 오더의 조건 유지보수를 위한 통신필드   
***        IT_CONDITIONX = LT_CONDX.                 " 오더의 조건 유지보수를 위한 통신필드   &n
***                                          
***    IF LS_RETURN-VBELN_VF_CHK EQ GC_S.                              
***      LOOP AT LT_CHK INTO LS_CHK.                            &
***        READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO LS_DATA2 WITH KEY VBELN_VL = LS_CHK-VBELN_VL               
***                                          
***        IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                            &nbs
***          LS_DATA2-ICON       = ICON_GREEN_LIGHT.                   
***          LS_DATA2-MSG        = LS_RETURN-MESSAGE.                  
***          LS_DATA2-VBELN      = LS_RETURN-VBELN.                    
***          LS_DATA2-VBELN_VL2  = LS_RETURN-VBELN_VL.                      &nbs
***          LS_DATA2-VBELN_VF   = LS_RETURN-VBELN_VF.                      
***                                          
***          SELECT SINGLE A~ERDAT,                          &nbs
***                 A~ERZET, A~AUART,                     &n
***                 B~POSNR,                       &nbs
***                 D~FKDAT,                       &nbs
***                 F~WBSTK                        
***            FROM VBAK AS A                         &
***            JOIN VBAP AS B  ON B~VBELN = A~VBELN                 &n
***            LEFT JOIN ( VBRP AS C JOIN VBRK AS D  ON D~VBELN = C~VBELN        &nbs
***                                          
***                                          
***                                          
***                                          
***            LEFT JOIN ( LIPS AS E JOIN LIKP AS F  ON F~VBELN = E~VBELN )       &nb
***                                          
***                                          
***           WHERE A~VBELN = @LS_RETURN-VBELN                       &
***             AND B~VGBEL = @LS_DATA2-VGBEL                     &nbs
***             AND B~VGPOS = @LS_DATA2-VGPOS                     &nbs
***            INTO ( @LS_DATA2-ERDAT_SO, @LS_DATA2-ERZET_SO,                    
***                   @LS_DATA2-AUART, @LS_DATA2-POSNR, @LS_DATA2-FKDAT,             
***                   @LS_DATA2-WBSTK2  ).                  
***                                          
***          MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING ICON MSG VBELN VBELN_VL2 VBELN_VF            
***                                          
***                                          
***                                          
***        ENDIF.                                 
***      ENDLOOP.                                  &nbs
***                                          
***    ELSE.                                     &
***      LOOP AT LT_CHK INTO LS_CHK.                            &
***        READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO LS_DATA2 WITH KEY VBELN_VL = LS_CHK-VBELN_VL               
***                                          
***        IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                            &nbs
***          LS_DATA2-ICON       = ICON_RED_LIGHT.                   &
***          LS_DATA2-MSG        = LS_RETURN-MESSAGE.                  
***                                          
***          MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING ICON MSG                  &nb
***                                          
***                                          
***        ENDIF.                                 
***      ENDLOOP.                                  &nbs
***    ENDIF.                                     
***                                          
***                                          
***    CLEAR : LS_DATA2, LV_KUNSB, LV_WAERK, LT_CHK, LT_ITEM, LS_RETURN, LT_COND, LT_CONDX.                &nb
***  ENDLOOP.                                      &nbs
***                                          
***  PERFORM SET_REFRESH USING GO_GRID2                                
***                            GS_LAYO2.            &nb

  LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form KMC_UPLOAD                                      
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& -->  p1        text                             &
*& <--  p2        text                             &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM KMC_UPLOAD .

  DATA : LV_COUNT TYPE I,
         LS_VIN   TYPE TY_VIN,
         LS_DATA2 TYPE TY_DATA2,
         LV_SUBRC TYPE SY-SUBRC,
         LS_KMC   TYPE TY_KMC,
         LS_TEMP  TYPE TY_KMC,
         LT_TEMP  TYPE TABLE OF TY_KMC.

  DATA : LS_WARNING TYPE TY_WARNING.

  CLEAR : GV_FILE, LS_VIN, LS_DATA2, GT_UPLOAD, GV_ANS, GT_WARNING.

***  " VIN EXCEL 초기화                                   
***  IF C_03 EQ ABAP_TRUE.                                  
***    MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING BSTKD_E_EXCEL VIN_NO_EXCEL WHERE BSTKD_E IS NOT INITIAL.            &n
***  ELSE.                                       &
***    MODIFY GT_VIN FROM LS_VIN TRANSPORTING FVINNO WHERE FVINNO IS NOT INITIAL.                 &n
***    MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING BSTKD_E_EXCEL FVINNO_EXCEL WHERE BSTKD_E IS NOT INITIAL.            &n
***  ENDIF.                                       

  LV_SUBRC = 0.

***  PERFORM GET_IMAGE.                                    &

  PERFORM FILE_OPEN_DIALOG_RTN USING GV_FILE
                                     LV_SUBRC.

  "--* 에러일 때 EXIT. _DS4K909741 *------------------------------------
  "- 'LV_SUBRC = 0'일 때 이어지는 모든 로직을 묶고 있길래 'LV_SUBRC <> 0'으로 바꿔서 메시지 출력하고 EXIT하게 함. _DS4K909741
  IF LV_SUBRC <> 0.
    MESSAGE |{ TEXT-E30 } (Prog { SY-REPID })(ErrCode 2403071125)| "- Error occurs while get file.
            TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.
  "--* 에러일 때 EXIT. _DS4K909741 *------------------------------------


  PERFORM UPLOAD_EXCEL USING GV_FILE '6' LV_SUBRC.

  "--* 에러일 때 EXIT. _DS4K909741 *------------------------------------
  "- 'LV_SUBRC = 0'일 때 이어지는 모든 로직을 묶고 있는데, ELSE에서도 'LV_SUBRC = 0'일 때만 에러메시지를 출력하고 EXIT 하도록 되어 있어서
  " 'LV_SUBRC <> 0'일 때 에러메시지 출력하고 EXIT 하도록 수정. _DS4K909741
  IF LV_SUBRC <> 0.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E14.
    EXIT. "FORM EXIT.
  ENDIF.
  "--* 에러일 때 EXIT. _DS4K909741 *------------------------------------

  SELECT DISTINCT FIELD11 AS CODE
    FROM ZCMT0030
   WHERE ZMODULE = 'SD'
     AND CLASS   = 'SD020'
    INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_CODE).

  " 파일값에서 필요한 부분만 옮겨오기
  LOOP AT GT_UPLOAD INTO DATA(LS_UPLOAD).
    " 유효 STATUS 가져오는 부분 테이블에서 가져오는 로직으로 수정
    READ TABLE LT_CODE INTO DATA(LS_CODE) WITH KEY CODE = LS_UPLOAD-STATUS.
    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.

      CONDENSE : LS_UPLOAD-FVINNO NO-GAPS,
                 LS_UPLOAD-PPLAN NO-GAPS.

      MOVE-CORRESPONDING LS_UPLOAD TO LS_KMC.

      LS_KMC-BSTKD_E = LS_UPLOAD-PPLAN(13).

      APPEND LS_KMC TO GT_KMC.

    ELSE.
      CONDENSE : LS_UPLOAD-FVINNO NO-GAPS,
               LS_UPLOAD-PPLAN NO-GAPS.

      MOVE-CORRESPONDING LS_UPLOAD TO LS_TEMP.

      LS_KMC-BSTKD_E = LS_UPLOAD-PPLAN(13).

      APPEND LS_TEMP TO LT_TEMP.
    ENDIF.
    CLEAR : LS_KMC, LS_UPLOAD, LS_TEMP.
  ENDLOOP.

  DATA(LT_UPLOAD_CHK) = LT_TEMP.
  IF LT_UPLOAD_CHK IS NOT INITIAL.
    LOOP AT LT_CODE INTO LS_CODE.
      DELETE LT_UPLOAD_CHK WHERE STATUS CS LS_CODE-CODE.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT LT_UPLOAD_CHK BY FVINNO.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_UPLOAD_CHK COMPARING FVINNO.
  ENDIF.
  DATA(LV_NVIN)  = LINES( LT_UPLOAD_CHK ).

  DATA(LT_UPLOAD_CHK2) = LT_TEMP.
  SORT LT_UPLOAD_CHK2 BY BSTKD_E.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_UPLOAD_CHK2 COMPARING BSTKD_E.
  DATA(LV_NSHIP) = LINES( LT_UPLOAD_CHK2 ).

  DATA(LT_CHK) = GT_DATA2.
  DELETE LT_CHK WHERE ICON <> '@08@'.

  SELECT DISTINCT B~*
    FROM @LT_CHK AS A
    JOIN ZSDT0180 AS B  ON B~WORDER_NO = A~BSTKD_E
   WHERE B~VBELN IS INITIAL
     AND B~POSNR IS INITIAL
    INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_CHK2).

  " 완료건 포함되었나 확인
  LOOP AT LT_CHK INTO DATA(LS_CHK).
    READ TABLE GT_KMC INTO LS_KMC WITH KEY BSTKD_E = LS_CHK-BSTKD_E.
    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.

      " 아직 만들지 않은 오더건 있나 확인
      READ TABLE LT_CHK2 INTO DATA(LS_CHK2) WITH KEY WORDER_NO   = LS_CHK-BSTKD_E
                                                     FULL_VIN_NO = LS_KMC-FVINNO.
      IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.
        DATA(LV_CHK) = ABAP_TRUE.

        LS_CHK-MSG = TEXT-E06.

        MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_CHK TRANSPORTING MSG
                                    WHERE BSTKD_E = LS_CHK-BSTKD_E.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    CLEAR : LS_CHK, LS_KMC.
  ENDLOOP.

  IF LV_CHK EQ ABAP_TRUE.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E06.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

***      " 데이터 없으면                                 
***      IF GT_KMC IS INITIAL.                              
***        MESSAGE TEXT-E22 TYPE GC_I.                           
***        EXIT.                                 &
***      ENDIF.                                   

  " 중복 데이터 찾기
  DATA(LT_DUPLICATE) = GT_KMC.
  SORT LT_DUPLICATE BY FVINNO.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_DUPLICATE COMPARING FVINNO.

  LOOP AT LT_DUPLICATE INTO DATA(LS_DUPLICATE).
    DATA(LT_CHECK) = GT_KMC.
    DELETE LT_CHECK WHERE FVINNO <> LS_DUPLICATE-FVINNO.

    IF LINES( LT_CHECK ) > 1.     " 파일 내 중복데이터
      SELECT SINGLE A~VIN_NO, A~FULL_VIN_NO,
             B~BSTKD_E,
             B~KUNAG,
             B~KUNAG_NM
        FROM ZSDT0180 AS A
        LEFT JOIN @GT_DATA2 AS B  ON B~BSTKD_E = A~WORDER_NO
       WHERE A~FULL_VIN_NO = @LS_DUPLICATE-FVINNO
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @LS_WARNING.

      IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
        DO LINES( LT_CHECK ) TIMES.
          APPEND LS_WARNING TO GT_WARNING.
        ENDDO.
      ENDIF.

    ELSE.                          " 중복 파일 or 다른 파일 내 중복 데이터
      CASE C_03. " Display with Full VIN List
        WHEN ABAP_TRUE.
          READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO DATA(LS_DATA) WITH KEY BSTKD_E_EXCEL = LS_DUPLICATE-BSTKD_E
                                                          VIN_NO_EXCEL  = LS_DUPLICATE-FVINNO.
          IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
            SELECT SINGLE A~VIN_NO, A~FULL_VIN_NO,
                   B~BSTKD_E,
                   B~KUNAG,
                   B~KUNAG_NM
              FROM ZSDT0180 AS A
              LEFT JOIN @GT_DATA2 AS B  ON B~BSTKD_E = A~WORDER_NO
             WHERE A~FULL_VIN_NO = @LS_DUPLICATE-FVINNO
              INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @LS_WARNING.

            IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
              DO 2 TIMES.
                APPEND LS_WARNING TO GT_WARNING.
              ENDDO.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.

        WHEN OTHERS.
          READ TABLE GT_VIN INTO LS_VIN WITH KEY WORDER_NO = LS_DUPLICATE-BSTKD_E
                                                 FVINNO    = LS_DUPLICATE-FVINNO.
          IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
            SELECT SINGLE A~VIN_NO, A~FULL_VIN_NO,
                   B~BSTKD_E,
                   B~KUNAG,
                   B~KUNAG_NM
              FROM ZSDT0180 AS A
              LEFT JOIN @GT_DATA2 AS B  ON B~BSTKD_E = A~WORDER_NO
             WHERE A~FULL_VIN_NO = @LS_DUPLICATE-FVINNO
              INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @LS_WARNING.

            IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
              DO 2 TIMES.
                APPEND LS_WARNING TO GT_WARNING.
              ENDDO.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDIF.

    CLEAR : LS_DUPLICATE, LS_WARNING, LS_DATA, LS_VIN.
  ENDLOOP.

  IF GT_WARNING IS NOT INITIAL.
    SORT GT_WARNING BY BSTKD_E VIN_NO FULL_VIN_NO.

    CALL SCREEN 600 STARTING AT 10 10 ENDING AT 130 45.

  ELSE.
    GV_ANS = ABAP_TRUE.
  ENDIF.

  IF GV_ANS EQ ABAP_TRUE.
    LOOP AT GT_KMC INTO LS_KMC.
      " 일치하는 VIN NO 찾기
      IF C_03 EQ ABAP_TRUE.
        READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO LS_DATA2 WITH KEY FULL_VIN_NO = LS_KMC-FVINNO
                                                   BSTKD_E     = LS_KMC-BSTKD_E.
        IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
          LS_DATA2-VIN_NO_EXCEL  = LS_KMC-FVINNO.
          LS_DATA2-BSTKD_E_EXCEL = LS_KMC-BSTKD_E.
          LS_DATA2-ZZPRD_DATE    = LS_KMC-ZZPRD_DATE.
          LS_DATA2-ZZSHIP_DATE   = LS_KMC-ZZSHIP_DATE.
          LS_DATA2-ZZETA         = LS_KMC-ZZETA.
          MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING VIN_NO_EXCEL BSTKD_E_EXCEL ZZPRD_DATE ZZSHIP_DATE ZZETA
                                               WHERE FULL_VIN_NO = LS_DATA2-FULL_VIN_NO
                                                 AND BSTKD_E     = LS_KMC-BSTKD_E.

        ELSE.
          LS_KMC-CHK = ABAP_TRUE.
        ENDIF.

      ELSE.
        READ TABLE GT_VIN INTO LS_VIN WITH KEY FULL_VIN_NO   = LS_KMC-FVINNO
                                               WORDER_NO     = LS_KMC-BSTKD_E.
        IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
          LS_VIN-FVINNO         = LS_KMC-FVINNO.
          LS_VIN-ZZPRD_DATE     = LS_KMC-ZZPRD_DATE.
          LS_VIN-ZZSHIP_DATE    = LS_KMC-ZZSHIP_DATE.
          LS_VIN-ZZETA          = LS_KMC-ZZETA.

          MODIFY GT_VIN FROM LS_VIN TRANSPORTING FVINNO ZZPRD_DATE ZZSHIP_DATE ZZETA
                                    WHERE FULL_VIN_NO = LS_KMC-FVINNO.

        ELSE.
          LS_KMC-CHK = ABAP_TRUE.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

      MODIFY GT_KMC FROM LS_KMC TRANSPORTING CHK.

      CLEAR : LS_UPLOAD, LS_DATA2, LS_VIN, LS_KMC.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 유효하지 않은 VIN 삭제
    DELETE GT_KMC WHERE CHK IS NOT INITIAL.

    IF GT_KMC IS NOT INITIAL.
      " VIN EXCEL 개수 넣기
      CLEAR : LS_VIN, LS_DATA2.
      IF C_03 NE ABAP_TRUE.
        LOOP AT GT_VIN INTO LS_VIN GROUP BY ( WORDER_NO = LS_VIN-WORDER_NO
                                              VBELN_VL  = LS_VIN-VBELN_VL
                                              POSNR_VL  = LS_VIN-POSNR_VL )
                                         ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<FS_GROUP>).

          CLEAR : LV_COUNT.

          LOOP AT GROUP <FS_GROUP> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<FS_DATA>).
            READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO LS_DATA2 WITH KEY VBELN_VL = <FS_DATA>-VBELN_VL
                                                       POSNR_VL = <FS_DATA>-POSNR_VL.
            IF <FS_DATA>-FVINNO IS NOT INITIAL.
              LV_COUNT += 1.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.

          LS_DATA2-FVINNO_EXCEL = LV_COUNT.

          IF LV_COUNT IS NOT INITIAL.
            LS_DATA2-BSTKD_E_EXCEL = <FS_DATA>-WORDER_NO.
          ENDIF.

          MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING FVINNO_EXCEL BSTKD_E_EXCEL
                                               WHERE VBELN_VL = LS_DATA2-VBELN_VL
                                                 AND POSNR_VL = LS_DATA2-POSNR_VL.
          CLEAR : LS_DATA2.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  " 총 W/Oder 개수
  DATA(LT_ORDER) = GT_DATA2.
  SORT LT_ORDER BY BSTKD_E.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_ORDER COMPARING BSTKD_E.
  DATA(LV_WORDER) = REDUCE I( INIT X = 0 FOR WA IN LT_ORDER
                     WHERE ( BSTKD_E IS NOT INITIAL ) NEXT X = X + 1 ).

  " 일치하는 W/Order(Excel) 개수
  DATA(LT_ORDER2) = GT_DATA2.
  DELETE LT_ORDER2 WHERE BSTKD_E_EXCEL IS INITIAL.
  SORT LT_ORDER2 BY BSTKD_E_EXCEL.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_ORDER2 COMPARING BSTKD_E_EXCEL.
  DATA(LV_EWORDER) = REDUCE I( INIT X = 0 FOR WA2 IN LT_ORDER2
                      WHERE ( BSTKD_E IS NOT INITIAL ) NEXT X = X + 1 ).

  " VIN No 개수
  IF C_03 EQ ABAP_TRUE.
    DATA(LT_VIN) = GT_DATA2.
    SORT LT_VIN BY FULL_VIN_NO.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_VIN COMPARING FULL_VIN_NO.
    DATA(LV_VIN) = REDUCE I( INIT X = 0 FOR WA3 IN LT_VIN
                    WHERE ( FULL_VIN_NO IS NOT INITIAL ) NEXT X = X + 1 ).

  ELSE.
    DATA(LT_VIN2) = GT_VIN.
    SORT LT_VIN2 BY VIN_NO.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_VIN COMPARING FULL_VIN_NO.
    LV_VIN = REDUCE I( INIT X = 0 FOR WA4 IN LT_VIN2
              WHERE ( VIN_NO IS NOT INITIAL ) NEXT X = X + 1 ).
  ENDIF.

  " VIN No(Excel) 개수
  IF C_03 EQ ABAP_TRUE.
    DATA(LT_VIN_EXCEL2) = GT_DATA2.
    DELETE LT_VIN_EXCEL2 WHERE VIN_NO_EXCEL IS INITIAL.
    SORT LT_VIN_EXCEL2 BY VIN_NO_EXCEL.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_VIN_EXCEL2 COMPARING VIN_NO_EXCEL.

    DATA(LV_EVIN) = REDUCE I( INIT X = 0 FOR WA5 IN LT_VIN_EXCEL2
                    WHERE ( VIN_NO_EXCEL IS NOT INITIAL ) NEXT X = X + 1 ).

  ELSE.
    DATA(LT_VIN_EXCEL) = GT_VIN.
    DELETE LT_VIN_EXCEL WHERE FVINNO IS INITIAL.
    SORT LT_VIN_EXCEL BY FVINNO.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_VIN_EXCEL COMPARING FVINNO.

    LV_EVIN = REDUCE I( INIT X = 0 FOR WA6 IN LT_VIN_EXCEL
              WHERE ( FVINNO IS NOT INITIAL ) NEXT X = X + 1 ).
  ENDIF.


  DATA(LV_TEXT)  = TEXT-M02 && | | && LV_WORDER && | |
                   && '/' && | | && TEXT-M03 && | | && LV_EWORDER
                   && | | && '/' && | | && TEXT-M12 && | | && LV_NSHIP.
  DATA(LV_TEXT2) = TEXT-M04 && | | && LV_VIN && | |
                   && '/' && | | && TEXT-M05 && | | && LV_EVIN
                   && | | && '/' && | | && TEXT-M13 && | | && LV_NVIN.

  CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_DISPLAY_TEXT'
    EXPORTING
*     TITEL     = SPACE                             &nb
      TEXTLINE1 = LV_TEXT
      TEXTLINE2 = LV_TEXT2
*     START_COLUMN = 25                                 
*     START_ROW = 6                                 &nb
    .
  .
  IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
*MESSAGE ID SY-MSGID TYPE SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO                             &
*WITH SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4.                                &
  ENDIF.

  CLEAR : LV_WORDER, LV_EWORDER, LV_VIN, LV_EVIN, LV_TEXT, LV_TEXT2,
          LT_ORDER, LT_ORDER2, LT_VIN, LT_VIN2, LT_VIN_EXCEL2.

  PERFORM SET_REFRESH USING GO_GRID2
                            GS_LAYO2.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form FILE_OPEN_DIALOG_RTN                                    &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      --> GV_FILE                                 
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM FILE_OPEN_DIALOG_RTN  USING    PV_VAL
                                    PV_SUBRC.

  DATA: LT_FILEPATH TYPE FILETABLE,
        LV_RETURN   TYPE I,
        LV_DIR      TYPE STRING.


  LV_DIR    = PV_VAL.
  GV_FILTER = GV_ALL.

  CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES=>FILE_OPEN_DIALOG(
      EXPORTING
      WINDOW_TITLE            = 'File Open'
      FILE_FILTER             = GV_FILTER
      INITIAL_DIRECTORY       = LV_DIR
    CHANGING
      FILE_TABLE              = LT_FILEPATH
      RC                      = LV_RETURN
    EXCEPTIONS
      FILE_OPEN_DIALOG_FAILED = 1
      CNTL_ERROR              = 2
      ERROR_NO_GUI            = 3
      NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_GUI    = 4 ).

  IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
    PV_SUBRC = SY-SUBRC.
    MESSAGE ID SY-MSGID TYPE GC_I NUMBER SY-MSGNO
               WITH SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4.
  ENDIF.

  IF LV_RETURN  = 1.
    READ TABLE LT_FILEPATH INTO PV_VAL INDEX 1.
  ENDIF.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form UPLOAD_EXCEL                                     &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      --> GV_FILE                                 
*&      --> P_                                  
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM UPLOAD_EXCEL  USING PV_FILE  PV_ROW PV_SUBRC.

  " 장착계약 업로드
  DATA : LV_TABIX  TYPE SY-TABIX.
  DATA : LV_STRING TYPE STRING.

  DATA : LS_UPLOAD  TYPE TY_UPLOAD.

  FIELD-SYMBOLS <FS>.

  CLEAR : GV_ERR, LV_TABIX.

  __PROGRESS : 10 'Data Uploading...'.
  __CLEAR    : GT_EXCEL.

  CALL FUNCTION 'ALSM_EXCEL_TO_INTERNAL_TABLE'
    EXPORTING
      FILENAME                = PV_FILE
      I_BEGIN_COL             = 1
      I_BEGIN_ROW             = PV_ROW
      I_END_COL               = 256
      I_END_ROW               = 65536
    TABLES
      INTERN                  = GT_EXCEL
    EXCEPTIONS
      INCONSISTENT_PARAMETERS = 1
      UPLOAD_OLE              = 2
      OTHERS                  = 3.

  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
    __CLEAR : GT_UPLOAD.

    LOOP AT GT_EXCEL.
      LV_TABIX = GT_EXCEL-COL.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT LV_TABIX OF STRUCTURE LS_UPLOAD TO <FS>.

*      TRANSLATE GT_EXCEL-VALUE TO UPPER CASE.                          &nb

      MOVE GT_EXCEL-VALUE TO <FS>.

      AT END OF ROW.
        APPEND LS_UPLOAD TO GT_UPLOAD. CLEAR : LS_UPLOAD.
      ENDAT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ELSE.
    PV_SUBRC = SY-SUBRC.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form CALL_VIN_POPUP                                     &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      --> LS_DATA2                                 
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM CALL_VIN_POPUP  USING    PS_DATA TYPE TY_DATA2
                              PV_CHK.

  TYPES : BEGIN OF TY_VIN_P,
            NO_PDI      TYPE ZSDT0180-NO_PDI,
            NO_LINE     TYPE ZSDT0180-NO_LINE,
            NO_LINE_D   TYPE ZSDT0180-NO_LINE_D,
            WORDER_NO   TYPE ZSDT0180-WORDER_NO,
            VIN_NO      TYPE ZSDT0180-VIN_NO,
            FULL_VIN_NO TYPE ZSDT0180-FULL_VIN_NO,
            SERIAL_NO   TYPE ZSDT0180-SERIAL_NO,
          END OF TY_VIN_P.
  DATA : LT_VIN_P TYPE TABLE OF TY_VIN_P.

  TYPES : BEGIN OF TY_VIN_E,
            NO_PDI      TYPE ZSDT0180-NO_PDI,
            NO_LINE     TYPE ZSDT0180-NO_LINE,
            NO_LINE_D   TYPE ZSDT0180-NO_LINE_D,
            WORDER_NO   TYPE ZSDT0180-WORDER_NO,
            VIN_NO      TYPE ZSDT0180-VIN_NO,
            FULL_VIN_NO TYPE ZSDT0180-FULL_VIN_NO,
            SERIAL_NO   TYPE ZSDT0180-SERIAL_NO,
            FVINNO      TYPE ZSDT0180-VIN_NO,
            ZZPRD_DATE  TYPE VBAP-ZZPRD_DATE,
            ZZSHIP_DATE TYPE VBAP-ZZSHIP_DATE,
            ZZETA       TYPE VBAP-ZZETA,
          END OF TY_VIN_E.
  DATA : LT_VIN_E TYPE TABLE OF TY_VIN_E.

  CASE ABAP_TRUE.
    WHEN R_05.
      CASE PV_CHK.
        WHEN GC_V.
          LT_VIN_P = VALUE #( FOR WA IN GT_VIN
                      WHERE ( VBELN_VL = PS_DATA-VBELN_VL
                        AND   POSNR_VL = PS_DATA-POSNR_VL )
                            ( CORRESPONDING #( WA ) ) ).

          SORT LT_VIN_P BY NO_PDI NO_LINE NO_LINE_D.

          CALL METHOD ZCL_SD_UTIL=>SALV_POPUP( IT_TAB = LT_VIN_P ).

        WHEN GC_E.
          LT_VIN_E = VALUE #( FOR WA IN GT_VIN
                      WHERE ( VBELN_VL = PS_DATA-VBELN_VL
                        AND   POSNR_VL = PS_DATA-POSNR_VL )
                            ( CORRESPONDING #( WA ) ) ).

          SORT LT_VIN_E BY NO_PDI NO_LINE NO_LINE_D.

          CALL METHOD ZCL_SD_UTIL=>SALV_POPUP( IT_TAB = LT_VIN_E ).
      ENDCASE.

    WHEN R_02 OR R_06.
      LT_VIN_P = VALUE #( FOR WA IN GT_VIN
                      WHERE ( VBELN_VL = PS_DATA-VBELN
                        AND   POSNR_VL = PS_DATA-POSNR )
                            ( CORRESPONDING #( WA ) ) ).

      SORT LT_VIN_P BY NO_PDI NO_LINE NO_LINE_D.

      CALL METHOD ZCL_SD_UTIL=>SALV_POPUP( IT_TAB = LT_VIN_P ).
  ENDCASE.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form MES                                       
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& -->  p1        text                             &
*& <--  p2        text                             &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM MES .

  TYPES : BEGIN OF TY_POPUP,
            VBELN TYPE LIPS-VBELN,
            MSG   TYPE ZSDS0040-MESSAGE,
          END OF TY_POPUP.
  DATA : LS_POPUP TYPE TY_POPUP,
         LT_POPUP TYPE TABLE OF TY_POPUP.

  DATA : LS_HEADER TYPE ZSDS0230,
         LS_ITEM   TYPE ZSDS0240,
         LT_ITEM   TYPE TABLE OF ZSDS0240,
         LS_RETURN TYPE ZSDS0250.

  DATA : LV_LGORT TYPE MARD-LGORT.

  DATA : LS_DATA2 TYPE TY_DATA2,
         LT_ROWS  TYPE LVC_T_ROID.

  CLEAR : LS_DATA2, LT_POPUP, LS_HEADER, LS_ITEM, LT_ITEM, LS_RETURN, LV_LGORT, LS_DATA2, LT_ROWS.
  MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING CHK WHERE CHK IS NOT INITIAL.

  PERFORM SELECTED_ROWS(ZSDR0000) TABLES LT_ROWS
                                   USING GO_GRID2.

  " 선택한 라인이 없으면 에러
  IF LT_ROWS IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE I004.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  " 선택 라인 체크
  LOOP AT LT_ROWS INTO DATA(LS_ROWS).
    READ TABLE GT_DATA2 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<FS>) INDEX LS_ROWS-ROW_ID.
    IF <FS> IS ASSIGNED.

      <FS>-CHK = ABAP_TRUE.

      UNASSIGN <FS>.
    ENDIF.

    " 혹시 체크 안됐을까봐 한 번 확인
    READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO DATA(LS_DATA) INDEX LS_ROWS-ROW_ID.
    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
      IF LS_DATA-CHK IS INITIAL.
        LS_DATA-CHK = ABAP_TRUE.

        MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA INDEX LS_ROWS-ROW_ID TRANSPORTING CHK.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

  " 매출처리 됐는지 확인
  READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO LS_DATA2 WITH KEY CHK      = ABAP_TRUE
                                             VBELN_VF = ''.
  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E20.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  " 납품문서 품번 전체 선택되어 있는지 체크
  DATA(LT_VBELN) = GT_DATA2.
  DELETE LT_VBELN WHERE CHK IS INITIAL.

  SELECT DISTINCT A~VBELN, A~POSNR
    FROM LIPS AS A
    JOIN @LT_VBELN AS B  ON B~VBELN_VL2 = A~VBELN
    INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_LIPS2).

  LOOP AT LT_LIPS2 INTO DATA(LS_LIPS2).
    READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO LS_DATA2 WITH KEY VBELN_VL2 = LS_LIPS2-VBELN
                                               POSNR_VL2 = LS_LIPS2-POSNR
                                               CHK       = ABAP_TRUE.
    IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.
      " 한 번 더 체크해보기
      READ TABLE LT_VBELN INTO DATA(LS_VBELN) WITH KEY VBELN_VL2 = LS_LIPS2-VBELN
                                                       POSNR_VL2 = LS_LIPS2-POSNR
                                                       CHK       = ABAP_TRUE.
      IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.
        DATA(LV_LIPS) = ABAP_TRUE.
        DATA(LV_VBELN) = |{ LS_LIPS2-VBELN ALPHA = OUT }|.

        LS_POPUP-VBELN = LS_LIPS2-VBELN.
        LS_POPUP-MSG   = LV_VBELN && | | && TEXT-E26.

        APPEND LS_POPUP TO LT_POPUP.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    CLEAR : LS_POPUP, LS_LIPS2, LS_DATA2.
  ENDLOOP.

  SORT LT_POPUP BY VBELN.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_POPUP COMPARING VBELN.

  IF LV_LIPS EQ ABAP_TRUE.
    CALL METHOD ZCL_SD_UTIL=>SALV_POPUP( IT_TAB = LT_POPUP ).
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  DATA(LT_DATA) = GT_DATA2.
  DELETE LT_DATA WHERE CHK IS INITIAL.
  SORT LT_DATA BY VBELN.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_DATA COMPARING VBELN.

  " HEADER
  SELECT DISTINCT B~VBELN, B~VKORG,
         I~VTWEG, B~LFART, B~WADAT_IST,
         B~KUNAG, B~INCO1,
         C~KUNNR AS KUNSB,
         E~NAME1 AS KUNSB_NM,
         E~HOUSE_NUM1, E~STREET,
         E~STR_SUPPL1, E~CITY1,
         F~BEZEI,
         G~BSTKD,
         H~VTEXT,
         J~AUART
    FROM @LT_DATA AS A
    JOIN LIKP AS B  ON B~VBELN = A~VBELN_VL2
    LEFT JOIN VBPA AS C  ON C~VBELN = B~VBELN
                        AND C~POSNR = '000000'
                        AND C~PARVW = 'SB'
    LEFT JOIN KNA1 AS D ON D~KUNNR = C~KUNNR
    LEFT JOIN ADRC AS E  ON E~ADDRNUMBER = D~ADRNR
                        AND E~NATION IS INITIAL
    LEFT JOIN T005U AS F  ON F~LAND1 = D~LAND1
                         AND F~SPRAS = @SY-LANGU
                         AND F~BLAND = D~REGIO
    LEFT JOIN LIPS AS LP  ON LP~VBELN = B~VBELN
    LEFT JOIN VBKD AS G  ON G~VBELN = LP~VGBEL
    LEFT JOIN TVLKT AS H  ON H~LFART = B~LFART
                         AND H~SPRAS = @SY-LANGU
    JOIN LIPS AS I  ON I~VBELN = B~VBELN
    LEFT JOIN VBAK AS J  ON J~VBELN = A~VGBEL
    INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_HEAD).

  SORT LT_HEAD BY VBELN VKORG VTWEG LFART WADAT_IST KUNAG INCO1 KUNSB.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_HEAD COMPARING VBELN VKORG VTWEG LFART WADAT_IST KUNAG INCO1 KUNSB.

  " ITEM
  SELECT DISTINCT B~VBELN, B~POSNR,
         B~WERKS, B~MATNR,
         B~LFIMG, B~VRKME
    FROM @LT_HEAD AS A
    JOIN LIPS AS B  ON B~VBELN = A~VBELN
    INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_LIPS).

  SELECT DISTINCT FIELD05 AS LGORT,
         FIELD09 AS KUNSB
    FROM ZCMT0030
   WHERE ZMODULE = 'SD'
     AND CLASS   = 'SD010'
    INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_0030).


  LOOP AT LT_HEAD INTO DATA(LS_HEAD).

    " YCB2는 전송하지 않고 CBO 테이블에 상태만 Y로 업데이트
    IF LS_HEAD-AUART EQ 'YCB2'.
      PERFORM CHANGE_STATUS USING LS_HEAD-VBELN
                                  GC_Y.

      CONTINUE.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT SINGLE FIELD06
      FROM ZCMT0030
     WHERE ZMODULE = 'SD'
       AND CLASS   = 'SD004'
       AND FIELD05 = @LS_HEAD-INCO1
      INTO @LV_LGORT.

    LS_HEADER-IF_TYPE   = GC_I.
    LS_HEADER-VBELN_VL  = LS_HEAD-VBELN.
    LS_HEADER-VKORG     = LS_HEAD-VKORG.
    LS_HEADER-VTWEG     = LS_HEAD-VTWEG.
    LS_HEADER-LFART     = LS_HEAD-LFART.
    LS_HEADER-VTEXT     = LS_HEAD-VTEXT.
    LS_HEADER-GI_TYPE   = 'GI'.
    LS_HEADER-WADAT_IST = LS_HEAD-WADAT_IST.
    LS_HEADER-KUNAG     = LS_HEAD-KUNAG.
    LS_HEADER-KUNWE     = LS_HEAD-KUNSB.
    LS_HEADER-KUNWE_NM  = LS_HEAD-KUNSB_NM.
    LS_HEADER-ADDRESS   = LS_HEAD-HOUSE_NUM1 && | | && LS_HEAD-STREET && | | &&
                          LS_HEAD-STR_SUPPL1 && | | && LS_HEAD-CITY1 && | | &&
                          LS_HEAD-BEZEI.
    LS_HEADER-INCO1     = LS_HEAD-INCO1.
    LS_HEADER-BSTKD     = LS_HEAD-BSTKD.

    CLEAR : LT_ITEM, LS_ITEM.
    LOOP AT LT_LIPS INTO DATA(LS_LIPS) WHERE VBELN = LS_HEAD-VBELN.
      LS_ITEM-VBELN_VL  = LS_LIPS-VBELN.
      LS_ITEM-POSNR_VL  = LS_LIPS-POSNR.
      LS_ITEM-WERKS_D   = LS_LIPS-WERKS.
***      LS_ITEM-LGORT_F   = LS_LIPS-LGORT.                           

      READ TABLE LT_0030 INTO DATA(LS_0030) WITH KEY KUNSB = |{ LS_HEAD-KUNSB ALPHA = OUT }|.
      IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
        LS_ITEM-LGORT_F = LS_0030-LGORT.
      ENDIF.
      LS_ITEM-MATNR     = LS_LIPS-MATNR.
      LS_ITEM-LFIMG     = LS_LIPS-LFIMG.
      LS_ITEM-VRKME     = LS_LIPS-VRKME.

      APPEND LS_ITEM TO LT_ITEM.
      CLEAR : LS_ITEM, LS_LIPS.
    ENDLOOP.

    CALL FUNCTION 'ZSD_IF_MES_SEND '
      EXPORTING
        IS_HEADER = LS_HEADER                " [SD] SD0090 MES 송신 펑션 Header
        IV_ID     = 'SD0090'
      IMPORTING
        ES_RETURN = LS_RETURN
      TABLES
        IT_ITEM   = LT_ITEM.                 " [SD] SD0090 MES 송신 펑션 Item

    CASE LS_RETURN-TYPE.
      WHEN GC_S.    " 송신 성공했으면
        PERFORM CHANGE_STATUS USING LS_HEAD-VBELN
                                    GC_S.

***        SELECT SINGLE ZZSTATUS_MES_GI                           &nb
***          FROM LIPS                             &nbs
***         WHERE VBELN = @LS_HEAD-VBELN                          
***          INTO @LS_DATA2-ZZSTATUS_MES_GI.                          

        SELECT SINGLE ZZSTATUS_MES_GI
          FROM ZSDT0340
         WHERE VBELN = @LS_HEAD-VBELN
          INTO @LS_DATA2-ZZSTATUS_MES_GI.

        LS_DATA2-MSG  = LS_RETURN-MESSAGE.
        LS_DATA2-ICON = ICON_GREEN_LIGHT.

        MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING ZZSTATUS_MES_GI MSG ICON WHERE VBELN_VL2 = LS_HEAD-VBELN.

        CLEAR : LS_DATA2.

      WHEN OTHERS.
        LS_DATA2-MSG  = LS_RETURN-MESSAGE.
        LS_DATA2-ICON = ICON_RED_LIGHT.

        MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING MSG ICON WHERE VBELN_VL2 = LS_HEAD-VBELN.
    ENDCASE.

    CLEAR : LS_HEADER, LS_HEAD, LT_ITEM, LS_RETURN.
  ENDLOOP.




ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form CHANGE_STATUS                                     &n
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      --> LS_HEAD                                 
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM CHANGE_STATUS  USING    PV_VBELN
                             PV_CHK.

  DATA : LS_SAVE TYPE ZSDT0340,
         LT_SAVE TYPE TABLE OF ZSDT0340.

  CLEAR : LT_SAVE, LS_SAVE.

  SELECT DISTINCT VBELN, POSNR, WERKS
    FROM LIPS
   WHERE VBELN = @PV_VBELN
    INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_LIPS).

  DATA(LT_DATA) = GT_DATA2.
  DELETE LT_DATA WHERE VBELN_VL2 <> PV_VBELN
                    OR CHK IS INITIAL.

  LS_SAVE-ERDAT           = SY-DATUM.
  LS_SAVE-ERZET           = SY-UZEIT.
  LS_SAVE-ERNAM           = SY-UNAME.
  LS_SAVE-ZZSTATUS_MES_GI = PV_CHK.

  LOOP AT LT_DATA INTO DATA(LS_DATA).
    LS_SAVE-VBELN = LS_DATA-VBELN_VL2.
    LS_SAVE-POSNR = LS_DATA-POSNR_VL2.

    READ TABLE LT_LIPS INTO DATA(LS_LIPS) WITH KEY VBELN = LS_DATA-VBELN_VL2
                                                   POSNR = LS_DATA-POSNR_VL2.
    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
      LS_SAVE-WERKS = LS_LIPS-WERKS.
    ENDIF.

    APPEND LS_SAVE TO LT_SAVE.

    CLEAR : LS_SAVE-VBELN, LS_SAVE-POSNR, LS_LIPS, LS_DATA.
  ENDLOOP.

  IF LT_SAVE IS NOT INITIAL.
    MODIFY ZSDT0340 FROM TABLE LT_SAVE.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDIF.

  " 안되는거 잊어버리고 해놓았어서 CBO 저장으로 변경
***  " 납품문서 변경용                                    &nbs
***  DATA : LV_VBELN  TYPE LIKP-VBELN,                              &n
***         LS_RETURN TYPE ZSDS0220,                           &n
***         LS_ITEM   TYPE ZSDS0210,                         &nbs
***         LT_ITEM   TYPE TABLE OF ZSDS0210.                      &nb
***                                          
***  LV_VBELN = PV_VBELN.                                   
***                                          
***  CALL FUNCTION 'ENQUEUE_EVVBLKE'                                 &
***    EXPORTING                                    &nb
***      MODE_LIKP      = GC_E                          &nbs
***      MANDT          = SY-MANDT                      &nbs
***      VBELN          = LV_VBELN                      &nbs
***    EXCEPTIONS                                    &n
***      FOREIGN_LOCK   = 1                             &nbs
***      SYSTEM_FAILURE = 2                               &n
***      OTHERS         = 3.                        &nb
***                                          
***  SELECT DISTINCT VBELN,POSNR                                  
***    FROM LIPS                                   &nbs
***   WHERE VBELN = @LV_VBELN                                &nbs
***    INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_LIPS).                                
***                                          
***  LOOP AT LT_LIPS INTO DATA(LS_LIPS).                               
***    " 아이템                                    &n
***    LS_ITEM-VBELN            = LS_LIPS-VBELN.                    &n
***    LS_ITEM-POSNR            = LS_LIPS-POSNR.                    &n
***    LS_ITEM-ZZSTATUS_MES_GI  = GC_S.                              &
***                                          
***    APPEND LS_ITEM TO LT_ITEM.                               &
***  ENDLOOP.                                      &nbs
***                                          
***  CALL FUNCTION 'ZSD_DELIVERYORDER_CHANGE'                               &nbs
***    EXPORTING                                    &nb
***      IV_VBELN  = LV_VBELN                " 납품            &nbs
***    IMPORTING                                    &nb
***      ES_RETURN = LS_RETURN                " [SD] Delivery Order Change Return     
***    TABLES                                     
***      IT_ITEM   = LT_ITEM.        " [SD] Delivery Order Change input           &nb
***                                          
***  IF LS_RETURN-TYPE = GC_S.                                 &n
***    CALL FUNCTION 'DEQUEUE_EVVBLKE'                               &
***      EXPORTING                                  &nb
***        MODE_LIKP = GC_E                             &nbs
***        MANDT     = SY-MANDT                         &nbs
***        VBELN     = LV_VBELN.                         &nb
***  ENDIF.                                       



ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form INVOICE                                      &n
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& -->  p1        text                             &
*& <--  p2        text                             &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM INVOICE .

  DATA : LS_HEAD  TYPE TY_EXCEL_HEAD,
         LS_ITEM  TYPE TY_EXCEL_ITEM,
         LV_VBELN TYPE VBRP-VBELN,
         LV_MVGR1 TYPE VBRP-MVGR1,
         LV_COUNT TYPE I,
         LV_NUM   TYPE P LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
         LV_KZWI1 TYPE VBAP-KZWI1.

  DATA : LC_REF  TYPE REF TO CX_ROOT.

  DATA : LV_NETPR  TYPE NETPR,
         LV_NETPR2 TYPE NETPR.

  DATA : LV_SUBRC TYPE SY-SUBRC.

  DATA : LS_DATA2 TYPE TY_DATA2,
         LT_ROWS  TYPE LVC_T_ROID.

  CLEAR : LS_DATA2, GV_DIRECTORY2.
  MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING CHK WHERE CHK IS NOT INITIAL.

  PERFORM SELECTED_ROWS(ZSDR0000) TABLES LT_ROWS
                                   USING GO_GRID2.

  " 선택한 라인이 없으면 에러
  IF LT_ROWS IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE I004.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  " 선택 라인 체크
  LOOP AT LT_ROWS INTO DATA(LS_ROWS).
    READ TABLE GT_DATA2 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<FS>) INDEX LS_ROWS-ROW_ID.
    IF <FS> IS ASSIGNED.

      <FS>-CHK = ABAP_TRUE.

      UNASSIGN <FS>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

  " 판매오더 존재하는지 확인
  READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO LS_DATA2 WITH KEY CHK   = ABAP_TRUE
