                                             VBELN = ''.
  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E04. "- Some sales orders do not exist.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  " MAIN
  DATA(LT_HEADER) = GT_DATA2.
  DELETE LT_HEADER WHERE CHK IS INITIAL.
  SORT LT_HEADER BY VBELN POSNR.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_HEADER COMPARING VBELN POSNR. "- POSNR 추가. _DS4K909741

  " 엑셀 경로 먼저 받아놓기
  "--* 파일명에서 판매문서번호 제거. _DS4K909741 *----------------------
  DATA(LV_TXT) = |{ TEXT-T09 }_{ SY-DATUM }{ SY-UZEIT }|. "- CBU INVOICE

    "--* 기존 코드 *----------------------------------------------------
    "- 24.06.18.까지 복원 없을 시 코드 제거.
*****  READ TABLE LT_HEADER INTO DATA(LS_H) INDEX 1.                           &
*****  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                                  &n
*****    DATA(LV_VBELN2) = |{ LS_H-VBELN ALPHA = OUT }|.                        
*****    CONDENSE LV_VBELN2.                                 &nbs
*****  ENDIF.                                      &nbs
*****  DATA(LV_TXT) = TEXT-T09 && '_' && LV_VBELN2 && '_' && SY-DATUM.                     
    "--* 기존 코드 *----------------------------------------------------
  "--* 파일명에서 판매문서번호 제거. _DS4K909741 *----------------------

  PERFORM CHOOSE_DIRECTORY USING LV_TXT
                           CHANGING GV_DIRECTORY2
                                    LV_SUBRC.

  IF LV_SUBRC NE 0.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.


  "--* 파일 분리 기준 변경 _DS4K909741 *--------------------------------
  "- 국가별로 파일을 분리하지 않고 하나의 파일로 출력.
  CLEAR : GS_EXCEL_HEAD, GT_EXCEL_ITEM.


    READ TABLE LT_HEADER INTO DATA(LS_HEADER) INDEX 1.
      IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
        EXIT. "- FORM EXIT.
        MESSAGE TEXT-995 TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'. "- There are no exporting data.
      ENDIF.

    DATA(LT_DATA) = GT_DATA.
    DELETE LT_DATA WHERE VBELN <> LS_HEADER-VBELN.

    CLEAR : LS_DATA2.
    LV_VBELN = LS_HEADER-VBELN.

    SELECT SINGLE B~NAME1, B~STREET, B~STR_SUPPL1,
           B~CITY1, B~POST_CODE1, B~NAME2
      FROM J_1BBRANCH AS A
      JOIN ADRC AS B  ON B~ADDRNUMBER = A~ADRNR
                     AND B~NATION = @GC_I
      LEFT JOIN ADR6 AS C  ON C~ADDRNUMBER = B~ADDRNUMBER
     WHERE A~BUKRS  = '1000'
       AND A~BRANCH = 'Z144'
      INTO @DATA(LS_ADRC).

    SELECT SINGLE
           CASE WHEN B~TEL_NUMBER IS NOT INITIAL
           THEN B~TEL_NUMBER
           ELSE D~TEL_NUMBER
            END AS TEL_NUMBER,
           CASE WHEN B~FAX_NUMBER IS NOT INITIAL
           THEN B~FAX_NUMBER
           ELSE D~FAX_NUMBER
            END AS FAX_NUMBER,
           C~SMTP_ADDR
      FROM T001 AS A
      JOIN VBAK AS VK  ON VK~BUKRS_VF = A~BUKRS
      LEFT JOIN ADRC AS B  ON B~ADDRNUMBER = A~ADRNR
                          AND B~NATION     = @GC_I
      LEFT JOIN ADR6 AS C  ON C~ADDRNUMBER = A~ADRNR
      LEFT JOIN ADRC AS D  ON D~ADDRNUMBER = A~ADRNR
                          AND D~NATION IS INITIAL
     WHERE VK~VBELN = @LS_HEADER-VBELN
      INTO @DATA(LS_ADRC3).

    " Header 주소( APPLICANT )
    SELECT SINGLE
           A~WAERK, A~AUDAT AS VDATU,
           D~NAME1, D~NAME2,
           D~STREET, D~CITY1, D~POST_CODE1,
           E~INCO1, E~INCO2,
           CASE
           WHEN E~KURRF IS NOT INITIAL
           THEN E~KURRF
           ELSE E~KURSK
            END AS KURRF,
           F~VTEXT
      FROM VBAK AS A
      JOIN VBAP AS B  ON B~VBELN = A~VBELN
      LEFT JOIN ( KNA1 AS C JOIN ADRC AS D  ON D~ADDRNUMBER = C~ADRNR
                                           AND D~NATION     = @GC_I )
                                            ON C~KUNNR = A~KUNNR
      LEFT JOIN ( VBKD AS E LEFT JOIN TVZBT AS F  ON F~ZTERM = E~ZTERM
                                                 AND F~SPRAS = @GC_E   )   " EN
                                                  ON E~VBELN = A~VBELN
                                                 AND E~POSNR = '000000'
     WHERE A~VBELN = @LV_VBELN
      INTO @DATA(LS_ADRC2).

    IF LS_ADRC-NAME1 IS INITIAL.
      SELECT SINGLE
             A~WAERK, A~AUDAT AS VDATU,
             D~NAME1, D~NAME2,
             D~STREET, D~CITY1, D~POST_CODE1,
             E~INCO1, E~INCO2,
             CASE
             WHEN E~KURRF IS NOT INITIAL
             THEN E~KURRF
             ELSE E~KURSK
              END AS KURRF,
             F~VTEXT
        FROM VBAK AS A
        JOIN VBAP AS B  ON B~VBELN = A~VBELN
        JOIN ( KNA1 AS C JOIN ADRC AS D  ON D~ADDRNUMBER = C~ADRNR
                                        AND D~NATION IS INITIAL )
                                         ON C~KUNNR = A~KUNNR
        LEFT JOIN ( VBKD AS E LEFT JOIN TVZBT AS F  ON F~ZTERM = E~ZTERM
                                                   AND F~SPRAS = @GC_E   )   " EN
                                                    ON E~VBELN = A~VBELN
                                                   AND E~POSNR = '000000'
       WHERE A~VBELN = @LV_VBELN
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @LS_ADRC2.
    ENDIF.

    " Header
    LS_HEAD-NAME1     = LS_ADRC-NAME1.
    LS_HEAD-STREET    = LS_ADRC-STREET && | | && LS_ADRC-STR_SUPPL1.
    LS_HEAD-CITY      = LS_ADRC-CITY1 && | | && LS_ADRC-POST_CODE1.
    LS_HEAD-NAME2     = LS_ADRC2-NAME1 && | | && LS_ADRC2-NAME2.
    LS_HEAD-STREET2   = LS_ADRC2-STREET && | | && LS_ADRC2-CITY1 && | | && LS_ADRC2-POST_CODE1.
    LS_HEAD-DATE      = LS_ADRC2-VDATU(4) && '.' && LS_ADRC2-VDATU+4(2) && '.' && LS_ADRC2-VDATU+6(2).
    LS_HEAD-ZTERM_TXT = LS_ADRC2-VTEXT.
    LS_HEAD-INCO1     = LS_ADRC2-INCO1.
    LS_HEAD-INCO2     = LS_ADRC2-INCO2.
    LS_HEAD-WAERK     = LS_ADRC2-WAERK.
    LS_HEAD-TEL       = TEXT-M09 && | | && LS_ADRC3-TEL_NUMBER.
    LS_HEAD-FAX       = TEXT-M10 && | | && LS_ADRC3-FAX_NUMBER.
    LS_HEAD-EMAIL     = TEXT-M11 && | | && LS_ADRC3-SMTP_ADDR.
    LV_NUM = LS_ADRC2-KURRF.
    WRITE LV_NUM TO LS_HEAD-KURRF.

    MOVE LS_HEAD TO GS_EXCEL_HEAD.

    CONDENSE : LS_HEAD-KURRF,
               LS_HEAD-NAME1,
               LS_HEAD-NAME2,
               LS_HEAD-INCO1,
               LS_HEAD-INCO2,
               LS_HEAD-WAERK.

    "--* 아이템 취득. (로직 수정 _DS4K909741) *-------------------------
    TRY.
      WITH +ADRC_TEXT AS (
        SELECT FROM ADRC  AS A
               JOIN T005T AS B   ON     B~LAND1 = A~COUNTRY
                                    AND B~SPRAS = @SY-LANGU
          FIELDS A~ADDRNUMBER, B~LANDX )
      SELECT FROM VBAP           AS A
             JOIN @LT_HEADER     AS I   ON     I~VBELN = A~VBELN
                                           AND I~POSNR = A~POSNR
             JOIN VBAK           AS B   ON     B~VBELN = A~VBELN
             JOIN MARA           AS E   ON     E~MATNR = A~MATNR
        LEFT JOIN VBPA           AS C   ON     C~VBELN = B~VBELN
                                           AND C~POSNR = A~POSNR
                                           AND C~PARVW = 'AG'
        LEFT JOIN +ADRC_TEXT     AS D   ON     D~ADDRNUMBER = C~ADRNR
        LEFT JOIN PRCD_ELEMENTS  AS G   ON     G~KNUMV = B~KNUMV
                                           AND G~KPOSN = A~POSNR
                                           AND G~KSCHL = 'ZPR2'
        LEFT JOIN TVM1T          AS H  ON      H~MVGR1 = A~MVGR1
                                           AND H~SPRAS = @SY-LANGU
        FIELDS DISTINCT A~VBELN, A~MATNR
           , A~VRKME, A~MVGR1
           , A~ARKTX AS NAME
           , B~ERDAT, B~WAERK
           , D~LANDX AS NATIO
           , G~KBETR, G~WAERS
           , H~BEZEI
           , SUM( A~KWMENG ) AS FKIMG
           , SUM( A~KZWI1 )  AS KZWI1
        GROUP BY A~ARKTX, A~VBELN, A~MATNR
               , A~VRKME, A~MVGR1
               , B~ERDAT, B~WAERK
               , D~LANDX
               , G~KBETR, G~WAERS
               , H~BEZEI
        ORDER BY A~VBELN, D~LANDX, NAME
        INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_SLSDOC).
    CATCH CX_ROOT INTO DATA(LO_ROOT).

    ENDTRY.

    LOOP AT LT_SLSDOC ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<LS_SLSDOC>).
      CLEAR LS_ITEM.

      LS_ITEM-VBELN = <LS_SLSDOC>-VBELN.
      LS_ITEM-NATIO = <LS_SLSDOC>-NATIO.
      LS_ITEM-NAME  = <LS_SLSDOC>-NAME.
      LS_ITEM-TEXT  = TEXT-T08.

      "- FKIMG
      WRITE <LS_SLSDOC>-FKIMG TO LS_ITEM-FKIMG.

      "--* KBETR *------------------------------------------------------
      IF <LS_SLSDOC>-WAERK = <LS_SLSDOC>-WAERS.
        WRITE <LS_SLSDOC>-KBETR TO LS_ITEM-KBETR.

      ELSE.
        TRY.
            LV_KZWI1 = <LS_SLSDOC>-KZWI1 / <LS_SLSDOC>-FKIMG.
          CATCH CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE INTO LC_REF.
            LV_KZWI1 = 0.
          CATCH CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_OVERFLOW INTO LC_REF.
            LV_KZWI1 = 0.
        ENDTRY.

        WRITE LV_KZWI1 TO LS_ITEM-KBETR.
      ENDIF.
      "--* KBETR *------------------------------------------------------

      "--* KZWI1 *------------------------------------------------------
      ZCL_SD_UTIL=>CONV_CURR( EXPORTING I_IN       = ' '
                                        I_CURRENCY = <LS_SLSDOC>-WAERK
                                        I_AMOUNT   = <LS_SLSDOC>-KZWI1
                              IMPORTING E_AMOUNT   = <LS_SLSDOC>-KZWI1 ).
      WRITE <LS_SLSDOC>-KZWI1 TO LS_ITEM-KZWI1.
      "--* KZWI1 *------------------------------------------------------

      "- FKIMG2
      LS_ITEM-FKIMG2 = |{ <LS_SLSDOC>-FKIMG ALIGN = LEFT }|.

      "- KZWI12
      LS_ITEM-KZWI12 = |{ <LS_SLSDOC>-KZWI1 ALIGN = LEFT }|.

      "--* PRICE *------------------------------------------------------
      LV_NETPR = ROUND( VAL = <LS_SLSDOC>-KZWI1 * LS_ADRC2-KURRF
                        DEC = 0 ).
      LS_ITEM-PRICE = |{ LV_NETPR ALIGN = LEFT }|.
      "--* PRICE *------------------------------------------------------

      LS_ITEM-CURRENCY = <LS_SLSDOC>-WAERK.
      LS_ITEM-MVGR1    = <LS_SLSDOC>-MVGR1.

      CONDENSE : LS_ITEM-VBELN,
                 LS_ITEM-NATIO,
                 LS_ITEM-NAME,
                 LS_ITEM-TEXT,
                 LS_ITEM-FKIMG,
                 LS_ITEM-KBETR,
                 LS_ITEM-FKIMG2,
                 LS_ITEM-KZWI1,
                 LS_ITEM-KZWI12,
                 LS_ITEM-PRICE,
                 LS_ITEM-PRICE2,
                 LS_ITEM-MVGR1,
                 LS_ITEM-CURRENCY.

      APPEND LS_ITEM TO GT_EXCEL_ITEM.

      IF LV_MVGR1 <> <LS_SLSDOC>-MVGR1.
        LV_MVGR1 = <LS_SLSDOC>-MVGR1.
        LV_COUNT = 0.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    "--* 아이템 취득. (로직 수정 _DS4K909741) *-------------------------


  "--* 파일명에서 판매문서번호 제거. _DS4K909741 *----------------------
  PERFORM EXCEL_DOWN USING 'ZSDR0080_INVOICE' LV_TXT
                     CHANGING LV_SUBRC.

    "--* 기존 코드 *----------------------------------------------------
    "- 24.06.18.까지 복원할 일 없으면 코드 지워도 됨.
*****      LV_VBELN2     = |{ LV_VBELN ALPHA = OUT }|.                   &n
*****      CONDENSE LV_VBELN2.                               &nbs
*****      DATA(LV_TXT2) = TEXT-T09 && '_' && LV_VBELN2 && '_' && SY-DATUM.                &nbs
*****      PERFORM EXCEL_DOWN    USING 'ZSDR0080_INVOICE' LV_TXT2                     
*****                       CHANGING LV_SUBRC.               
    "--* 기존 코드 *----------------------------------------------------
  "--* 파일명에서 판매문서번호 제거. *----------------------------------

  IF LV_SUBRC EQ 0.
** 저장된 엑셀 OPEN                                     &nbs
    CLEAR:G_EXCEL, G_MAPL, G_MAPL, G_SHEET.
    IF G_EXCEL-HEADER = SPACE OR G_EXCEL-HANDLE = -1.
      CREATE OBJECT G_EXCEL 'Excel.Application'.
      PERFORM ERR_HDL.
    ENDIF.

** 엑셀 불러오기                                       &
    CALL METHOD OF G_EXCEL 'Workbooks' = G_MAPL.

    PERFORM ERR_HDL.

    CALL METHOD OF G_MAPL 'OPEN' "= G_MAP
      EXPORTING
        #1 = GV_FILENAME.     "저장된 엑셀 파일명

    CALL METHOD OF G_EXCEL 'Worksheets' = G_SHEET
      EXPORTING
      #1 = 1.

    CALL METHOD OF G_SHEET 'Activate'.

*__엑셀 화면 출력 visible 처리                                   &nb
    SET PROPERTY OF G_EXCEL 'Visible' = 1.           "0-숨김, 1-보이기

    PERFORM FILL_SPREADSHEET_CELL .

  ELSE.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.
  "--* 파일 분리 기준 변경 _DS4K909741 *--------------------------------
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form excel_down                                      
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      --> P_                                  
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM EXCEL_DOWN     USING  PV_OBJID PV_FNAME
                 CHANGING  PV_SUBRC.
  DATA : LV_FNAME  LIKE RLGRAP-FILENAME,
         LV_SUBRC  TYPE SY-SUBRC,
         LV_RETURN TYPE I.

  DATA : LV_DOCUMENT TYPE STRING.
  DATA : LV_DEF      TYPE RLGRAP-FILENAME.
  DATA : LS_KEY      LIKE WWWDATATAB.

  DATA: LV_TIME(22).
  DATA: LT_DOC_TABLE     LIKE W3MIME OCCURS 0,
        L_DOC_SIZE       TYPE I,
        L_DOC_TYPE(80)   VALUE SOI_DOCTYPE_EXCEL_SHEET,
        L_DOC_FORMAT(80) TYPE C.

  DATA: LS_FILE_LENGTH(20), "TYPE I,
        LS_FILENAME      TYPE STRING.

  CLEAR:LT_DOC_TABLE,LT_DOC_TABLE[], GV_FILENAME.

***  LV_FNAME = PV_FNAME.                                   
***                                          
****.. 파일선택창                                       &nbs
***  CALL FUNCTION 'WS_FILENAME_GET'                                 &
***    EXPORTING                                    &nb
***      DEF_FILENAME     = LV_FNAME   " 화일명                      
***      MODE             = GC_S                    &nb
***      TITLE            = 'FILE PATH'                   &n
***    IMPORTING                                    &nb
***      FILENAME         = LV_FNAME                       &
***    EXCEPTIONS                                    &n
***      INV_WINSYS       = 01                          
***      NO_BATCH         = 02                        &
***      SELECTION_CANCEL = 03                               
***      SELECTION_ERROR  = 04.                              
***                                          
***  PV_SUBRC = SY-SUBRC.                                   
***                                          
***  IF SY-SUBRC  NE 0.                                 &nbs
***    EXIT.                                     &
***  ENDIF.                                       
***                                          
***  CALL FUNCTION 'WS_FILE_DELETE'                                 &n
***    EXPORTING                                    &nb
***      FILE   = LV_FNAME                              
***    IMPORTING                                    &nb
***      RETURN = LV_RETURN.                               &

**  IF LS_RETURN = 0 OR LS_RETURN = 1.                            &nbs
**  ELSE.                                       &n
**    MESSAGE I001 with text-m01.                               &
**    EXIT.                                     &n
**  ENDIF.                                       &

  GV_FILENAME = GV_DIRECTORY2 && PV_FNAME.

*..파일이름을 프로그램명으로 넣음                                     &nbs
  LV_DEF = GV_FILENAME && '.XLSX'.

  CLEAR: LS_KEY.
  SELECT SINGLE * FROM WWWDATA
  INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF LS_KEY
  WHERE OBJID = PV_OBJID.

  CALL FUNCTION 'DOWNLOAD_WEB_OBJECT'
    EXPORTING
      KEY         = LS_KEY
      DESTINATION = LV_DEF
    IMPORTING
      RC          = LV_SUBRC.

  PV_SUBRC = LV_SUBRC.

  IF LV_SUBRC NE 0.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.

FORM FILL_SPREADSHEET_CELL .

        LV_CHAR_QTY   TYPE CHAR20,
        LV_CHAR_NTGEW TYPE CHAR20.

  DATA : LV_TEXT(60).
*                                          &n

  DATA:
    LO_CONTROL     TYPE REF TO I_OI_CONTAINER_CONTROL,

  " 통합 INVOICE HEADER
  PERFORM PRO_FILL_CELL_DATA USING: 3 1 1 GS_EXCEL_HEAD-NAME1, "A3
                                    4   1   0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-STREET, "A4
                                    5   1   0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-CITY, "A5
                                    8   1   1  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-NAME2, "A8
                                    9   1   0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-STREET2, "A9
  "--* DS4K911579 *-----------------------------------------------------
                                    3   13  0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-DATE, "M3
    "--* 기존 코드 *----------------------------------------------------
*                                    3   10  0&nbs
    "--* 기존 코드 *----------------------------------------------------
  "--* DS4K911579 *-----------------------------------------------------
                                    5   6   0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-ZTERM_TXT, "F5
  "--* DS4K911579 *-----------------------------------------------------
                                    10  8   0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-INCO1, "H10
                                    10  10  0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-INCO2, "J10
    "--* 기존 코드 *----------------------------------------------------
*                                    10  7   0&nbs
*                                    10  8   0&nbs
    "--* 기존 코드 *----------------------------------------------------
  "--* DS4K911579 *-----------------------------------------------------
                                    24  1   0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-TEL, "A24
                                    25  1   0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-FAX, "A25
                                    26  1   0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-EMAIL. "A26
  " 환율
  CASE GS_EXCEL_HEAD-WAERK.
    WHEN 'EUR'.
      DATA(LV_CURR) = '#'.
    WHEN 'USD'.
      LV_CURR = '$'.
  ENDCASE.

  CASE GS_EXCEL_HEAD-WAERK.
    WHEN 'EUR'.
      DATA(LV_CURR_ICON) = '#'.
    WHEN 'USD'.
      LV_CURR_ICON = '$'.
  ENDCASE.

  LV_TEXT = TEXT-M17 && ' ' && LV_CURR && '1' && ' ' && '='.

  PERFORM PRO_FILL_CELL_DATA USING:
      12      6       0         LV_TEXT,
  "--* DS4K911579 *-----------------------------------------------------
      12      10      0         GS_EXCEL_HEAD-KURRF. "J10
    "--* 기존 코드 *----------------------------------------------------
*      12      8       0         GS_EXCEL_HEAD-KURRF.          &n
    "--* 기존 코드 *----------------------------------------------------
  "--* DS4K911579 *-----------------------------------------------------

  LV_LINE_CNT = 19.

  " 라인 삽입용
  DATA(LV_LINES) = LINES( GT_EXCEL_ITEM ).

  GV_LINE = LV_LINES + 20.

  "--* DS4K911579 *-----------------------------------------------------
  DATA(LV_TIMES) = LV_LINES - 2.
    "--* 기존 코드 *----------------------------------------------------
*  DATA(LV_TIMES) = LV_LINES - 1.                                
    "--* 기존 코드 *----------------------------------------------------
  "--* DS4K911579 *-----------------------------------------------------

  DO LV_TIMES TIMES.
    "--* DS4K911579 *---------------------------------------------------
    CALL METHOD OF G_EXCEL 'Rows' = LS_ROW EXPORTING #1 = 21.
      "--* 기존 코드 *--------------------------------------------------
*    CALL METHOD OF G_EXCEL 'Rows' = LS_ROW                           
*    EXPORTING                                     
*      #1       = 20. "- 복사될 위치 (복수가능-->3:4)                   &nbs
      "--* 기존 코드 *--------------------------------------------------
    "--* DS4K911579 *---------------------------------------------------

    CALL METHOD OF LS_ROW 'Select'.  "- Row선택.
    CALL METHOD OF LS_ROW 'Insert'.  "- Row추가.
  ENDDO.

  "--* 병합해야 할 셀 확인 및 병할될 셀 값 제거 _DS4K909741 *-----------
  DATA LT_EXCEL_ITEM TYPE G_TT_EXCEL_ITEM.
    PERFORM CHK_XL_ITEM_TO_MERGE USING GT_EXCEL_ITEM
                                 CHANGING LT_EXCEL_ITEM.
  "--* 병합해야 할 셀 확인 및 병할될 셀 값 제거 *-----------------------


  "--* DS4K911579 *-----------------------------------------------------
  DATA : LT_OLE_I TYPE  TABLE OF CHAR200
       , LV_TAB   VALUE CL_ABAP_CHAR_UTILITIES=>HORIZONTAL_TAB.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <LS_OLE_I> LIKE LINE OF LT_OLE_I.

  LOOP AT LT_EXCEL_ITEM INTO DATA(LS_ITEM)
                        TO LINES( LT_EXCEL_ITEM ) - 2. " 합계 두 행 제외
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO LT_OLE_I ASSIGNING <LS_OLE_I>.

    "--* Column A *-----------------------------------------------------
    LS_ITEM-VBELN = |{ LS_ITEM-VBELN ALPHA = OUT }|.
    <LS_OLE_I> = LS_ITEM-VBELN.
    "--* Column A *-----------------------------------------------------

    "--* Column B *-----------------------------------------------------
    <LS_OLE_I> = <LS_OLE_I> && LV_TAB && LS_ITEM-NATIO.
    "--* Column B *-----------------------------------------------------

    "--* Column C *-----------------------------------------------------
    <LS_OLE_I> = <LS_OLE_I> && LV_TAB && LS_ITEM-NAME.
    "--* Column C *-----------------------------------------------------

    "--* Column D *-----------------------------------------------------
    <LS_OLE_I> = <LS_OLE_I> && LV_TAB && LS_ITEM-TEXT.
    "--* Column D *-----------------------------------------------------

    "--* Column E *-----------------------------------------------------
    <LS_OLE_I> = <LS_OLE_I> && LV_TAB && LS_ITEM-FKIMG.
    "--* Column E *-----------------------------------------------------

    "--* Column F *-----------------------------------------------------
    <LS_OLE_I> = <LS_OLE_I> && LV_TAB && LV_CURR_ICON.
    "--* Column F *-----------------------------------------------------

    "--* Column G *-----------------------------------------------------
    <LS_OLE_I> = <LS_OLE_I> && LV_TAB && LS_ITEM-KBETR.
    "--* Column G *-----------------------------------------------------

    "--* Column H *-----------------------------------------------------
    <LS_OLE_I> = <LS_OLE_I> && LV_TAB && LV_CURR_ICON.
    "--* Column H *-----------------------------------------------------

    "--* Column I *-----------------------------------------------------
    <LS_OLE_I> = <LS_OLE_I> && LV_TAB && LS_ITEM-KZWI1.
    "--* Column I *-----------------------------------------------------

    "--* Column J *-----------------------------------------------------
    <LS_OLE_I> = <LS_OLE_I> && LV_TAB && LS_ITEM-FKIMG2.
    "--* Column J *-----------------------------------------------------

    "--* Column K *-----------------------------------------------------
    <LS_OLE_I> =    <LS_OLE_I> && LV_TAB
                 && COND CHAR1( WHEN LS_ITEM-KZWI12 IS INITIAL THEN SPACE
                                ELSE LV_CURR_ICON ).
    "--* Column K *-----------------------------------------------------

    "--* Column L *-----------------------------------------------------
    <LS_OLE_I> = <LS_OLE_I> && LV_TAB && LS_ITEM-KZWI12.
    "--* Column L *-----------------------------------------------------

    "--* Column M *-----------------------------------------------------
    <LS_OLE_I> =    <LS_OLE_I> && LV_TAB
                 && COND CHAR1( WHEN LS_ITEM-PRICE IS INITIAL THEN SPACE
                                ELSE '#' ).
    "--* Column M *-----------------------------------------------------

    "--* Column N *-----------------------------------------------------
    <LS_OLE_I> = <LS_OLE_I> && LV_TAB && LS_ITEM-PRICE.
    "--* Column N *-----------------------------------------------------
  ENDLOOP.

  DATA LV_RC TYPE I.
  CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES=>CLIPBOARD_EXPORT(
    EXPORTING  NO_AUTH_CHECK        = 'X'
    IMPORTING  DATA                 = LT_OLE_I
    CHANGING   RC                   = LV_RC
    EXCEPTIONS CNTL_ERROR           = 1 " Control error
               ERROR_NO_GUI         = 2 " No GUI available
               NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_GUI = 3 " GUI does not support this
               NO_AUTHORITY         = 4 " Authorization check failed
               OTHERS               = 5 ).
  IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
*   MESSAGE ID SY-MSGID TYPE SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO                          &
*     WITH SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4.                           &
  ENDIF.

  CALL METHOD OF G_SHEET 'Cells' = G_ZL EXPORTING #1 = 20      "행
                                                  #2 = 1.     "열

  CALL METHOD OF G_ZL 'Select'.
  CALL METHOD OF G_SHEET 'Paste'.

    "--* 기존 코드 *----------------------------------------------------
*  LOOP AT LT_EXCEL_ITEM INTO DATA(LS_ITEM)                              &n
*                        TO LINES( LT_EXCEL_ITEM ) - 2. " 합계 두 행 제외   
*                                          &n
*    LV_LINE_CNT = LV_LINE_CNT + 1.                              
*                                          &n
*    LS_ITEM-VBELN = |{ LS_ITEM-VBELN ALPHA = OUT }|.                        &nb

FORM PRO_FILL_CELL_DATA  USING I J BOLD VAL.

  CALL METHOD OF G_EXCEL 'Cells' = G_ZL
    EXPORTING
    #1 = I      "행
    #2 = J.     "열

*    perform err_hdl.                                   
  SET PROPERTY OF G_F  'Bold'  = BOLD.
*    perform err_hdl.                                   


ENDFORM.

                     PV_LINES.

    EXPORTING
      #1       = LV_CNT.

*          LT_FIELD_TO_MERGE = VALUE #( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 8 ) ( 9 ) ( 10 ) ).      &
            "--* 기존 코드 *--------------------------------------------
          "--* DS4K911579 *---------------------------------------------

      READ TABLE PT_XL_ITEM INTO DATA(LS_XL_ITEM) INDEX SY-INDEX.

              EXPORTING #1 = LS_XL_ITEM-MERGE_TO_ROW
                        #2 = <LV_FIELD_TO_MERGE>.

ENDFORM.

*& Form SET_CURRENCY                                     &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      --> LV_LINE_CNT                                &n
*&      --> P_6                                 &nbs
*&      --> LS_ITEM_KBETR                                
*&      --> LS_ITEM_CURENCY                               &nbs
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM SET_CURRENCY  USING    PV_COL
                            PV_ROW
                            PV_VAL
                            PV_CURRENCY.

  DATA : NUMBERFORMAT TYPE STRING. " VALUE '@ #,##0.00'.
  CLEAR : NUMBERFORMAT.

  CASE PV_CURRENCY.
    WHEN 'EUR'.
      NUMBERFORMAT = '_([$#-x-euro2]* #,##0.00_);_([$#-x-euro2]* (#,##0.00);_([$#-x-euro2] * \"\"-\"\"??_);_(@_)'.
    WHEN 'USD'.
      NUMBERFORMAT = '_([$$-en-US]* #,##0.00_);_([$$-en-US]* (#,##0.00);_([$$-en-US]* \"\"-\"\"??_);_(@_)'.
    WHEN 'KRW'.
***      NUMBERFORMAT = '_-\* #,##0_-;-\* #,##0_-;_-\* ""-""_-;_-@_-'.                     &nbs
  ENDCASE.

*  REPLACE '@' INTO NUMBERFORMAT WITH PV_CURRENCY(3).                            

  CALL METHOD OF G_EXCEL 'Cells' = G_ZL
      EXPORTING
      #1 = PV_COL      "행
      #2 = PV_ROW.     "열

  PERFORM ERR_HDL.

  IF PV_CURRENCY EQ 'KRW'.
    SET PROPERTY OF G_ZL 'Style' = 'Currency [0]'.

  ELSE.
    SET PROPERTY OF G_ZL 'Style' = 'currency'.
    PERFORM ERR_HDL.
  ENDIF.

  IF NUMBERFORMAT IS NOT INITIAL.
    SET PROPERTY OF G_ZL 'NumberFormat' = NUMBERFORMAT.

    "- '셀에 맞춤' 제거. _DS4K909741
    " 셀에 맞춤이 적용되면 통화기호가 일렬로 정렬되지 않음.
    SET PROPERTY OF G_ZL 'ShrinkToFit' = 'False'.
    PERFORM ERR_HDL.
  ENDIF.

  CLEAR : NUMBERFORMAT.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form VIN                                       
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& -->  p1        text                             &
*& <--  p2        text                             &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM VIN .

  DATA : LV_SUBRC TYPE SY-SUBRC.

  DATA: LV_LINE_CNT TYPE NUMC10,
        LV_CNT      TYPE NUMC10,
        LS_BOLD     TYPE I.

  DATA : LV_PRICE_TXT(30),
         LV_TXT3(30),
         LV_TXT4(30).

  DATA : LV_KZWI1 TYPE VBAP-KZWI1.
  DATA : LC_REF  TYPE REF TO CX_ROOT.

  DATA : LS_DATA2 TYPE TY_DATA2,
         LT_ROWS  TYPE LVC_T_ROID.

  CLEAR : LS_DATA2, GV_DIRECTORY2.
  MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING CHK WHERE CHK IS NOT INITIAL.

  PERFORM SELECTED_ROWS(ZSDR0000) TABLES LT_ROWS
                                   USING GO_GRID2.

  " 선택한 라인이 없으면 에러
  IF LT_ROWS IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE I004.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  " 선택 라인 체크
  LOOP AT LT_ROWS INTO DATA(LS_ROWS).
    READ TABLE GT_DATA2 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<FS>) INDEX LS_ROWS-ROW_ID.
    IF <FS> IS ASSIGNED.

      <FS>-CHK = ABAP_TRUE.

      UNASSIGN <FS>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

  DATA(LT_DATA) = GT_DATA2.
  DELETE LT_DATA WHERE CHK IS INITIAL.

  " 판매오더 있는 건만
  READ TABLE LT_DATA INTO DATA(LS_DATA) WITH KEY CHK   = ABAP_TRUE
                                                 VBELN = ''.
  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E06.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  " VIN 정보 있는지 확인
  DATA(LT_VIN_CHK) = GT_DATA2.
  DELETE LT_VIN_CHK WHERE CHK IS INITIAL.
  IF C_03 EQ ABAP_TRUE.
    READ TABLE LT_VIN_CHK INTO DATA(LS_VIN_CHK) WITH KEY VIN_NO = ''.
    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
      MESSAGE TEXT-E16 TYPE GC_I. "- Lines without VIN (Vehicle Identification Number) information.
      EXIT.
    ENDIF.

  ELSE.
    READ TABLE LT_VIN_CHK INTO LS_VIN_CHK WITH KEY PVINNO_SHIP = 0.
    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
      MESSAGE TEXT-E16 TYPE GC_I.
      EXIT.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  CASE C_03. "- Display with Full VIN List
    WHEN ABAP_TRUE.
      WITH +MAIN AS (
      SELECT DISTINCT
             A~VBELN, A~POSNR,
             B~NO_LINE_D, B~FULL_VIN_NO,
             D~BSTKD_E,
             E~WAERK,
             F~KBETR, F~WAERS,
             G~NAME,
             I~LANDX AS NATIO,
             VP~KZWI1, VP~KWMENG
        FROM @LT_DATA AS A
        JOIN VBAP AS VP  ON VP~VBELN = A~VBELN
                        AND VP~POSNR = A~POSNR
        JOIN ZSDT0180 AS B  ON B~WORDER_NO   = A~BSTKD_E
                           AND B~VIN_NO      = A~VIN_NO
                           AND B~FULL_VIN_NO = A~FULL_VIN_NO
        JOIN ZSDT0200 AS C  ON C~NO_PDI  = B~NO_PDI
                           AND C~NO_LINE = B~NO_LINE
                           AND C~VBELN   = VP~VGBEL
                           AND C~POSNR   = VP~VGPOS
        LEFT JOIN VBKD AS D  ON D~BSTKD_E = A~BSTKD_E
                            AND D~VBELN   = A~VBELN
                            AND D~POSNR   = A~POSNR
        JOIN VBAK AS E  ON E~VBELN = VP~VBELN
        LEFT JOIN PRCD_ELEMENTS AS F  ON F~KNUMV = E~KNUMV
                                     AND F~KPOSN = B~POSNR
                                     AND F~KSCHL = 'ZPR2'
        LEFT JOIN ( MARA AS MA JOIN ZMMT0002 AS G  ON G~ZZCATYPE = MA~ZZCATYPE )
                                                   ON MA~MATNR = VP~MATNR
        LEFT JOIN VBPA AS H  ON H~VBELN = VP~VBELN
                            AND H~POSNR = VP~POSNR
                            AND H~PARVW = 'AG'
        LEFT JOIN ( ADRC AS AD JOIN T005T AS I  ON I~LAND1 = AD~COUNTRY
                                               AND I~SPRAS = @SY-LANGU )       " EN
                                                ON AD~ADDRNUMBER = H~ADRNR
       ORDER BY B~NO_LINE_D, D~BSTKD_E, B~FULL_VIN_NO     )

      SELECT DISTINCT A~VBELN,
             A~NO_LINE_D, A~FULL_VIN_NO,
             A~BSTKD_E, A~WAERK, A~NAME,
             A~NATIO, A~KZWI1, A~KWMENG,
             A~KBETR, A~WAERS
        FROM +MAIN AS A
        INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_VIN).

    WHEN OTHERS.
      CASE ABAP_TRUE.
        WHEN R_07.
          WITH +MAIN AS (
          SELECT DISTINCT
                 A~VBELN, A~POSNR,
                 B~NO_LINE_D, B~FULL_VIN_NO,
                 D~BSTKD_E,
                 E~WAERK,
                 F~KBETR, F~WAERS,
                 G~NAME,
                 I~LANDX AS NATIO,
                 VP~KZWI1, VP~KWMENG
            FROM @LT_DATA AS A
            JOIN VBAP AS VP  ON VP~VBELN = A~VBELN
                            AND VP~POSNR = A~POSNR
            JOIN ZSDT0180 AS B  ON B~WORDER_NO = A~BSTKD_E
            JOIN ZSDT0200 AS C  ON C~NO_PDI  = B~NO_PDI
                               AND C~NO_LINE = B~NO_LINE
                               AND C~VBELN   = VP~VGBEL
                               AND C~POSNR   = VP~VGPOS
            LEFT JOIN VBKD AS D  ON D~BSTKD_E = A~BSTKD_E
                                AND D~VBELN   = A~VBELN
                                AND D~POSNR   = A~POSNR
            JOIN VBAK AS E  ON E~VBELN = VP~VBELN
            LEFT JOIN PRCD_ELEMENTS AS F  ON F~KNUMV = E~KNUMV
                                         AND F~KPOSN = B~POSNR
                                         AND F~KSCHL = 'ZPR2'
            LEFT JOIN ( MARA AS MA JOIN ZMMT0002 AS G  ON G~ZZCATYPE = MA~ZZCATYPE )
                                                       ON MA~MATNR = VP~MATNR
            LEFT JOIN VBPA AS H  ON H~VBELN = VP~VBELN
                                AND H~POSNR = VP~POSNR
                                AND H~PARVW = 'AG'
            LEFT JOIN ( ADRC AS AD JOIN T005T AS I  ON I~LAND1 = AD~COUNTRY
                                                   AND I~SPRAS = @SY-LANGU )       " EN
                                                    ON AD~ADDRNUMBER = H~ADRNR
           ORDER BY B~NO_LINE_D, D~BSTKD_E, B~FULL_VIN_NO     )

          SELECT DISTINCT A~VBELN,
                 A~NO_LINE_D, A~FULL_VIN_NO,
                 A~BSTKD_E, A~WAERK, A~NAME,
                 A~NATIO, A~KZWI1, A~KWMENG,
                 A~KBETR, A~WAERS
            FROM +MAIN AS A
            INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @LT_VIN.

        WHEN OTHERS.
          WITH +MAIN AS (
          SELECT DISTINCT
                 A~VBELN, A~POSNR,
                 B~NO_LINE_D, B~FULL_VIN_NO,
                 D~BSTKD_E,
                 E~WAERK,
                 F~KBETR, F~WAERS,
                 G~NAME,
                 I~LANDX AS NATIO,
                 VP~KZWI1, VP~KWMENG
            FROM @LT_DATA AS A
            JOIN VBAP AS VP  ON VP~VBELN = A~VBELN
                            AND VP~POSNR = A~POSNR
            JOIN ZSDT0180 AS B  ON B~WORDER_NO = A~BSTKD_E
                               AND B~VBELN     = A~VBELN
                               AND B~POSNR     = A~POSNR
            JOIN ZSDT0200 AS C  ON C~NO_PDI  = B~NO_PDI
                               AND C~NO_LINE = B~NO_LINE
                               AND C~VBELN   = VP~VGBEL
                               AND C~POSNR   = VP~VGPOS
            LEFT JOIN VBKD AS D  ON D~BSTKD_E = A~BSTKD_E
                                AND D~VBELN   = A~VBELN
                                AND D~POSNR   = A~POSNR
            JOIN VBAK AS E  ON E~VBELN = VP~VBELN
            LEFT JOIN PRCD_ELEMENTS AS F  ON F~KNUMV = E~KNUMV
                                         AND F~KPOSN = B~POSNR
                                         AND F~KSCHL = 'ZPR2'
            LEFT JOIN ( MARA AS MA JOIN ZMMT0002 AS G  ON G~ZZCATYPE = MA~ZZCATYPE )
                                                       ON MA~MATNR = VP~MATNR
            LEFT JOIN VBPA AS H  ON H~VBELN = VP~VBELN
                                AND H~POSNR = VP~POSNR
                                AND H~PARVW = 'AG'
            LEFT JOIN ( ADRC AS AD JOIN T005T AS I  ON I~LAND1 = AD~COUNTRY
                                                   AND I~SPRAS = @SY-LANGU )       " EN
                                                    ON AD~ADDRNUMBER = H~ADRNR
           ORDER BY B~NO_LINE_D, D~BSTKD_E, B~FULL_VIN_NO     )

          SELECT DISTINCT A~VBELN,
                 A~NO_LINE_D, A~FULL_VIN_NO,
                 A~BSTKD_E, A~WAERK, A~NAME,
                 A~NATIO, A~KZWI1, A~KWMENG,
                 A~KBETR, A~WAERS
            FROM +MAIN AS A
            INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @LT_VIN.
      ENDCASE.
  ENDCASE.

  "--* 데이터가 없으면 안내하고 종료 _DS4K909741 *----------------------
  IF LT_VIN IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE TEXT-996 TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'. "- VIN data to export does not exist.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.
  "--* 데이터가 없으면 안내하고 종료 *----------------------------------


  " YCE1 오더별로 생성 ( 통화별에서 변경 )
  DATA(LT_CURRENCY) = LT_VIN.
  SORT LT_CURRENCY BY VBELN.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_CURRENCY COMPARING VBELN.

  " 엑셀 경로 먼저 받아놓기
  READ TABLE LT_CURRENCY INTO DATA(LS_H) INDEX 1.
  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
    DATA(LV_VBELN2) = |{ LS_H-VBELN ALPHA = OUT }|.
    CONDENSE : LV_VBELN2.
  ENDIF.
  DATA(LV_TXT) = TEXT-T10 && '_' && LV_VBELN2 && '_' && LS_H-WAERK && '_' && SY-DATUM.
  PERFORM CHOOSE_DIRECTORY USING LV_TXT
                           CHANGING GV_DIRECTORY2
                                    LV_SUBRC.
  IF LV_SUBRC NE 0.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.



  "--* 사용자가 선택한 행을 하나의 파일로 내보내기로 변경 _DS4K909741 *--
    READ TABLE LT_CURRENCY INTO DATA(LS_CURRENCY) INDEX 1.

    CLEAR : LV_CNT.

    " Excel Down
    LV_VBELN2     = |{ LS_CURRENCY-VBELN ALPHA = OUT }|.
    CONDENSE : LV_VBELN2.
    DATA(LV_TXT2) = TEXT-T10 && '_' && LV_VBELN2 && '_' && LS_CURRENCY-WAERK && '_' && SY-DATUM.
    PERFORM EXCEL_DOWN USING 'ZSDR0080_VIN' LV_TXT2
                        CHANGING LV_SUBRC.

    IF LV_SUBRC <> 0.
      EXIT.
    ENDIF.

** 저장된 엑셀 OPEN                                     &nbs
      CLEAR:G_EXCEL,G_MAPL,G_MAPL.
      IF G_EXCEL-HEADER = SPACE OR G_EXCEL-HANDLE = -1.
        CREATE OBJECT G_EXCEL 'Excel.Application'.
        PERFORM ERR_HDL.
      ENDIF.

** 엑셀 불러오기                                       &
      CALL METHOD OF G_EXCEL 'Workbooks' = G_MAPL.

      PERFORM ERR_HDL.

      CALL METHOD OF G_MAPL 'OPEN' "= G_MAP
        EXPORTING
          #1 = GV_FILENAME.     "저장된 엑셀 파일명

      CALL METHOD OF G_EXCEL 'Worksheets' = G_SHEET
        EXPORTING
        #1 = 1.

      CALL METHOD OF G_SHEET 'Activate'.

* __엑셀 화면 출력 visible 처리                                  &nb
      SET PROPERTY OF G_EXCEL 'Visible' = 1.           "0-숨김, 1-보이기

      " 헤더 셀 이름 채워넣기
      LV_PRICE_TXT = '금액(@)'.

      CASE LS_CURRENCY-WAERK.
        WHEN 'EUR'.
          DATA(LV_CURR) = 'EUR#'.
        WHEN 'USD'.
          LV_CURR = 'US$'.
        WHEN 'KRW'.
          LV_CURR = 'KRW'.
      ENDCASE.

      CASE LS_CURRENCY-WAERK.
        WHEN 'EUR'.
          DATA(LV_CURR_ICON) = '#'.
        WHEN 'USD'.
          LV_CURR_ICON = '$'.
        WHEN 'KRW'.
          LV_CURR_ICON = '#'.
      ENDCASE.

      "--* DS4K911579 *-------------------------------------------------
      PERFORM PRO_FILL_CELL_DATA USING:
                  2   10   1 LV_CURR.

        "--* 기존 코드 *------------------------------------------------
*      REPLACE '@' INTO LV_PRICE_TXT WITH LV_CURR.                         
*                                          &n
*      PERFORM PRO_FILL_CELL_DATA USING:                             &
*                  2   7   1 LV_PRICE_TXT,              &nbs
*                  2   9   1 LV_CURR.               &nb
*                                          &n
*      LV_TXT3       = LV_CURR && TEXT-M14.                      
*      DATA(LV_SUM1) = '=SUM(G:G)'.                              
*      DATA(LV_SUM2) = '=SUM(P:P)'.                              
*                                          &n
*      PERFORM PRO_FILL_CELL_DATA USING:                             &
*                  3   8   0   LV_TXT3, " H3           
*                  3   9   0   LV_SUM1, " I3           
*                  3   10  0   LV_SUM2. " J3            
*                                          &n
*      PERFORM SET_CURRENCY USING :                             &
*                  3   9       LV_SUM1 LS_CURRENCY-WAERK,         
*                  3   10      LV_SUM2 LS_CURRENCY-WAERK.         &nbs
*                                          &n
*      DATA(LT_VIN_COUNT) = LT_VIN.                              
*      DELETE LT_VIN_COUNT WHERE WAERK <> LS_CURRENCY-WAERK.                      &n
*      DATA(LV_LINE)   = LINES( LT_VIN_COUNT ).                        &nbs
*                                          &n
*      LV_LINE         = LV_LINE + 2.                     &n
*      LV_TXT4         = TEXT-M15.                       &nb
*      DATA(LV_COUNT)  = '=COUNTA(G3:G' && LV_LINE && ')'.                      
*      DATA(LV_COUNT2) = '=COUNTA(P3:P' && LV_LINE && ')'.                       
*                                          &n
*      PERFORM PRO_FILL_CELL_DATA USING:                             &
*                  5   8   0   LV_TXT4,  "- H5          
*                  5   9   0   LV_COUNT, "- I5          &nbs
*                  5   10  0   LV_COUNT2. "- J5           &n
        "--* 기존 코드 *------------------------------------------------
      "--* DS4K911579 *-------------------------------------------------



      " 데이터 채워넣기
      "--* DS4K911579 *-------------------------------------------------
      DATA : LT_OLE_LEFT  TYPE  TABLE OF CHAR200
           , LT_OLE_RIGHT TYPE  TABLE OF CHAR200
           , LV_TAB       VALUE CL_ABAP_CHAR_UTILITIES=>HORIZONTAL_TAB.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <LS_OLE> LIKE LINE OF LT_OLE_LEFT.

      LV_LINE_CNT = 2.

      LOOP AT LT_VIN INTO DATA(LS_VIN).
        APPEND INITIAL LINE TO LT_OLE_LEFT ASSIGNING <LS_OLE>.

        LV_CNT      += 1.
        LV_LINE_CNT += 1.

        "--* Column A *-------------------------------------------------
        <LS_OLE> = LV_CNT.
        "--* Column A *-------------------------------------------------

        "--* Column B *-------------------------------------------------
        <LS_OLE> = <LS_OLE> && LV_TAB && LV_CNT.
        "--* Column B *-------------------------------------------------

        "--* Column C *-------------------------------------------------
        <LS_OLE> = <LS_OLE> && LV_TAB && |=LEFT(M{ LV_LINE_CNT },13)|.
        "--* Column C *-------------------------------------------------

        "--* Column D *-------------------------------------------------
        <LS_OLE> = <LS_OLE> && LV_TAB && |=LEFT(N{ LV_LINE_CNT },13)|.
        "--* Column D *-------------------------------------------------

        "--* Column E *-------------------------------------------------
        <LS_OLE> = <LS_OLE> && LV_TAB && |=O{ LV_LINE_CNT }|.
        "--* Column E *-------------------------------------------------

        "--* Column F *-------------------------------------------------
        <LS_OLE> = <LS_OLE> && LV_TAB && |=P{ LV_LINE_CNT }|.
        "--* Column F *-------------------------------------------------

        "--* Column G *-------------------------------------------------
        <LS_OLE> = <LS_OLE> && LV_TAB && LV_CURR_ICON.
        "--* Column G *-------------------------------------------------

        "--* Column H *-------------------------------------------------
        <LS_OLE> = <LS_OLE> && LV_TAB && |=R{ LV_LINE_CNT }|.
        "--* Column H *-------------------------------------------------


        APPEND INITIAL LINE TO LT_OLE_RIGHT ASSIGNING <LS_OLE>.

        "--* Column L *-------------------------------------------------
        <LS_OLE> = LV_CNT.
        "--* Column L *-------------------------------------------------

        "--* Column M *-------------------------------------------------
        <LS_OLE> = <LS_OLE> && LV_TAB && LS_VIN-BSTKD_E.
        "--* Column M *-------------------------------------------------

        "--* Column N *-------------------------------------------------
        <LS_OLE> = <LS_OLE> && LV_TAB && LS_VIN-FULL_VIN_NO.
        "--* Column N *-------------------------------------------------

        "--* Column O *-------------------------------------------------
        <LS_OLE> = <LS_OLE> && LV_TAB && LS_VIN-NATIO.
        "--* Column O *-------------------------------------------------

        "--* Column P *-------------------------------------------------
        <LS_OLE> = <LS_OLE> && LV_TAB && LS_VIN-NAME.
        "--* Column P *-------------------------------------------------

        "--* Column Q *-------------------------------------------------
        <LS_OLE> = <LS_OLE> && LV_TAB && LV_CURR_ICON.
        "--* Column Q *-------------------------------------------------

        "--* Column R *-------------------------------------------------
        IF LS_VIN-WAERK = LS_VIN-WAERS.
          LV_KZWI1 = LS_VIN-KBETR.

        ELSE.
          TRY.
              LV_KZWI1 = LS_VIN-KZWI1 / LS_VIN-KWMENG.
            CATCH CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE INTO LC_REF.
              LV_KZWI1 = 0.
            CATCH CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_OVERFLOW INTO LC_REF.
              LV_KZWI1 = 0.
          ENDTRY.
        ENDIF.

        <LS_OLE> = <LS_OLE> && LV_TAB && LV_KZWI1.
        "--* Column R *-------------------------------------------------
      ENDLOOP.

      DATA LV_RC TYPE I.
      CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES=>CLIPBOARD_EXPORT(
        EXPORTING  NO_AUTH_CHECK        = 'X'
        IMPORTING  DATA                 = LT_OLE_LEFT
        CHANGING   RC                   = LV_RC
        EXCEPTIONS CNTL_ERROR           = 1 " Control error
                   ERROR_NO_GUI         = 2 " No GUI available
                   NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_GUI = 3 " GUI does not support this
                   NO_AUTHORITY         = 4 " Authorization check failed
                   OTHERS               = 5 ).
      IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
*       MESSAGE ID SY-MSGID TYPE SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO                      &
*         WITH SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4.                       &
      ENDIF.

      CALL METHOD OF G_SHEET 'Cells' = G_ZL EXPORTING #1 = 3      "행
                                                      #2 = 1.     "열

      CALL METHOD OF G_ZL 'Select'.
      CALL METHOD OF G_SHEET 'Paste'.


      CLEAR LV_RC.
      CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES=>CLIPBOARD_EXPORT(
        EXPORTING  NO_AUTH_CHECK        = 'X'
        IMPORTING  DATA                 = LT_OLE_RIGHT
        CHANGING   RC                   = LV_RC
        EXCEPTIONS CNTL_ERROR           = 1 " Control error
                   ERROR_NO_GUI         = 2 " No GUI available
                   NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_GUI = 3 " GUI does not support this
                   NO_AUTHORITY         = 4 " Authorization check failed
                   OTHERS               = 5 ).
      IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
*       MESSAGE ID SY-MSGID TYPE SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO                      &
*         WITH SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4.                       &
      ENDIF.

      CALL METHOD OF G_SHEET 'Cells' = G_ZL EXPORTING #1 = 3      "행
                                                      #2 = 12.     "열

      CALL METHOD OF G_ZL 'Select'.
      CALL METHOD OF G_SHEET 'Paste'.



        "--* 기존 코드 *------------------------------------------------
*      LV_LINE_CNT = 2.                                
*                                          &n
*      LOOP AT LT_VIN INTO DATA(LS_VIN).                           &nb
*        LV_LINE_CNT += 1.                              
*        LV_CNT      += 1.                         &nbs
*                                          &n
*        DATA(LV_WORDER) = '=LEFT(L' && LV_LINE_CNT && ',13)'.                    &nb
*        DATA(LV_VIN)    = '=LEFT(M' && LV_LINE_CNT && ',13)'.                  
*        DATA(LV_NATIO)  = '=+N' && LV_LINE_CNT.                       &nbs
*        DATA(LV_NAME)   = '=+O' && LV_LINE_CNT.                       
*        DATA(LV_PRICE)  = '=+P' && LV_LINE_CNT.                       &nbs
*                                          &n
*        PERFORM PRO_FILL_CELL_DATA USING:                           &
*              LV_LINE_CNT  1   0   LV_CNT,                 
*              LV_LINE_CNT  2   0   LV_CNT,                 
*              LV_LINE_CNT  3   0   LV_WORDER,                &nb
*              LV_LINE_CNT  4   0   LV_VIN,                 
*              LV_LINE_CNT  5   0   LV_NATIO,                &nbs
*              LV_LINE_CNT  6   0   LV_NAME,                 
*              LV_LINE_CNT  7   0   LV_PRICE,                &nbs
*              LV_LINE_CNT  11  0   LV_CNT,                  
*              LV_LINE_CNT  12  0   LS_VIN-BSTKD_E,                &nb
*              LV_LINE_CNT  13  0   LS_VIN-FULL_VIN_NO,                
*              LV_LINE_CNT  14  0   LS_VIN-NATIO,                 
*              LV_LINE_CNT  15  0   LS_VIN-NAME.                 
*                                          &n
*        IF LS_VIN-WAERK = LS_VIN-WAERS.                          &nbs
*          LV_KZWI1 = LS_VIN-KBETR.                          &nbs
*                                          &n
*        ELSE.                                 &nb
*          TRY.                               &nbs
*              LV_KZWI1 = LS_VIN-KZWI1 / LS_VIN-KWMENG.                  &n
*            CATCH CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE INTO LC_REF.                      
*              LV_KZWI1 = 0.                        &nb
*            CATCH CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_OVERFLOW INTO LC_REF.                    &nb
*              LV_KZWI1 = 0.                        &nb
*          ENDTRY.                               &
*        ENDIF.                                 &n
*                                          &n
*        PERFORM PRO_FILL_CELL_DATA USING:                           &
*              LV_LINE_CNT  16  0   LV_KZWI1.                 &nb
*                                          &n
*        PERFORM SET_CURRENCY USING :                           &
*          LV_LINE_CNT 7   LV_PRICE LS_VIN-WAERK,                      
*          LV_LINE_CNT 16  LV_KZWI1 LS_VIN-WAERK.                      &nbs
*      ENDLOOP.                                   
        "--* 기존 코드 *------------------------------------------------
      "--* DS4K911579 *-------------------------------------------------

      CALL METHOD OF G_EXCEL 'ActiveWorkbook' = G_AWORK.
      CALL METHOD OF G_AWORK 'Save'.
  "--* 사용자가 선택한 행을 하나의 파일로 내보내기로 변경 _DS4K909741 *--


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form KMC_EXCEL                                      
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& -->  p1        text                             &
*& <--  p2        text                             &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM KMC_EXCEL .

  DATA : LV_FNAME LIKE RLGRAP-FILENAME,
         LV_SUBRC TYPE SY-SUBRC.
  DATA : LV_DOCUMENT TYPE STRING.
  DATA : LV_DEF      TYPE RLGRAP-FILENAME.
  DATA : LS_KEY      LIKE WWWDATATAB.

  LV_FNAME = TEXT-T11 && '_' && SY-DATUM.

*.. 파일선택창                                        &
  CALL FUNCTION 'WS_FILENAME_GET'
    EXPORTING
      DEF_FILENAME     = LV_FNAME   " 화일명
      MODE             = GC_S
      TITLE            = 'FILE PATH'
    IMPORTING
      FILENAME         = LV_FNAME
    EXCEPTIONS
      INV_WINSYS       = 01
      NO_BATCH         = 02
      SELECTION_CANCEL = 03
      SELECTION_ERROR  = 04.
  IF SY-SUBRC  NE 0.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.


*..파일이름을 프로그램명으로 넣음                                     &nbs
  LV_DEF = LV_FNAME && '.XLSX'.

  CLEAR: LS_KEY.
  SELECT SINGLE * FROM WWWDATA
  INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF LS_KEY
  WHERE OBJID = 'ZSDR0080'.

  CALL FUNCTION 'DOWNLOAD_WEB_OBJECT'
    EXPORTING
      KEY         = LS_KEY
      DESTINATION = LV_DEF
    IMPORTING
      RC          = LV_SUBRC.

  IF LV_SUBRC NE 0.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.


*.. 엑셀실행                                        &n
  LV_DOCUMENT = LV_DEF.
  CALL METHOD CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES=>EXECUTE
    EXPORTING
      DOCUMENT               = LV_DOCUMENT
    EXCEPTIONS
      CNTL_ERROR             = 1
      ERROR_NO_GUI           = 2
      BAD_PARAMETER          = 3
      FILE_NOT_FOUND         = 4
      PATH_NOT_FOUND         = 5
      FILE_EXTENSION_UNKNOWN = 6
      ERROR_EXECUTE_FAILED   = 7
      SYNCHRONOUS_FAILED     = 8
      NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_GUI   = 9
      OTHERS                 = 10.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form PERIOD_CHECK                                     &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      --> LS_FKDAT_FKDAT                                
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM PERIOD_CHECK  USING    PV_FKDAT TYPE FKDAT
                            PV_VBELN_VL
                            PV_ERR
                            PV_MSG.

  " FI 기간 체크
  DATA : LV_BUKRS LIKE  T001-BUKRS,
         LV_GJAHR LIKE  T001B-FRYE1,
         LV_KOART LIKE  T001B-MKOAR,
         LV_MONAT LIKE  T001B-FRPE1,
         LV_GLVOR TYPE  GLVOR,
         LV_OPER  TYPE T001B-FRPE1.

  " CO 기간 체크
  DATA : LV_BUKRS2 TYPE T001-BUKRS,
         LV_OPER2  TYPE T001B-FRPE1.

  SELECT SINGLE C~BUKRS_VF
    FROM LIPS AS A
    JOIN ( VBAP AS B JOIN VBAK AS C  ON C~VBELN = B~VBELN )
                                     ON B~VBELN = A~VGBEL
   WHERE A~VBELN = @PV_VBELN_VL
    INTO @LV_BUKRS.

  LV_GJAHR = PV_FKDAT(4).
  LV_MONAT = PV_FKDAT+4(2).
  LV_KOART = GC_D.

  " FI 기간 체크
  CALL FUNCTION 'FI_PERIOD_CHECK'
    EXPORTING
      I_BUKRS          = LV_BUKRS
      I_GJAHR          = LV_GJAHR
      I_KOART          = LV_KOART
      I_MONAT          = LV_MONAT
      I_GLVOR          = 'RFBU'
    IMPORTING
      E_OPER           = LV_OPER
    EXCEPTIONS
      ERROR_PERIOD     = 1
      ERROR_PERIOD_ACC = 2
      INVALID_INPUT    = 3
      OTHERS           = 4.

  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
    " CO 기간 체크
    CALL FUNCTION 'ZSD_CO_PERIOD_CHECK '
      EXPORTING
        I_BUKRS      = LV_BUKRS                  " 회사 코드
        I_GJAHR      = LV_GJAHR                  " 허용된 첫번째 기간에 대한 회계연도 (간격 1에서)
        I_MONAT      = LV_MONAT                  " 최초로 허용된 전기기간 (기간 1)
      IMPORTING
        E_OPER       = LV_OPER2                 " 최초로 허용된 전기기간 (기간 1)
      EXCEPTIONS
        ERROR_PERIOD = 1                " CO 기간이 오픈되지 않았습니다.
        OTHERS       = 2.

    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 1.
      PV_ERR = GC_E.
      PV_MSG = TEXT-E12.
      EXIT.
    ENDIF.

  ELSE.
    PV_ERR = GC_E.
    PV_MSG = TEXT-E11.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form KMC                                       
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& -->  p1        text                             &
*& <--  p2        text                             &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM KMC .

  DATA : LS_DATA2 TYPE TY_DATA2,
         LT_ROWS  TYPE LVC_T_ROID.

  DATA : LS_ITEM   TYPE ZSDS0110,
         LT_ITEM   TYPE TABLE OF ZSDS0110,
         LS_COND   TYPE BAPICOND,
         LT_COND   TYPE TABLE OF BAPICOND,
         LS_CONDX  TYPE BAPICONDX,
         LT_CONDX  TYPE TABLE OF BAPICONDX,
         LS_RETURN TYPE ZSDS0120,
         LV_SEQ    TYPE I,
         LV_POSNR  TYPE VBAP-POSNR.

  DATA : LV_KUNSB TYPE VBPA-KUNNR,
         LV_WAERK TYPE VBAK-WAERK.

  DATA : LV_ERR,
         LV_MSG(100).

  TYPES : BEGIN OF TY_CHK,
            VBELN_VL TYPE LIPS-VBELN,
            POSNR_VL TYPE LIPS-POSNR,
          END OF TY_CHK.
  DATA : LS_CHK TYPE TY_CHK,
         LT_CHK TYPE TABLE OF TY_CHK.

  RANGES : LR_BSTKD FOR VBKD-BSTKD.

  CLEAR : LS_DATA2, GT_0400.
  MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING CHK WHERE CHK IS NOT INITIAL.

  PERFORM SELECTED_ROWS(ZSDR0000) TABLES LT_ROWS
                                   USING GO_GRID2.

  " 선택한 라인이 없으면 에러
  IF LT_ROWS IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE I004.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  " 선택 라인 체크
  LOOP AT LT_ROWS INTO DATA(LS_ROWS).
    READ TABLE GT_DATA2 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<FS>) INDEX LS_ROWS-ROW_ID.
    IF <FS> IS ASSIGNED.

      <FS>-CHK = ABAP_TRUE.

      UNASSIGN <FS>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

  " 유통경로가 같은 건들이 체크되어 있는지
  DATA(LT_VTWEG) = GT_DATA2.
  DELETE LT_VTWEG WHERE CHK IS INITIAL.
  SORT LT_VTWEG BY VTWEG.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_VTWEG COMPARING VTWEG.

  IF LINES( LT_VTWEG ) > 1.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E10.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  " 오더 있는지 확인
  READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO LS_DATA2 WITH KEY CHK   = ABAP_TRUE
                                             VBELN = ''.
  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E19.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  " 이미 마감처리된 문서 있는지 확인
  DATA(LT_DATA) = GT_DATA2.
  DELETE LT_DATA WHERE CHK IS INITIAL.
  SELECT DISTINCT D~VBELN
    FROM VBAP AS A
    JOIN VBAK AS B  ON B~VBELN = A~VBELN
    JOIN LIPS AS C  ON C~VGBEL = A~VGBEL
                   AND C~VGPOS = A~POSNR
    JOIN VBRP AS D  ON D~VGBEL = B~VBELN
                   AND D~VGPOS = A~POSNR
    JOIN @LT_DATA AS E  ON E~VBELN = A~VGBEL
                       AND E~POSNR = A~VGPOS
   WHERE B~AUART = 'YCE1'
    INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_TEMP).

  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
    LS_DATA2-MSG = TEXT-E01.

    MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING MSG WHERE CHK  = ABAP_TRUE
                                                     AND ICON = '@08@'.

    MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E01.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  " 아이콘 확인
  READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO LS_DATA2 WITH KEY CHK  = ABAP_TRUE
                                             ICON = '@08@'.
  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
    LS_DATA2-MSG = TEXT-E01.

    MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING MSG WHERE CHK  = ABAP_TRUE
                                                     AND ICON = '@08@'.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E01.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  DATA(LT_HEADER) = GT_DATA2.
  DELETE LT_HEADER WHERE CHK IS INITIAL.

  SORT LT_HEADER BY VBELN POSNR.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_HEADER COMPARING VBELN.

  LOOP AT LT_HEADER INTO DATA(LS_HEADER).

    LS_ITEM-VBELN     = LS_HEADER-VBELN.
    LS_ITEM-WADAT_IST = LS_HEADER-AUDAT.

    APPEND LS_ITEM TO LT_ITEM.

    CALL FUNCTION 'ZSD_SD_ALL_PROCESS '
      EXPORTING
        IV_CHK        = ABAP_TRUE
      IMPORTING
        ES_RETURN     = LS_RETURN                 " [SD] 일괄처리 return
      TABLES
        IT_DATA       = LT_ITEM                 " [SD] 일괄처리 input
        IT_CONDITION  = LT_COND                 " 오더의 조건 유지보수를 위한 통신필드
        IT_CONDITIONX = LT_CONDX.                 " 오더의 조건 유지보수를 위한 통신필드

    IF LS_RETURN-VBELN_VF_CHK EQ GC_S.
      "--* YCE1 LIPS-POSNR도 갱신하도록 수정 _DS4K911829 *--------------
      LOOP AT GT_DATA2 INTO LS_DATA2 WHERE VBELN = LS_HEADER-VBELN.
        LS_DATA2-ICON       = ICON_YELLOW_LIGHT.
        LS_DATA2-MSG        = LS_RETURN-MESSAGE.
        LS_DATA2-VBELN      = LS_RETURN-VBELN.
        LS_DATA2-VBELN_VL2  = LS_RETURN-VBELN_VL.
        LS_DATA2-VBELN_VF   = LS_RETURN-VBELN_VF.

        SELECT SINGLE
               D~FKDAT,
               F~WBSTK, E~POSNR
          FROM VBAK AS A
          JOIN VBAP AS B  ON B~VBELN = A~VBELN
          LEFT JOIN ( VBRP AS C JOIN VBRK AS D  ON D~VBELN = C~VBELN
                                               AND D~FKSTO IS INITIAL
                                               AND D~SFAKN IS INITIAL )
                                                ON C~AUBEL = A~VBELN
                                               AND C~AUPOS = B~POSNR
          LEFT JOIN ( LIPS AS E JOIN LIKP AS F  ON F~VBELN = E~VBELN )
                                                ON E~VGBEL = A~VBELN
                                               AND E~VGPOS = B~POSNR
         WHERE A~VBELN = @LS_HEADER-VBELN
               AND B~POSNR = @LS_DATA2-POSNR
               AND F~VBELN = @LS_DATA2-VBELN_VL2
          INTO ( @LS_DATA2-FKDAT, @LS_DATA2-WBSTK2, @LS_DATA2-POSNR_VL2 ).

        MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2.
      ENDLOOP.
        "--* 기존 코드 *------------------------------------------------
*        READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO LS_DATA2 WITH KEY VBELN_VL = LS_CHK-VBELN_VL               &n
*                                          &n
*        IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                             
*          LS_DATA2-ICON       = ICON_YELLOW_LIGHT.                   
*          LS_DATA2-MSG        = LS_RETURN-MESSAGE.                  &
*          LS_DATA2-VBELN      = LS_RETURN-VBELN.                    &
*          LS_DATA2-VBELN_VL2  = LS_RETURN-VBELN_VL.                       
*          LS_DATA2-VBELN_VF   = LS_RETURN-VBELN_VF.                      &
*                                          &n
*          SELECT SINGLE                             &n
*                 D~FKDAT,                        
*                 F~WBSTK                        &
*            FROM VBAK AS A                         &nb
*            JOIN VBAP AS B  ON B~VBELN = A~VBELN                 &nbs
*            LEFT JOIN ( VBRP AS C JOIN VBRK AS D  ON D~VBELN = C~VBELN         
*                                          &n
*                                          &n
*                                          &n
*                                          &n
*            LEFT JOIN ( LIPS AS E JOIN LIKP AS F  ON F~VBELN = E~VBELN )        
*                                          &n
*                                          &n
*           WHERE A~VBELN = @LS_HEADER-VBELN                       &nb
*            INTO ( @LS_DATA2-FKDAT, @LS_DATA2-WBSTK2 ).                    
*                                          &n
*          MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING ICON MSG VBELN VBELN_VL2              &nb
*                                          &n
*                                          &n
*        ENDIF.                                 &n
        "--* 기존 코드 *------------------------------------------------
      "--* YCE1 LIPS-POSNR도 갱신하도록 수정 *--------------------------



    ELSE.
      READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO LS_DATA2 WITH KEY VBELN = LS_HEADER-VBELN.
      IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
        LS_DATA2-ICON       = ICON_RED_LIGHT.
        LS_DATA2-MSG        = LS_RETURN-MESSAGE.

        IF LS_RETURN-VBELN_VL IS NOT INITIAL.
          LS_DATA2-VBELN_VL2 = LS_RETURN-VBELN_VL.

          SELECT SINGLE WBSTK
            FROM LIKP
           WHERE VBELN = @LS_RETURN-VBELN_VL
            INTO @LS_DATA2-WBSTK2.
        ENDIF.

        MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING ICON MSG VBELN_VL WBSTK2
                                             WHERE VBELN = LS_DATA2-VBELN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.


    CLEAR : LS_DATA2, LT_CHK, LT_ITEM, LS_RETURN, LT_COND, LT_CONDX, LS_HEADER.
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.

*    CLEAR : LS_DATA3, LS_PARTNER, LV_WAERS, LS_0030, LS_0090.                        
*  ENDLOOP.                                       
*                                          &n
*  LOOP AT LT_MAIN2 INTO DATA(LS_MAIN2).                               
*    MOVE-CORRESPONDING LS_MAIN2 TO LS_DATA3.                             &
*                                          &n
*    " 파트너                                    &nbs
*    READ TABLE LT_PARTNER2 INTO DATA(LS_PARTNER2) WITH KEY VBELN = LS_MAIN2-VBELN                  
*                                          &n
*                                          &n
*    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                                 
*      MOVE-CORRESPONDING LS_PARTNER2 TO LS_DATA3.                          &nbs
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
*    " 국가명                                    &nbs
*    SELECT SINGLE LANDX                                 &nb
*      FROM T005T                                  
*     WHERE LAND1 = @LS_DATA3-COUNTRY_RG                             &
*       AND SPRAS = @SY-LANGU                             &n
*      INTO @LS_DATA3-LANDX_RG.                               &nb
*                                          &n
*    SELECT SINGLE LANDX                                 &nb
*      FROM T005T                                  
*     WHERE LAND1 = @LS_DATA3-COUNTRY_Z2                             &
*       AND SPRAS = @SY-LANGU                             &n
*      INTO @LS_DATA3-LANDX_Z2.                               &nb
*                                          &n
*    " ZSDT0090에 데이터 존재하면 대체                               &
****    READ TABLE LT_00902 INTO DATA(LS_00902) WITH KEY SHIP_REQ_NO = LS_MAIN-SHIP_REQ_NO                &nbs
****                                          
****    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                                &nb
****      MOVE-CORRESPONDING LS_00902 TO LS_DATA3.                          &nbs
****    ENDIF.                                     
*                                          &n
*    " 전표                                     
*    READ TABLE LT_BELNR INTO DATA(LS_BELNR) WITH KEY VBELN = LS_MAIN-VBELN                   &
*                                          &n
*                                          &n
*    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                                 
*      LS_DATA3-BELNR2 = LS_BELNR-BELNR.                             &
*      LS_DATA3-GJAHR2 = LS_BELNR-GJAHR.                             &
*      LS_DATA3-BUKRS2 = LS_BELNR-BUKRS.                             &
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
*    IF LS_MAIN-LICENSE_NO IS NOT INITIAL.                             
*      READ TABLE LT_BELNR2 INTO DATA(LS_BELNR2) WITH KEY VBELN = LS_MAIN-VBELN                 
*                                          &n
*                                          &n
*      IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                               
*        LS_DATA3-BELNR = LS_BELNR2-BELNR.                           &
*        LS_DATA3-GJAHR = LS_BELNR2-GJAHR.                           &
*        LS_DATA3-BUKRS = LS_BELNR2-BUKRS.                           &
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
*    " DMBTR                                    &n
*    DATA(LT_DTEMP) = LT_DMBTR2.                                &
*    DELETE LT_DTEMP WHERE VBELN <> LS_MAIN2-VBELN                         &nbs
*                       OR POSNR <> LS_MAIN2-POSNR.           &n
*    SORT LT_DTEMP BY DMBTR.                                
*                                          &n
*    IF LINES( LT_DTEMP ) > 1.                             &nb
*      " 같은 WRBTR이면 순서 비교해야 해서                            &n
*      DATA(LT_WRBTR) = LT_MAIN2.                              &n
*      DELETE LT_WRBTR WHERE VBELN <> LS_MAIN2-VBELN.                       &nb
*      DELETE LT_WRBTR WHERE WRBTR <> LS_MAIN2-WRBTR.                       &nb
*      SORT LT_WRBTR BY VBELN POSNR.                            &
*      DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_WRBTR COMPARING VBELN POSNR.                    
*                                          &n
*      READ TABLE LT_WRBTR INTO DATA(LS_WRBTR) WITH KEY VBELN = LS_MAIN2-VBELN                 
*                                          &n
*      IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0 .                              
*        DATA(LV_TABIX) = SY-TABIX.                            &n
*                                          &n
*        READ TABLE LT_DTEMP INTO DATA(LS_DTEMP) INDEX LV_TABIX.                    &
*        IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                             
*          LS_DATA3-DMBTR = LS_DTEMP-DMBTR.                         &n
*        ENDIF.                                 &n
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*                                          &n
*    ELSE.                                     &nb
*      READ TABLE LT_DTEMP INTO LS_DTEMP INDEX 1.                        &n
*      IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                               
*        LS_DATA3-DMBTR = LS_DTEMP-DMBTR.                           &n
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
*    " VTWEG <> 10                                &nbs
*    IF LS_MAIN2-VTWEG <> 10.                               
*      DATA(LT_DTEMP2) = LT_DMBTR.                              &
*      DELETE LT_DTEMP2 WHERE VBELN <> LS_MAIN-VBELN                       &nbs
*                         AND POSNR <> LS_MAIN-POSNR.         &n
*                                          &n
*      SORT LT_DTEMP2 BY DMBTR.                              
*                                          &n
*      IF LINES( LT_DTEMP2 ) > 1.                           &n
*        " 같은 WRBTR이면 순서 비교해야 해서                          &n
*        DATA(LT_WRBTR2) = LT_MAIN2.                            &
*        DELETE LT_WRBTR2 WHERE VBELN <> LS_MAIN2-VBELN.                     &n
*        DELETE LT_WRBTR2 WHERE WRBTR <> LS_MAIN2-WRBTR.                     &n
*        SORT LT_WRBTR2 BY VBELN POSNR.                          
*        READ TABLE LT_WRBTR2 INTO DATA(LS_WRBTR2) WITH KEY VBELN = LS_MAIN2-VBELN              &nbs
*                                          &n
*        IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0 .                            
*          LV_TABIX = SY-TABIX.                           &n
*                                          &n
*          READ TABLE LT_DTEMP2 INTO DATA(LS_DTEMP2) WITH KEY VBELN = LS_DATA3-VBELN            &nbs
*                                          &n
*                                          &n
*          IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0 AND LS_DTEMP2-GJAHR = LS_MAIN2-FKDAT+(4).                 
*            IF LS_DTEMP2-KWERT = LS_DTEMP2-WRBTR.                     &nbs
*              LS_DATA3-DMBTR = LS_DTEMP2-DMBTR.                     &
*            ENDIF.                             &n
*          ENDIF.                               &n
*        ENDIF.                                 &n
*                                          &n
*      ELSE.                                   &nb
*        READ TABLE LT_DTEMP2 INTO LS_DTEMP2 INDEX 1.                      
*        IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                             
*          LS_DATA3-DMBTR = LS_DTEMP2-DMBTR.                         &
*        ENDIF.                                 &n
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
*    " 통화 확인해서 환율 적용                                &nb
*    SELECT SINGLE WAERS                                 &nb
*      FROM T001                                  
*     WHERE BUKRS = @LS_MAIN2-BUKRS                              
*      INTO @LV_WAERS.                                 
*                                          &n
*    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                                 
*      " 통화 KRW는 값이 없길래 추가                             
*      IF LV_WAERS = LS_MAIN2-WAERK AND LS_DATA3-DMBTR IS INITIAL.                    &nbs
*        LS_DATA3-DMBTR = LS_MAIN2-WRBTR.                           &n
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*                                          &n
*      IF LV_WAERS <> LS_MAIN2-WAERK.                            
*        " 세액(LC) = MWSBP                             &
*        LS_DATA3-MWSBP_LC = LS_MAIN2-MWSBP * LS_MAIN2-KURRF.                      &n
*                                          &n
*        CALL METHOD ZCL_SD_UTIL=>CONV_CURR                          &nb
*          EXPORTING                               
*            I_CURRENCY = LV_WAERS                         &
*            I_AMOUNT   = LS_DATA3-MWSBP_LC                      
*          IMPORTING                               
*            E_AMOUNT   = LS_DATA3-MWSBP_LC.                      
*                                          &n
*      ELSE.                                   &nb
*        " 세액(LC) = MWSBP                             &
*        LS_DATA3-MWSBP_LC = LS_DATA3-MWSBP.                           
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
*    " VBTYP T, K면 금액, 수량 -                             &nbs
*    CASE LS_DATA3-VBTYP.                                  &
*      WHEN GC_O.                                  
**      WHEN GC_T OR GC_K.                              &nbs
*        LS_DATA3-ZFR1      = LS_DATA3-ZFR1 * ( -1 ).                  
*        LS_DATA3-ZIR1      = LS_DATA3-ZIR1 * ( -1 ).                  
*        LS_DATA3-FKIMG     = LS_DATA3-FKIMG * ( -1 ).                  &nb
*        LS_DATA3-WRBTR     = LS_DATA3-WRBTR * ( -1 ).                  &nb
*        LS_DATA3-WAVWR     = LS_DATA3-WAVWR * ( -1 ).                  &nb
*        LS_DATA3-MWSBP     = LS_DATA3-MWSBP * ( -1 ).                  &nb
*        LS_DATA3-DMBTR     = LS_DATA3-DMBTR * ( -1 ).                  &nb
*        LS_DATA3-ZFR1_LC   = LS_DATA3-ZFR1_LC * ( -1 ).                    
*        LS_DATA3-ZIR1_LC   = LS_DATA3-ZIR1_LC * ( -1 ).                    
*        LS_DATA3-WAVWR_LC  = LS_DATA3-WAVWR_LC * ( -1 ).                    &nb
*        LS_DATA3-MWSBP_LC  = LS_DATA3-MWSBP_LC * ( -1 ).                    &nb
*        LS_DATA3-ZCM1      = LS_DATA3-ZCM1 * ( -1 ).                  
*        LS_DATA3-ZCM1_LC   = LS_DATA3-ZCM1_LC * ( -1 ).                    
*        LS_DATA3-ZCD       = LS_DATA3-ZCD * ( -1 ).                 &
*        LS_DATA3-ZCD_LC    = LS_DATA3-ZCD_LC * ( -1 ).                   &
*    ENDCASE.                                     
*                                          &n
*    READ TABLE LT_AUART INTO DATA(LS_AUART) WITH KEY AUART = LS_DATA3-FKART.                   
*    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                                 
*      LS_DATA3-WAVWR2    = LS_DATA3-WRBTR.                          &
*      LS_DATA3-WAVWR_LC2 = LS_DATA3-DMBTR.                            &nbs
*                                          &n
*      CLEAR : LS_DATA3-WRBTR, LS_DATA3-WRBTR_GROSS, LS_DATA3-DMBTR, LS_DATA3-DMBTR_GROSS.                  &n
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
*    " COGS, Cost 값 변경                                &
*    CLEAR : LS_0030.                                  
*    READ TABLE LT_0030 INTO LS_0030 WITH KEY FKART = LS_DATA3-FKART.                    &
*    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                                 
*      LS_DATA3-WAVWR2    = LS_DATA3-WAVWR.                          &
*      CLEAR : LS_DATA3-WAVWR.                               
*                                          &n
*      LS_DATA3-WAVWR_LC2 = LS_DATA3-WAVWR_LC.                            &
*      CLEAR : LS_DATA3-WAVWR_LC.                              &n
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
*    LS_DATA3-WAERS = LV_WAERS.                                &n
*                                          &n
*    " Amount(Gross), Amount in LC(Gross)                             
*    LS_DATA3-WRBTR_GROSS = LS_DATA3-WRBTR + LS_DATA3-ZFR1 + LS_DATA3-ZIR1 + LS_DATA3-ZCD.                 &nb
*    LS_DATA3-DMBTR_GROSS = LS_DATA3-DMBTR + LS_DATA3-ZFR1_LC + LS_DATA3-ZIR1_LC + LS_DATA3-ZCD_LC.                
*                                          &n
*    APPEND LS_DATA3 TO GT_DATA3.                               &
*    CLEAR : LS_DATA3, LS_PARTNER, LV_WAERS, LS_BELNR, LS_BELNR2, LS_PARTNER2, LS_MAIN2,                  
*            LT_DTEMP, LT_DTEMP2, LT_WRBTR, LS_DTEMP, LS_DTEMP2, LT_WRBTR2, LS_WRBTR2.             &
*  ENDLOOP.                                       
*                                          &n
*  SORT GT_DATA3 BY VBELN POSNR.                                &
*  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM GT_DATA3.                              &
*                                          &n
*ENDFORM.                                         
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form KMC_SO                                      &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& -->  p1        text                             &
*& <--  p2        text                             &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM KMC_SO .

  TYPES : BEGIN OF TY_CBO,
            VBELN_VL TYPE LIPS-VBELN,
            POSNR_VL TYPE LIPS-POSNR,
            BSTKD_E  TYPE VBKD-BSTKD_E,
            PVINNO   TYPE I,
          END OF TY_CBO.
  DATA : LT_CBO TYPE TABLE OF TY_CBO,
         LS_CBO TYPE TY_CBO.

  DATA : LS_DATA2 TYPE TY_DATA2,
         LT_ROWS  TYPE LVC_T_ROID.

  RANGES : LR_VTWEG FOR VBAK-VTWEG.

  __CLEAR : LR_VTWEG.

  __RANGE : LR_VTWEG '10' '' 'EQ',
            LR_VTWEG '60' '' 'EQ'.

  CLEAR : LS_DATA2, GT_0400, GV_POPUP.
  MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING CHK WHERE CHK IS NOT INITIAL.

  PERFORM SELECTED_ROWS(ZSDR0000) TABLES LT_ROWS
                                   USING GO_GRID2.

  " 선택한 라인이 없으면 에러
  IF LT_ROWS IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE I004.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  " 선택 라인 체크
  LOOP AT LT_ROWS INTO DATA(LS_ROWS).
    READ TABLE GT_DATA2 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<FS>) INDEX LS_ROWS-ROW_ID.
    IF <FS> IS ASSIGNED.

      <FS>-CHK = ABAP_TRUE.

      UNASSIGN <FS>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

***  " 전체 선택으로 변경                                   &nb
***  LS_DATA2-CHK = ABAP_TRUE.                                  &
***  MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING CHK WHERE CHK IS INITIAL.                     &

  " 유통경로가 같은 건들이 체크되어 있는지
  DATA(LT_VTWEG) = GT_DATA2.
  DELETE LT_VTWEG WHERE CHK IS INITIAL.
  SORT LT_VTWEG BY VTWEG.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_VTWEG COMPARING VTWEG.

  IF LINES( LT_VTWEG ) > 1.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E10.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  " 이미 판매오더 있는지 확인
  DATA(LT_DATA) = GT_DATA2.
  DELETE LT_DATA WHERE CHK IS INITIAL.

  SELECT DISTINCT A~VGBEL, A~VGPOS
    FROM @LT_DATA AS A
    JOIN ZSDT0180 AS B  ON B~WORDER_NO = A~BSTKD_E
   WHERE B~VBELN IS INITIAL
     AND B~POSNR IS INITIAL
    INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_TEMP).

  IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.
    " 비어있는 건 없으면 취소건 있는지 확인
    SELECT DISTINCT A~VBELN, A~POSNR
      FROM ZSDT0180 AS A
      JOIN VBAP AS B  ON B~VBELN = A~VBELN
                     AND B~POSNR = A~POSNR
      JOIN @LT_DATA AS C  ON C~BSTKD_E = A~WORDER_NO
     WHERE A~VBELN IS NOT INITIAL
       AND A~POSNR IS NOT INITIAL
      INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_TEMP2).

    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
      LS_DATA2-MSG = TEXT-E18.

      MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING MSG WHERE CHK  = ABAP_TRUE
                                                       AND ICON = '@08@'.

      MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E01.
      EXIT.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(LT_TEMP3) = LT_DATA.
    DELETE LT_TEMP3 WHERE AUART = 'YCB1'.

    READ TABLE LT_TEMP3 INTO DATA(LS_TEMP3) WITH KEY ICON = '@08@'.
    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
      LS_DATA2-MSG = TEXT-E18.

      MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING MSG WHERE CHK  = ABAP_TRUE
                                                       AND ICON = '@08@'.

      MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E01.
      EXIT.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

***  SELECT DISTINCT B~VBELN                                  &nb
***    FROM VBAP AS A                                 &
***    JOIN VBAK AS B  ON B~VBELN = A~VBELN                         &n
***    JOIN @LT_DATA AS E  ON E~VGBEL = A~VGBEL                        &nbs
***                       AND E~VGPOS = A~VGPOS             
***   WHERE B~AUART = 'YCE1'                                 
***    INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_TEMP).                                
***                                          
***  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                                  &nbs
***    LS_DATA2-MSG = TEXT-E18.                                &n
***
