*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form SET_SELTAB                                      
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      --> GT_CHECK                                 
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM SET_SELTAB_BY_RADIOBTN.
  "--* S_KUNSB *--------------------------------------------------------
  "SQL 대체 후 주석 해제 _DS4K910519
  DATA LRT_PAYER TYPE RANGE OF ZSDT0320-PAYER.

  CASE ABAP_ON.
    WHEN R_07. "HMC
      LRT_PAYER = VALUE #( ( SIGN = 'I' OPTION = 'EQ' LOW = 'H' ) ).
    WHEN R_08. "KMC
      LRT_PAYER = VALUE #( ( SIGN = 'I' OPTION = 'EQ' LOW = 'K' ) ).
    WHEN R_09. "ALL
      LRT_PAYER = VALUE #( ( SIGN = 'I' OPTION = 'EQ' LOW = 'H' )
                           ( SIGN = 'I' OPTION = 'EQ' LOW = 'K' ) ).
    WHEN OTHERS.
      CLEAR LRT_PAYER.
  ENDCASE.

  SELECT FROM ZSDT0320
    FIELDS 'I'   AS SIGN
         , 'EQ'  AS OPTION
         , KUNRG AS LOW
    WHERE PAYER IN @LRT_PAYER
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @S_KUNSB[].
  "--* S_KUNSB *--------------------------------------------------------


  "--* S_LFART *--------------------------------------------------------
  CLEAR : S_LFART, S_LFART[].

  CASE ABAP_ON.
    WHEN    R_02 "Pre-billing Order List
         OR R_06. " Billed Order List
      S_LFART[] = VALUE #( ( SIGN = 'I' OPTION = 'EQ' LOW = 'YCE1' ) ).

    WHEN R_05. " Installation Order List
      S_LFART[] = VALUE #( ( SIGN = 'I' OPTION = 'EQ' LOW = 'YCB1' )
                           ( SIGN = 'I' OPTION = 'EQ' LOW = 'YCB2' ) ).
  ENDCASE.
  "--* S_LFART *--------------------------------------------------------

  "--* S_STSMGI *-------------------------------------------------------
  CLEAR : S_STSMGI, S_STSMGI[].

  CASE ABAP_ON.
    WHEN R_02. "Pre-billing Order List
      S_STSMGI[] = VALUE #( ( SIGN = 'E' OPTION = 'EQ' LOW = 'S' )
                            ( SIGN = 'E' OPTION = 'EQ' LOW = 'Y' ) ).

    WHEN R_06. "Billed Order List
      S_STSMGI[] = VALUE #( ( SIGN = 'I' OPTION = 'EQ' LOW = 'S' )
                            ( SIGN = 'I' OPTION = 'EQ' LOW = 'Y' ) ).
  ENDCASE.
  "--* S_STSMGI *-------------------------------------------------------
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form CHK_XLSX_ITEM_TO_MERGE                                    
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& -->  p1        text                             &
*& <--  p2        text                             &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM CHK_XL_ITEM_TO_MERGE USING    PT_XL_ITEM TYPE G_TT_EXCEL_ITEM
                          CHANGING CT_XL_ITEM TYPE G_TT_EXCEL_ITEM.
  DATA LV_MERGE_TO_ROW TYPE TY_EXCEL_ITEM-MERGE_TO_ROW VALUE '19'.

  CT_XL_ITEM = PT_XL_ITEM.


  DATA LV_GRP_TABIX TYPE SY-TABIX.
  SORT CT_XL_ITEM BY VBELN NATIO.
  LOOP AT CT_XL_ITEM ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<LS_GRP>)
                     GROUP BY ( VBELN = <LS_GRP>-VBELN
                                NATIO = <LS_GRP>-NATIO
                                SIZE  = GROUP SIZE )
                     ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<LS_GRP_KEYS>).
    CLEAR LV_GRP_TABIX.

    LOOP AT GROUP <LS_GRP_KEYS> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<LS_XL_ITEM>).
      LV_MERGE_TO_ROW += 1.
      LV_GRP_TABIX += 1.

      IF LV_GRP_TABIX > 1.
        CLEAR : <LS_XL_ITEM>-VBELN,  <LS_XL_ITEM>-NATIO
              , <LS_XL_ITEM>-FKIMG2, <LS_XL_ITEM>-KZWI12
              , <LS_XL_ITEM>-PRICE.
      ELSE.
        PERFORM REDUCE_VALUE_BY_VBELN_NATIO
          USING    <LS_XL_ITEM>
                   CT_XL_ITEM
          CHANGING <LS_XL_ITEM>-FKIMG2
                   <LS_XL_ITEM>-KZWI12
                   <LS_XL_ITEM>-PRICE.
      ENDIF.

      IF     <LS_GRP_KEYS>-SIZE > 1
         AND LV_GRP_TABIX = 1.
        <LS_XL_ITEM>-MERGE_TO_ROW =   LV_MERGE_TO_ROW
                                    + <LS_GRP_KEYS>-SIZE
                                    - 1. "- 자기자신의 행은 차감.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDLOOP.

  "--* 합계 행 생성 *---------------------------------------------------
  TYPES : BEGIN OF L_TS_SUM
  , VBELN    TYPE TY_EXCEL_ITEM-VBELN
  , KZWI1    TYPE VBAP-KZWI1
  , KZWI12   TYPE VBAP-KZWI1
  , CURRENCY TYPE TY_EXCEL_ITEM-CURRENCY
        , END OF L_TS_SUM.
  DATA : LS_XL_ITEM TYPE TY_EXCEL_ITEM
       , LS_XL_SUM  TYPE L_TS_SUM.

    "--* EUR *----------------------------------------------------------
    LOOP AT CT_XL_ITEM ASSIGNING <LS_XL_ITEM> WHERE CURRENCY = 'EUR'.
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF ',' IN : <LS_XL_ITEM>-KZWI1  WITH ''
                                        , <LS_XL_ITEM>-KZWI12 WITH ''.

      LS_XL_SUM-KZWI1  += CONV VBAP-KZWI1( <LS_XL_ITEM>-KZWI1 ).
      LS_XL_SUM-KZWI12 += CONV VBAP-KZWI1( <LS_XL_ITEM>-KZWI12 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    LS_XL_ITEM = CORRESPONDING #( LS_XL_SUM ).
    LS_XL_ITEM-CURRENCY = 'EUR'.
    LS_XL_ITEM-VBELN = 'SUM'.
    APPEND LS_XL_ITEM TO CT_XL_ITEM.
    "--* EUR *----------------------------------------------------------

    "--* USD *----------------------------------------------------------
    LOOP AT CT_XL_ITEM ASSIGNING <LS_XL_ITEM> WHERE CURRENCY = 'USD'.
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF ',' IN : <LS_XL_ITEM>-KZWI1  WITH ''
                                        , <LS_XL_ITEM>-KZWI12 WITH ''.

      LS_XL_SUM-KZWI1  += CONV VBAP-KZWI1( <LS_XL_ITEM>-KZWI1 ).
      LS_XL_SUM-KZWI12 += CONV VBAP-KZWI1( <LS_XL_ITEM>-KZWI12 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    LS_XL_ITEM = CORRESPONDING #( LS_XL_SUM ).
    LS_XL_ITEM-CURRENCY = 'USD'.
    LS_XL_ITEM-VBELN = 'SUM'.
    APPEND LS_XL_ITEM TO CT_XL_ITEM.
    "--* EUR *----------------------------------------------------------
  "--* 합계 행 생성 *---------------------------------------------------
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form REDUCE_FKIMG2                                     &n
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      <-- <LS_XL_ITEM>_FKIMG2                              
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM REDUCE_VALUE_BY_VBELN_NATIO
  USING    PS_XL_ITEM TYPE TY_EXCEL_ITEM
           PT_XL_ITEM TYPE G_TT_EXCEL_ITEM
  CHANGING CV_FKIMG2  TYPE TY_EXCEL_ITEM-FKIMG2
           CV_KZWI12  TYPE TY_EXCEL_ITEM-KZWI12
           CV_PRICE   TYPE TY_EXCEL_ITEM-PRICE.

  DATA : LV_FKIMG_SUM TYPE VBAP-KWMENG
       , LV_KZWI1_SUM TYPE VBAP-KZWI1
       , LV_PRICE_SUM TYPE VBAP-KZWI1.

  LOOP AT PT_XL_ITEM ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<LS_XL_ITEM>)
                     WHERE     VBELN = PS_XL_ITEM-VBELN
                           AND NATIO = PS_XL_ITEM-NATIO.

    LV_FKIMG_SUM += CONV VBAP-KWMENG( <LS_XL_ITEM>-FKIMG2 ).
    LV_KZWI1_SUM += CONV VBAP-KZWI1( <LS_XL_ITEM>-KZWI12 ).
    LV_PRICE_SUM += CONV VBAP-KZWI1( <LS_XL_ITEM>-PRICE ).
  ENDLOOP.

  WRITE : LV_FKIMG_SUM TO CV_FKIMG2 LEFT-JUSTIFIED
        , LV_KZWI1_SUM TO CV_KZWI12 LEFT-JUSTIFIED
        , LV_PRICE_SUM TO CV_PRICE  LEFT-JUSTIFIED.
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form GET_DATA_WHEN_INSTL_ORD                                   &nbs
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& 신규. _DS4K910519                                      
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM GET_DATA_WHEN_INSTL_ORD .
  TRY.
    "1. 키 데이터 취득
    DATA LT_KEYS TYPE G_TT_KEYS_INSTL_ORD.
    PERFORM GET_KEYS_INSTL_ORD CHANGING LT_KEYS.


    "2-1. 부가 정보 취득 및 가공 (SQL로)
    DATA LT_DATA TYPE G_TT_KEYS_INSTL_ORD.
    PERFORM GET_ADDTIONAL_BY_SQL USING LT_KEYS
                                 CHANGING LT_DATA.

    "2-2. 부가 정보 가공 (루프로)
    PERFORM GET_ADDTIONAL_BY_LOOP CHANGING LT_DATA.


    "3. 라디오버튼에 따라 필드를 매핑해서 이동.
    PERFORM CORRESSPOND_DATA USING LT_DATA
                             CHANGING GT_DATA2.



    IF C_03 = ABAP_OFF. " Display with Full VIN List
      PERFORM COMPRESS_DATA_BY_WORKORDER CHANGING GT_DATA2 " 납품문서*납품품목*워크오더 기준으로 데이터 압축.
                                                  GT_DATA2_B4_COMPRESS
                                                  GT_VIN.
    ELSE.
      PERFORM MODIFY_DATA_BY_VIN CHANGING GT_DATA2.
    ENDIF.


  CATCH CX_ROOT INTO DATA(LO_ROOT).
    GV_ERR = ABAP_TRUE.
    MESSAGE |Error while selecting data. { LO_ROOT->GET_LONGTEXT( ) }|
            TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    EXIT. "- FORM EXIT.
  ENDTRY.


*  IF GT_DATA2 IS INITIAL.                                  
*    GV_ERR = ABAP_TRUE.                                 &nb
*    MESSAGE 'Data not found.' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.                       
*    EXIT. "-- Form Exit.                                &nb
*  ELSE.                                       &nb
*    MESSAGE |{ LINES( GT_DATA2 ) } lines is seleted.| TYPE 'S'.                    &
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form GET_KEYS_INSTL_ORD                                    &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& 신규. _DS4K910519                                      
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM GET_KEYS_INSTL_ORD CHANGING CT_KEYS TYPE G_TT_KEYS_INSTL_ORD.
  WITH +SLSDOC_2 AS ( SELECT FROM VBFA AS A
                             JOIN VBAK AS B ON     B~VBELN = A~VBELN
                         FIELDS A~VBELV AS VBELN_VA1
                              , A~POSNV AS POSNR_VA1
                              , A~VBELN AS VBELN_VA2
                              , A~POSNN AS POSNR_VA2
                         WHERE B~AUART = 'YCE1' )
  , +INSTLED AS ( SELECT FROM VBAP
                    FIELDS VGBEL AS VBELN_VA1
                         , VGPOS AS POSNR_VA1
                         , SUM( KWMENG ) AS QTY_INSTLED
                    GROUP BY VGBEL, VGPOS )
  SELECT FROM VBAP      AS A "페이즈1 판매문서
         JOIN VBAK      AS B ON     B~VBELN = A~VBELN
         JOIN LIPS      AS C ON     C~VGBEL = A~VBELN "페이즈1 출하지시
                                AND C~VGPOS = A~POSNR
         JOIN LIKP      AS D ON     D~VBELN = C~VBELN
    LEFT JOIN VBKD      AS E ON     E~VBELN = A~VBELN
                                AND E~POSNR = A~POSNR
    LEFT JOIN +SLSDOC_2 AS F ON     F~VBELN_VA1 = A~VBELN "페이즈2 판매문서
                                AND F~POSNR_VA1 = A~POSNR
    LEFT JOIN +INSTLED  AS G ON     G~VBELN_VA1 = A~VBELN "페이즈2 판매문서전환수량
                                AND G~POSNR_VA1 = A~POSNR
    FIELDS A~VBELN AS VBELN_VA1, A~POSNR AS POSNR_VA1
         , C~VBELN AS VBELN_VL1, C~POSNR AS POSNR_VL1
         , C~LFIMG AS QTY_SOLD
         , E~BSTKD_E AS WORDER
         , F~VBELN_VA2, F~POSNR_VA2, G~QTY_INSTLED
    WHERE     B~AUART     LIKE 'YCB%'
          AND A~MATNR     IN @S_MATNR[]
          AND A~VBELN     IN @S_VA_1[]
          AND B~ERDAT     IN @S_ERDAT[]
          AND B~SPART     IN @S_SPART[]
          AND B~VKORG     IN @S_VKORG[]
          AND B~VGBEL     IN @S_VBELNG[]
          AND B~VTWEG     IN @S_VTWEG[]
          AND E~BSTKD_E   IN @S_BSTKD[]
          AND D~WADAT_IST IN @S_WADAT[]
          AND D~WBSTK     IN @S_WBSTK[]
          AND D~VBELN     IN @S_VL_1[]
          AND F~VBELN_VA2 IN @S_VA_2[]
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @CT_KEYS.



  "--* 스케줄 라인 스플릿 *---------------------------------------------
  DATA : LT_SPLIT TYPE G_TT_KEYS_INSTL_ORD
       , LV_GRP_TABIX TYPE I.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <LS_SPLIT> TYPE G_TS_KEYS_INSTL_ORD.

  LOOP AT CT_KEYS INTO DATA(LS_GRP)
                  WHERE     NO_PDI IS NOT INITIAL
                  GROUP BY ( VBELN_VA1 = LS_GRP-VBELN_VA1
                             POSNR_VA1 = LS_GRP-POSNR_VA1
                             VBELN_VL1 = LS_GRP-VBELN_VL1
                             POSNR_VL1 = LS_GRP-POSNR_VL1 )
                  INTO DATA(LS_GRP_KEY).
    CLEAR LV_GRP_TABIX.

    LOOP AT GROUP LS_GRP_KEY ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<LS_KEYS>).
      LV_GRP_TABIX += 1.

      "--* 스케줄 라인 분리용 테이블에 새 행을 복사하며 추가 *----------
      IF LV_GRP_TABIX = 1.
        IF <LS_KEYS>-QTY_SOLD <= <LS_KEYS>-QTY_INSTLED.
          CONTINUE. "전환가능수량 전량이 전환된 경우는 통과
        ENDIF.

        UNASSIGN <LS_SPLIT>.

        APPEND INITIAL LINE TO LT_SPLIT ASSIGNING <LS_SPLIT>.
        <LS_SPLIT> = <LS_KEYS>.
        " 별도의 행에서 전환된 결과 정보는 제거
        CLEAR : <LS_SPLIT>-VBELN_VA2, <LS_SPLIT>-POSNR_VA2.
      ENDIF.
      "--* 스케줄 라인 분리용 테이블에 새 행을 복사하며 추가 *----------
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDLOOP.

  " 저장해놓은 별도 행들을 메인데이터에 추가
  IF LT_SPLIT IS NOT INITIAL.
    APPEND LINES OF LT_SPLIT TO CT_KEYS.
    SORT CT_KEYS BY VBELN_VA1 POSNR_VA1 VBELN_VL1 POSNR_VL1.
  ENDIF.
  "--* 스케줄 라인 스플릿 *---------------------------------------------


  WITH +INSTL AS (
    SELECT FROM ZSDT0200 AS A "헤더+아이템 관계임
           JOIN ZSDT0180 AS B  ON     B~NO_PDI  = A~NO_PDI
                                  AND B~NO_LINE = A~NO_LINE
      FIELDS A~VBELN AS VBELN_VA1, A~POSNR AS POSNR_VA1
           , B~VBELN AS VBELN_VA2, B~POSNR AS POSNR_VA2
           , B~NO_PDI, B~NO_LINE, B~NO_LINE_D, B~WORDER_NO
           , B~FULL_VIN_NO, B~VIN_NO
      WHERE A~CANCELLED IS INITIAL )
  SELECT FROM @CT_KEYS AS A
    LEFT JOIN +INSTL   AS B ON     B~VBELN_VA1 = A~VBELN_VA1
                               AND B~POSNR_VA1 = A~POSNR_VA1
                               AND B~WORDER_NO = A~WORDER
                               AND COALESCE( B~VBELN_VA2, @SPACE ) = A~VBELN_VA2
                               AND COALESCE( B~POSNR_VA2, @SPACE ) = A~POSNR_VA2
    LEFT JOIN LIPS     AS C ON     C~VGBEL = A~VBELN_VA2
                               AND C~VGPOS = A~POSNR_VA2
    LEFT JOIN VBRP     AS D ON     D~AUBEL = A~VBELN_VA2
                               AND D~AUPOS = A~POSNR_VA2
                               AND D~VGBEL = C~VBELN
                               AND D~VGPOS = C~POSNR
    LEFT JOIN VBRK     AS E ON     E~VBELN = D~VBELN
    FIELDS A~VBELN_VA1, A~POSNR_VA1
         , A~VBELN_VL1, A~POSNR_VL1, A~QTY_SOLD
         , A~WORDER
         , A~VBELN_VA2, A~POSNR_VA2, A~QTY_INSTLED
         , B~NO_PDI, B~NO_LINE, B~NO_LINE_D
         , C~VBELN AS VBELN_VL2, C~POSNR AS POSNR_VL2
         , D~VBELN AS VBELN_VF, D~POSNR AS POSNR_VF
    WHERE     B~VIN_NO                    IN @S_VIN[]
          AND B~FULL_VIN_NO               IN @S_FULL[]
          AND C~ZZSTATUS_MES_GI           IN @S_STSMGI[]
          AND E~FKDAT                     IN @S_FKDAT[]
          AND COALESCE( E~FKSTO, @SPACE ) IS INITIAL
          AND COALESCE( E~SFAKN, @SPACE ) IS INITIAL
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @CT_KEYS.


  "--* 파트너펑션 결합 및 다른 조건 적용 *------------------------------
  " 상황마다 1페이즈 판매문서, 2페이즈 판매문서, 대금청구문서의 파트너를
  "가지고 와야 해서 키 데이터 취득 쿼리를 분리함.
  "또한 품목의 파트너가 없으면 헤더의 파트너를 가지고 와야 함.
  "공통 WHERE 절 추가해서 가지고 올 파트너펑션 제한하기
  DATA : LT_PARTN  TYPE TABLE OF VBPA
       , LRT_PARVW TYPE RANGE OF VBPA-PARVW. "필요한 파트너펑션
    LRT_PARVW = VALUE #( SIGN = 'I' OPTION = 'EQ' ( LOW = 'AG' )
                                                  ( LOW = 'RG' )
                                                  ( LOW = 'WE' )
                                                  ( LOW = 'Z1' )
                                                  ( LOW = 'SB' ) ).



  CASE ABAP_ON.
    WHEN R_05. "Installation Order List
      SELECT FROM @CT_KEYS AS A
        FIELDS DISTINCT A~*
        WHERE A~QTY_SOLD > A~QTY_INSTLED
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @CT_KEYS.

      SELECT FROM @CT_KEYS AS A " 1페이즈 판매문서
             JOIN VBPA     AS B ON    ( B~VBELN = A~VBELN_VA1 AND B~POSNR IS INITIAL )
                                   OR ( B~VBELN = A~VBELN_VA1 AND B~POSNR = A~POSNR_VA1 )
        FIELDS DISTINCT B~VBELN, B~POSNR, B~PARVW, B~KUNNR
        ORDER BY B~VBELN, B~POSNR, B~PARVW
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @LT_PARTN.

          LOOP AT CT_KEYS ASSIGNING <LS_KEYS>.
            "--* 2페이즈 정보 제거 *------------------------------------
            CLEAR : <LS_KEYS>-VBELN_VA2, <LS_KEYS>-POSNR_VA2
                  , <LS_KEYS>-VBELN_VL2, <LS_KEYS>-POSNR_VL2
                  , <LS_KEYS>-VBELN_VF , <LS_KEYS>-POSNR_VF.
            "--* 2페이즈 정보 제거 *------------------------------------

            PERFORM GET_PARTN TABLES LT_PARTN
                              USING <LS_KEYS>-VBELN_VA1
                                    <LS_KEYS>-POSNR_VA1
            : 'AG' CHANGING <LS_KEYS>-KUNAG
            , 'RG' CHANGING <LS_KEYS>-KUNRG
            , 'WE' CHANGING <LS_KEYS>-KUNWE
            , 'Z1' CHANGING <LS_KEYS>-KUNZ1
            , 'SB' CHANGING <LS_KEYS>-KUNSB.
              IF <LS_KEYS>-KUNSB IS INITIAL. " SB가 없으면 WE를 사용.
                <LS_KEYS>-KUNSB = <LS_KEYS>-KUNWE.
              ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.

    WHEN R_02. "Pre-billing Order List
      DELETE CT_KEYS WHERE VBELN_VA2 IS INITIAL.


      SELECT FROM @CT_KEYS AS A
             JOIN VBPA     AS B ON    ( B~VBELN = A~VBELN_VA2 AND B~POSNR IS INITIAL )
                                   OR ( B~VBELN = A~VBELN_VA2 AND B~POSNR = A~POSNR_VA2 )
        FIELDS DISTINCT B~VBELN, B~POSNR, B~PARVW, B~KUNNR
        ORDER BY B~VBELN, B~POSNR, B~PARVW
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @LT_PARTN.

          LOOP AT CT_KEYS ASSIGNING <LS_KEYS>.
            "대금청구할 대상을 취득하는 거라 대금청구문서로 참조완료되지
            "않았어야 하는데 이전 쿼리에선 부분참조된 경우엔 참조하는
            "대금청구문서를 함께 취득해와서 아이콘을 조절해서 쿼리 수정
            "후에도 지우지 않고 남김.
*            CLEAR : <LS_KEYS>-VBELN_VF , <LS_KEYS>-POSNR_VF. "빌링 제거              &

            PERFORM GET_PARTN TABLES LT_PARTN
                              USING <LS_KEYS>-VBELN_VA2
                                    <LS_KEYS>-POSNR_VA2
            : 'AG' CHANGING <LS_KEYS>-KUNAG
            , 'RG' CHANGING <LS_KEYS>-KUNRG
            , 'WE' CHANGING <LS_KEYS>-KUNWE
            , 'Z1' CHANGING <LS_KEYS>-KUNZ1
            , 'SB' CHANGING <LS_KEYS>-KUNSB.
              IF <LS_KEYS>-KUNSB IS INITIAL. " SB가 없으면 WE를 사용.
                <LS_KEYS>-KUNSB = <LS_KEYS>-KUNWE.
              ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.

    WHEN R_06. "Billed Order List
      DELETE CT_KEYS WHERE VBELN_VF IS INITIAL.

      SELECT FROM @CT_KEYS AS A
             JOIN VBPA     AS B ON    ( B~VBELN = A~VBELN_VF AND B~POSNR IS INITIAL )
                                   OR ( B~VBELN = A~VBELN_VF AND B~POSNR = A~POSNR_VF )
        FIELDS DISTINCT B~VBELN, B~POSNR, B~PARVW, B~KUNNR
        ORDER BY B~VBELN, B~POSNR, B~PARVW
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @LT_PARTN.

          LOOP AT CT_KEYS ASSIGNING <LS_KEYS>.
            PERFORM GET_PARTN TABLES LT_PARTN
                              USING <LS_KEYS>-VBELN_VF
                                    <LS_KEYS>-POSNR_VF
            : 'AG' CHANGING <LS_KEYS>-KUNAG
            , 'RG' CHANGING <LS_KEYS>-KUNRG
            , 'WE' CHANGING <LS_KEYS>-KUNWE
            , 'Z1' CHANGING <LS_KEYS>-KUNZ1
            , 'SB' CHANGING <LS_KEYS>-KUNSB.
              IF <LS_KEYS>-KUNSB IS INITIAL. " SB가 없으면 WE를 사용.
                <LS_KEYS>-KUNSB = <LS_KEYS>-KUNWE.
              ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
  ENDCASE.

  "결합된 파트너펑션을 대상으로 파트너펑션 셀렉트옵션 적용
  SELECT FROM @CT_KEYS AS A
    FIELDS DISTINCT A~*
    WHERE     A~KUNAG IN @S_KUNAG[]
          AND A~KUNSB IN @S_KUNSB[]
          AND A~KUNRG IN @S_KUNRG[]
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @CT_KEYS.
  "--* 파트너펑션 결합 및 다른 조건 적용 *------------------------------
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form GET_PARTN                                      
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& 신규. _DS4K910519                                      
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM GET_PARTN TABLES   PT_PARTN STRUCTURE VBPA
               USING    PV_VBELN PV_POSNR
                        PV_RARVW
               CHANGING CV_KUNNR.
  READ TABLE PT_PARTN INTO DATA(LS_PARTN)
                      WITH KEY VBELN = PV_VBELN
                               POSNR = PV_POSNR
                               PARVW = PV_RARVW
                      BINARY SEARCH.
    IF SY-SUBRC <> 0. "품목까지 일치하는 게 없으면 헤더에서 확인
      READ TABLE PT_PARTN INTO LS_PARTN WITH KEY VBELN = PV_VBELN
                                                 PARVW = PV_RARVW
                          BINARY SEARCH.
    ENDIF.

    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      CV_KUNNR = LS_PARTN-KUNNR.
    ENDIF.
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form GET_ADDTIONAL_BY_SQL                                    &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& 신규. _DS4K910519                                      
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM GET_ADDTIONAL_BY_SQL USING    PT_KEYS TYPE G_TT_KEYS_INSTL_ORD
                          CHANGING CT_DATA TYPE G_TT_KEYS_INSTL_ORD .
*  "PRE-BILLING 대상 부가정보 결합 중.                                &nbs
" 1. 기존 쿼리로 실행해서 GT_DATA2 취득
" 2. 변경한 쿼리로 실행해서 GT_DATA2 취득
" 3. 필드를 순서대로 두 데이터를 비교해서 가지고 옴.
"    - 이때 라디오버튼 3개의 경우를 다 확인해야 함.

  "--* Phase 1 데이터 *-------------------------------------------------
  WITH +KEYS AS ( SELECT * FROM @PT_KEYS AS A )
  , +INSTLED_QTY AS (
    SELECT FROM +KEYS AS A
           JOIN VBAP  AS B ON     B~VGBEL = A~VBELN_VA1
                              AND B~VGPOS = A~POSNR_VA1
      FIELDS A~VBELN_VL1, A~POSNR_VL1
           , SUM( B~KWMENG ) AS QTY_INSTLED
           , SUM( B~KZWI1 )  AS KZWI1_INSTLED
           , SUM( B~MWSBP )  AS MWSBP_INSTLED
      GROUP BY A~VBELN_VL1, A~POSNR_VL1 )
  SELECT FROM +KEYS         AS A
         JOIN LIKP          AS B ON     B~VBELN = A~VBELN_VL1
         JOIN LIPS          AS C ON     C~VBELN = A~VBELN_VL1
                                    AND C~POSNR = A~POSNR_VL1
         JOIN VBAP          AS G ON     G~VBELN = A~VBELN_VA1
                                    AND G~POSNR = A~POSNR_VA1
         JOIN VBAK          AS H ON     H~VBELN = A~VBELN_VA1
    LEFT JOIN VBKD          AS D ON     D~VBELN = A~VBELN_VA1
                                    AND D~POSNR = A~POSNR_VA1
    LEFT JOIN ZSDT0180      AS E ON     E~NO_PDI    = A~NO_PDI
                                    AND E~NO_LINE   = A~NO_LINE
                                    AND E~NO_LINE_D = A~NO_LINE_D
    LEFT JOIN +INSTLED_QTY  AS F ON     F~VBELN_VL1 = A~VBELN_VL1
                                    AND F~POSNR_VL1 = A~POSNR_VL1
    LEFT JOIN PRCD_ELEMENTS AS J ON     J~KNUMV = H~KNUMV
                                    AND J~KPOSN = A~POSNR_VA1
                                    AND J~KAPPL = 'V'
                                    AND J~KSCHL = 'ZIS1'
    LEFT JOIN VBAK          AS I ON     I~VBELN = A~VBELN_VA2
    LEFT JOIN PRCD_ELEMENTS AS K ON     K~KNUMV = I~KNUMV
                                    AND K~KPOSN = A~POSNR_VA2
                                    AND K~KAPPL = 'V'
                                    AND K~KSCHL = 'ZIS1'
    FIELDS A~VBELN_VA1, A~POSNR_VA1, A~VBELN_VL1, A~POSNR_VL1
         , A~WORDER, A~NO_PDI, A~NO_LINE, A~NO_LINE_D
         , A~VBELN_VA2, A~POSNR_VA2, A~VBELN_VL2, A~POSNR_VL2
         , A~VBELN_VF, A~POSNR_VF
         , A~KUNAG, A~KUNRG, A~KUNSB, A~KUNWE, A~KUNZ1
         , B~ERDAT, B~ERNAM, B~ERZET, B~LFART, B~VKORG, B~WADAT_IST, B~WAERK "B: Phase 1 LIKP
         , C~ARKTX, C~LGORT, C~MATNR, C~MVGR1, C~SPART, C~VKBUR, C~VKGRP, C~VRKME, C~VTWEG, C~WERKS "C: Phase 1 LIPS
         , D~BSTKD_E, D~IHREZ_E, D~POSEX_E, D~PRSDT
         , E~FULL_VIN_NO, E~SERIAL_NO, E~VIN_NO
         , G~KZWI1 - COALESCE( F~KZWI1_INSTLED, 0 ) AS NETWR "G: Phase 1 VBAP
         , G~MWSBP - COALESCE( F~MWSBP_INSTLED, 0 ) AS MWSBP
         , C~LFIMG - COALESCE( F~QTY_INSTLED, 0 )  AS LFIMG
         , CASE WHEN COALESCE( J~KWERT, 0 ) IS NOT INITIAL
                     THEN J~KWERT - COALESCE( K~KWERT, 0 )
                ELSE 0 END AS KWERT
         , J~WAERK AS WAERK2
  INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @CT_DATA.
  "--* Phase 1 데이터 *-------------------------------------------------

  "--* Phase 2 데이터 *-------------------------------------------------
  WITH +KEYS AS ( SELECT * FROM @CT_DATA AS A )
  , +VIN_CNT AS (
    SELECT FROM +KEYS    AS A
           JOIN ZSDT0180 AS B ON     B~NO_PDI    = A~NO_PDI
                                 AND B~NO_LINE   = A~NO_LINE
                                 AND B~NO_LINE_D = A~NO_LINE_D
      FIELDS A~VBELN_VA2, A~POSNR_VA2, A~WORDER
           , COUNT( B~VIN_NO ) AS PVINNO_SHIP
           , COUNT( B~FULL_VIN_NO ) AS FVINNO_SHIP
      WHERE A~VBELN_VA2 IS NOT INITIAL
      GROUP BY A~VBELN_VA2, A~POSNR_VA2, A~WORDER )
  SELECT FROM +KEYS    AS A
    LEFT JOIN VBAK     AS C ON     C~VBELN = A~VBELN_VA2
    LEFT JOIN VBAP     AS F ON     F~VBELN = A~VBELN_VA2
                               AND F~POSNR = A~POSNR_VA2
    LEFT JOIN VBKD     AS D ON     D~VBELN = A~VBELN_VA2
                               AND D~POSNR = A~POSNR_VA2
    LEFT JOIN LIKP     AS G ON     G~VBELN = A~VBELN_VL2
    LEFT JOIN VBRK     AS B ON     B~VBELN = A~VBELN_VF
    LEFT JOIN VBRP     AS I ON     I~VBELN = A~VBELN_VF
                               AND I~POSNR = A~POSNR_VF
    LEFT JOIN +VIN_CNT AS E ON     E~VBELN_VA2 = A~VBELN_VA2
                               AND E~POSNR_VA2 = A~POSNR_VA2
    LEFT JOIN ZSDT0340 AS H ON     H~VBELN = A~VBELN_VL2
                               AND H~POSNR = A~POSNR_VL2
    LEFT JOIN ZSDT0170 AS J ON     J~NO_PDI  = A~NO_PDI
                               AND J~NO_LINE = A~NO_LINE
                               AND J~TYPE    = 'I'
                               AND J~IF_TYPE = 'S'
    LEFT JOIN ZSDT0190 AS K ON     K~NO_PDI = A~NO_PDI
    FIELDS A~*
         , CASE WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_ON THEN A~ARKTX "Installation Order List
                ELSE F~ARKTX END AS ARKTX
         , CASE WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_OFF THEN C~AUART END AS AUART "Installation Order List
         , CASE WHEN @R_02 = @ABAP_ON THEN C~AUDAT END AS AUDAT "Pre-billing Order List
         , CASE WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_OFF THEN C~ERDAT END AS ERDAT_SO "Installation Order List
         , CASE WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_ON THEN A~ERNAM "Installation Order List
                ELSE C~ERNAM END AS ERNAM
         , CASE WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_OFF THEN C~ERZET END AS ERZET_SO "Installation Order List
         , CASE WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_OFF THEN B~FKDAT END AS FKDAT "Installation Order List
         , CASE WHEN @R_06 = @ABAP_ON THEN I~FKIMG END AS FKIMG "Billed Order List
         , CASE WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_ON THEN 0 "Installation Order List
                ELSE E~FVINNO_SHIP END AS FVINNO_SHIP
         , CASE WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_ON THEN A~IHREZ_E "Installation Order List
                ELSE D~IHREZ_E END AS IHREZ_E
         , CASE WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_OFF THEN F~KZWI1 END AS KZWI1 "Installation Order List
         , CASE WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_OFF THEN F~KWMENG END AS KWMENG "Installation Order List
         , CASE WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_ON THEN A~LGORT "Installation Order List
                ELSE F~LGORT END AS LGORT
         , CASE WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_ON THEN A~MATNR "Installation Order List
                ELSE F~MATNR END AS MATNR
         , CASE WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_ON THEN A~MVGR1 "Installation Order List
                ELSE F~MVGR1 END AS MVGR1
         , CASE WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_ON THEN A~MWSBP "Installation Order List
                ELSE F~MWSBP END AS MWSBP
         , CASE WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_ON THEN A~POSEX_E "Installation Order List
                ELSE D~POSEX_E END AS POSEX_E
         , CASE WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_ON THEN A~PRSDT "Installation Order List
                ELSE D~PRSDT END AS PRSDT
         , CASE WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_ON THEN 0 "Installation Order List
                ELSE E~PVINNO_SHIP END AS PVINNO_SHIP
         , CASE WHEN @R_02 = @ABAP_ON THEN C~SPART "Pre-billing Order List
                WHEN @R_06 = @ABAP_ON THEN B~SPART "Billed Order List
                ELSE A~SPART END AS SPART
         , CASE WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_OFF THEN C~VDATU END AS VDATU "Installation Order List
         , CASE WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_ON THEN A~VKBUR "Installation Order List
                ELSE C~VKBUR END AS VKBUR
         , CASE WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_ON THEN A~VKGRP "Installation Order List
                ELSE C~VKGRP END AS VKGRP
         , CASE WHEN @R_02 = @ABAP_ON THEN C~VKORG "Pre-billing Order List
                WHEN @R_06 = @ABAP_ON THEN B~VKORG "Billed Order List
                ELSE A~VKORG END AS VKORG
         , CASE WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_ON THEN A~VRKME "Installation Order List
                ELSE F~VRKME END AS VRKME
         , CASE WHEN @R_02 = @ABAP_ON THEN C~VTWEG "Pre-billing Order List
                WHEN @R_06 = @ABAP_ON THEN B~VTWEG "Billed Order List
                ELSE A~VTWEG END AS VTWEG
         , CASE WHEN     @R_05 = @ABAP_OFF "Installation Order List
                     AND COALESCE( K~WADAT_IST, @SPACE ) IS INITIAL
                     THEN J~WADAT_IST
                WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_OFF THEN K~WADAT_IST END AS WADAT_IST2
         , CASE WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_ON THEN A~WAERK "Installation Order List
                ELSE C~WAERK END AS WAERK
         , CASE WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_OFF THEN G~WBSTK END AS WBSTK2 "Installation Order List
         , CASE WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_ON THEN A~WERKS "Installation Order List
                ELSE F~WERKS END AS WERKS
         , CASE WHEN @R_05 = @ABAP_ON THEN H~ZZSTATUS_MES_GI "Installation Order List
                END AS ZZSTATUS_MES_GI
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @CT_DATA.
  "--* Phase 2 데이터 *-------------------------------------------------

  "--* 텍스트 데이터 *--------------------------------------------------
  WITH +ADRC AS ( SELECT FROM KNA1 AS A
                         JOIN ADRC AS B ON     B~ADDRNUMBER = A~ADRNR
                                           AND B~NATION IS INITIAL
                                           AND B~DATE_FROM <= @SY-DATUM
                                           AND B~DATE_TO   >= @SY-DATUM
                    FIELDS A~KUNNR, B~NAME1 )
  SELECT FROM @CT_DATA      AS A
    LEFT JOIN TVLKT         AS T01 ON     T01~LFART = A~LFART
                                      AND T01~SPRAS = @SY-LANGU
    LEFT JOIN USER_ADDR     AS T02 ON     T02~BNAME = A~ERNAM
    LEFT JOIN TVM1T         AS T03 ON     T03~MVGR1 = A~MVGR1
                                      AND T03~SPRAS = @SY-LANGU
    LEFT JOIN +ADRC         AS TAG ON     TAG~KUNNR = A~KUNAG
    LEFT JOIN +ADRC         AS TSB ON     TSB~KUNNR = A~KUNSB
    LEFT JOIN +ADRC         AS TRG ON     TRG~KUNNR = A~KUNRG
    FIELDS A~*
         , T01~VTEXT AS LFART_TXT, T02~NAME_TEXTC
         , T03~BEZEI AS MVGR1_TXT
         , TAG~NAME1 AS KUNAG_NM , TSB~NAME1 AS KUNSB_NM
         , TRG~NAME1 AS KUNRG_NM
  INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @CT_DATA.
  "--* 텍스트 데이터 *--------------------------------------------------
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form CORRESSPOND_DATA                                     
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& 신규. _DS4K910519                                      
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM CORRESSPOND_DATA USING    PT_DATA  TYPE G_TT_KEYS_INSTL_ORD
                      CHANGING CT_DATA2 TYPE G_TT_DATA2.
  CASE ABAP_ON.
    WHEN R_05. "Installation Order List
      CT_DATA2 = CORRESPONDING #( PT_DATA
        MAPPING VBELN_VL = VBELN_VL1
                POSNR_VL = POSNR_VL1
                VGBEL    = VBELN_VA1
                VGPOS    = POSNR_VA1 ).

    WHEN R_02. "Pre-billing Order List
      CT_DATA2 = CORRESPONDING #( PT_DATA
        MAPPING VBELN    = VBELN_VA2
                POSNR    = POSNR_VA2 ).
      "Phase 1 정보는 이전 쿼리 결과에도 없어서 매핑에서 제외.

    WHEN R_06. "Billed Order List
      CT_DATA2 = CORRESPONDING #( PT_DATA
        MAPPING VBELN_VL = VBELN_VL1
                POSNR_VL = POSNR_VL1
                VGBEL    = VBELN_VA1
                VGPOS    = POSNR_VA1
                VBELN    = VBELN_VA2
                POSNR    = POSNR_VA2 ).
  ENDCASE.
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form GET_ADDTIONAL_BY_LOOP                                    
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& 신규. _DS4K910519                                      
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM GET_ADDTIONAL_BY_LOOP CHANGING CT_DATA TYPE G_TT_KEYS_INSTL_ORD.
  LOOP AT CT_DATA ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<LS_DATA>).
    "--* ERDAT *--------------------------------------------------------
    IF R_05 = ABAP_OFF. "Installation Order List
      CLEAR <LS_DATA>-ERDAT.
    ENDIF.
    "--* ERDAT *--------------------------------------------------------

    "--* ERZET *--------------------------------------------------------
    IF R_05 = ABAP_OFF. "Installation Order List
      CLEAR <LS_DATA>-ERZET.
    ENDIF.
    "--* ERZET *--------------------------------------------------------

    "--* ICON *---------------------------------------------------------
    <LS_DATA>-ICON = ICON_YELLOW_LIGHT.

    CASE ABAP_ON.
      WHEN R_05. "Installation Order List
        <LS_DATA>-ICON = ICON_LIGHT_OUT.

      WHEN R_02. "Pre-billing Order List
        IF <LS_DATA>-ZZSTATUS_MES_GI = 'S'.
          <LS_DATA>-ICON = ICON_GREEN_LIGHT.
        ELSEIF <LS_DATA>-VBELN_VF IS INITIAL.
          <LS_DATA>-ICON = ICON_LIGHT_OUT.
        ENDIF.

      WHEN R_06. "Billed Order List
        IF <LS_DATA>-VBELN_VF IS INITIAL.
          <LS_DATA>-ICON = ICON_LIGHT_OUT.
        ELSEIF    <LS_DATA>-ZZSTATUS_MES_GI = 'S'
               OR <LS_DATA>-ZZSTATUS_MES_GI = 'Y'.
          <LS_DATA>-ICON = ICON_GREEN_LIGHT.
        ENDIF.
    ENDCASE.
    "--* ICON *---------------------------------------------------------

    "--* KWERT *--------------------------------------------------------
    IF R_05 = ABAP_OFF. "Installation Order List
      CLEAR <LS_DATA>-KWERT.
    ENDIF.
    "--* KWERT *--------------------------------------------------------

    "--* LFART *--------------------------------------------------------
    IF R_05 = ABAP_OFF. "Installation Order List
      CLEAR : <LS_DATA>-LFART, <LS_DATA>-LFART_TXT.
    ENDIF.
    "--* LFART *--------------------------------------------------------

    "--* LFIMG *--------------------------------------------------------
    IF R_05 = ABAP_OFF. "Installation Order List
      CLEAR <LS_DATA>-LFIMG.
    ENDIF.
    "--* LFIMG *--------------------------------------------------------

    "--* NETWR *--------------------------------------------------------
    IF R_05 = ABAP_OFF. "Installation Order List
      CLEAR <LS_DATA>-NETWR.
    ENDIF.
    "--* NETWR *--------------------------------------------------------

    "--* WADAT_IST *----------------------------------------------------
    IF R_05 = ABAP_OFF. "Installation Order List
      CLEAR <LS_DATA>-WADAT_IST.
    ENDIF.
    "--* WADAT_IST *----------------------------------------------------

    "--* WAERK2 *-------------------------------------------------------
    IF R_05 = ABAP_OFF. "Installation Order List
      CLEAR <LS_DATA>-WAERK2.
    ENDIF.
    "--* WAERK2 *-------------------------------------------------------
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form CHANGE_DETAIL_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM                                  &nbs
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM CHANGE_DETAIL_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM
  USING    PV_XRATE           TYPE KURRF
  CHANGING CT_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM TYPE G_TT_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM.

  "1. 거래통화 기준 총액
  DATA(LV_AMOUNT_SUM_DC) = REDUCE G_TS_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM-AMOUNT_DC(
    INIT HV_AMOUNT_SUM_DC TYPE G_TS_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM-AMOUNT_DC
    FOR HS_ITEM_AMOUNT_DC IN CT_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM
    NEXT HV_AMOUNT_SUM_DC += HS_ITEM_AMOUNT_DC-AMOUNT_DC
  ).

  "2. 거래통화 기준 총세액
  DATA(LV_TAX_SUM_DC) = REDUCE G_TS_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM-TAX_DC(
    INIT HV_TAX_SUM_DC TYPE G_TS_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM-TAX_DC
    FOR HS_ITEM_TAX_DC IN CT_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM
    NEXT HV_TAX_SUM_DC += HS_ITEM_TAX_DC-TAX_DC
  ).

  "3. 거래통화 기준 총액을 현지통화로 환전
  DATA(LV_AMOUNT_SUM_DC_2_LC) = CONV G_TS_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM-AMOUNT_LC(
    LV_AMOUNT_SUM_DC * PV_XRATE
  ).

  "4. 거래통화 기준 총세액을 현지통화로 환전
  DATA(LV_TAX_SUM_DC_2_LC) = CONV G_TS_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM-TAX_LC(
    LV_TAX_SUM_DC * PV_XRATE
  ).

  "5. '3 - 4'의 결과를 과세표준의 환전액으로 결정
  DATA(LV_NET_PRICE_SUM_DC_2_LC) = CONV WRBTR(
    LV_AMOUNT_SUM_DC_2_LC - LV_TAX_SUM_DC_2_LC
  ).

  "6. 품목별 과세표준 환전액의 합계와 '5번'의 결과와 비교 후 차액을
  " 첫 번째 품목에 반영
  DATA(LV_AMOUNT_SUM_LC) = REDUCE G_TS_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM-AMOUNT_LC(
    INIT HV_AMOUNT_SUM_LC TYPE G_TS_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM-AMOUNT_LC
    FOR HS_ITEM_AMOUNT_LC IN CT_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM
    NEXT HV_AMOUNT_SUM_LC += HS_ITEM_AMOUNT_LC-AMOUNT_LC
  ).

  IF LV_AMOUNT_SUM_LC <> LV_AMOUNT_SUM_DC_2_LC.
    CT_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM[ 1 ]-AMOUNT_LC += ROUND( VAL = LV_AMOUNT_SUM_DC_2_LC - LV_AMOUNT_SUM_LC
                                                DEC = 0 ).
  ENDIF.



  "7. 품목별 세액 환전액의 합계와 '4번'의 결과와 비교 후 차액을 첫 번째
  " 품목에 반영
  DATA(LV_TAX_SUM_LC) = REDUCE G_TS_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM-TAX_LC(
    INIT HV_TAX_SUM_LC TYPE G_TS_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM-TAX_LC
    FOR HS_ITEM_TAX_LC IN CT_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM
    NEXT HV_TAX_SUM_LC += HS_ITEM_TAX_LC-TAX_LC
  ).

  IF LV_TAX_SUM_LC <> LV_TAX_SUM_DC_2_LC.
    CT_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM[ 1 ]-TAX_LC += ROUND( VAL = LV_TAX_SUM_DC_2_LC - LV_TAX_SUM_LC
                                             DEC = 0 ).
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form GET_HEADER_INVVIN_2ND                                    
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM GET_HEADER_INVVIN_2ND
  USING    PT_DATA         TYPE G_TT_DATA2
  CHANGING CS_INVVIN_2ND_H TYPE G_TS_INVVIN_2ND_H.

  SELECT SINGLE FROM @PT_DATA AS A
                JOIN VBAK     AS B ON B~VBELN = A~VBELN
           LEFT JOIN VBKD     AS C ON     C~VBELN = B~VBELN
                                      AND C~POSNR IS INITIAL
           "ZSDT0320의 필드명은 'RG'지만 'SB'가 저장되어 있음.
           "초기엔 'RG'가 기준이었는데 이후 'SB'로 수정되었기 때문.
           LEFT JOIN ZSDT0320 AS D ON     D~KUNRG = A~KUNSB
    FIELDS D~PAYER
         , B~AUDAT AS VDATU
         , C~KURSK AS XRATE
         , CASE WHEN B~WAERK = 'EUR' THEN '#'
                WHEN B~WAERK = 'KRW' THEN '#'
                WHEN B~WAERK = 'JPY' THEN '#'
                WHEN B~WAERK = 'USD' THEN '$'
           END AS WAERS_ICON_DC
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @CS_INVVIN_2ND_H.
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form GET_ITEM_INVVIN_2ND                                    &n
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM GET_ITEM_INVVIN_2ND
  USING    PS_INVVIN_2ND_H TYPE G_TS_INVVIN_2ND_H
           PT_DATA         TYPE G_TT_DATA2
  CHANGING CT_INVVIN_2ND_I TYPE G_TT_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM
           CV_DEC          TYPE I.

  SELECT FROM @PT_DATA      AS A
         JOIN VBAK          AS BH  ON BH~VBELN = A~VBELN
         JOIN VBAP          AS BI  ON     BI~VBELN = A~VBELN
                                      AND BI~POSNR = A~POSNR
         JOIN T001          AS C   ON C~BUKRS = BH~BUKRS_VF
         JOIN MARA          AS D   ON D~MATNR = BI~MATNR
    LEFT JOIN VBPA          AS E   ON     E~VBELN = BI~VBELN
                                      AND E~POSNR = BI~POSNR
                                      AND E~PARVW = 'AG'
    LEFT JOIN PRCD_ELEMENTS AS F   ON     F~KNUMV = BH~KNUMV
                                      AND F~KPOSN = BI~POSNR
                                      AND F~KSCHL = 'ZPR2'
    LEFT JOIN PRCD_ELEMENTS AS G   ON     F~KNUMV = BH~KNUMV
                                      AND F~KPOSN = BI~POSNR
                                      AND F~KSCHL = 'MWST'
    LEFT JOIN ZMMT0002      AS T01 ON     T01~ZZCATYPE = D~ZZCATYPE
                                      AND T01~SPRAS    = @SY-LANGU
    LEFT JOIN T005T         AS T02 ON     T02~LAND1 = E~LAND1
                                      AND T02~SPRAS = @SY-LANGU
    FIELDS DISTINCT
           A~VBELN, A~POSNR, A~BSTKD_E AS WORK_ORDER "KEYS
         , CASE WHEN F~WAERK = BH~WAERK THEN F~KWERT
                     ELSE BI~KZWI1
           END       AS AMOUNT_DC
         , BI~ARKTX
         , BI~KWMENG AS QTY
         , T01~NAME
         , T02~LANDX AS NATION_TXT
         , CASE WHEN F~WAERS = BH~WAERK THEN F~KBETR
                     WHEN BI~KWMENG = 0      THEN 0
                     ELSE DIVISION( BI~KZWI1, BI~KWMENG, 2 )
           END       AS NET_PRICE_DC
         , CASE WHEN G~WAERK = BH~WAERK THEN G~KWERT
                     ELSE BI~MWSBP
           END       AS TAX_DC
         , BH~WAERK  AS WAERS_DC
         , C~WAERS   AS WAERS_LC
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @CT_INVVIN_2ND_I.
      IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
        "WORKORDER * MATNR 기준 축약인데 위 쿼리에선 금액들이
        "결정되기 전이라 GROUP BY가 복잡해져 에러가 있을까 봐 따로 실행
        SELECT FROM @CT_INVVIN_2ND_I AS A
          FIELDS WORK_ORDER "KEYS
               , SUM( AMOUNT_DC ) AS AMOUNT_DC
               , ARKTX
               , SUM( QTY ) AS QTY
               , NAME, NATION_TXT, NET_PRICE_DC
               , SUM( TAX_DC ) AS TAX_DC
               , WAERS_DC, WAERS_LC
           GROUP BY WORK_ORDER, ARKTX, NAME, NATION_TXT, NET_PRICE_DC
                  , WAERS_DC, WAERS_LC
           ORDER BY WORK_ORDER
           INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @CT_INVVIN_2ND_I.
      ENDIF.


  FIELD-SYMBOLS <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I> TYPE G_TS_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM.
  DATA : LV_DEC_DC TYPE I
       , LV_DEC_LC TYPE I.

  LOOP AT CT_INVVIN_2ND_I ASSIGNING <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>.
    "--* 환율을 곱해 로컬 금액 계산 후 이동해야 하는 소수점 계산 *------
    "인터널 값으로 전환하기 위해
    "DC, LC 모두 한 종류씩만 사용이 전제이므로 1번만 실행
    IF SY-TABIX = 1.
      SELECT SINGLE CURRDEC FROM TCURX
        WHERE CURRKEY = @<LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-WAERS_DC
        INTO @LV_DEC_DC.
          IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
            LV_DEC_DC = 2.
          ENDIF.

      SELECT SINGLE CURRDEC FROM TCURX
        WHERE CURRKEY = @<LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-WAERS_LC
        INTO @LV_DEC_LC.
          IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
            LV_DEC_LC = 2.
          ENDIF.

      CV_DEC = LV_DEC_DC - LV_DEC_LC.
    ENDIF.
    "--* 환율을 곱해 로컬 금액 계산 후 이동해야 하는 소수점 계산 *------

    "--* AMOUNT_LC *----------------------------------------------------
    <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-AMOUNT_LC = <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-AMOUNT_DC
                                * PS_INVVIN_2ND_H-XRATE
                                / ( 10 ** CV_DEC ).
    "--* AMOUNT_LC *----------------------------------------------------

    "--* TAX_LC *-------------------------------------------------------
    <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-TAX_LC = <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-TAX_DC
                             * PS_INVVIN_2ND_H-XRATE
                             / ( 10 ** CV_DEC ).
    "--* TAX_LC *-------------------------------------------------------

    <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-WAERS_ICON_DC = PS_INVVIN_2ND_H-WAERS_ICON_DC.

    CASE <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-WAERS_LC.
      WHEN 'EUR'.
        <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-WAERS_ICON_LC = '#'.
      WHEN 'KRW'.
        <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-WAERS_ICON_LC = '#'.
      WHEN 'JPY'.
        <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-WAERS_ICON_LC = '#'.
      WHEN 'USD'.
        <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-WAERS_ICON_LC = '$'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form CHANGE_ITEM_INVVIN_2ND                                    
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM CHANGE_ITEM_INVVIN_2ND
  USING    PV_XRATE        TYPE G_TS_INVVIN_2ND_H-XRATE
           PV_DEC          TYPE I
  CHANGING CT_INVVIN_2ND_I TYPE G_TT_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM.

  DATA : LV_SUM_BY_TOTAL TYPE G_TS_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM-AMOUNT_LC
       , LV_SUM_BY_ROW   TYPE G_TS_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM-TAX_LC.

  SELECT FROM @CT_INVVIN_2ND_I AS A
    FIELDS SUM( AMOUNT_DC + TAX_DC )
         , SUM( AMOUNT_LC + TAX_LC )
    INTO (@LV_SUM_BY_TOTAL, @LV_SUM_BY_ROW).

  "전표액의 환전액 계산
  LV_SUM_BY_TOTAL = LV_SUM_BY_TOTAL * PV_XRATE / ( 10 ** PV_DEC ).

  "전표액의 환전액과 행별로 환전해서 합한 금액이 다르면 차액은
  "1번째 과세표준 환전액에 반영
  IF LV_SUM_BY_TOTAL <> LV_SUM_BY_ROW.
    CT_INVVIN_2ND_I[ 1 ]-AMOUNT_LC += LV_SUM_BY_TOTAL - LV_SUM_BY_ROW.
  ENDIF.


  "--*  *--
*                                          &n
*                                          &n
*                                          &n
*                                          &n
*                                          &n
*                                          &n
*  "거래통화로 표시된 합계 환전액과 행마다 환전한 금액 합산                             &
*  DATA : LV_AMT_BY_TOTAL TYPE G_TS_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM-AMOUNT_LC                           &n
*       , LV_AMT_BY_ROW   TYPE G_TS_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM-AMOUNT_LC                      &n
*       , LV_TAX_BY_TOTAL TYPE G_TS_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM-TAX_LC                        &nb
*       , LV_TAX_BY_ROW   TYPE G_TS_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM-TAX_LC.                      &nbs
*                                          &n
*  SELECT FROM @CT_INVVIN_2ND_I AS A                               &nb
*    FIELDS SUM( AMOUNT_DC )                                
*         , SUM( TAX_DC )                            &n
*         , SUM( AMOUNT_LC )                            
*         , SUM( TAX_LC )                            &n
*    INTO (@LV_AMT_BY_TOTAL, @LV_TAX_BY_TOTAL                              
*        , @LV_AMT_BY_ROW,   @LV_TAX_BY_ROW).                         
*                                          &n
*  LV_AMT_BY_TOTAL = LV_AMT_BY_TOTAL * PV_XRATE / ( 10 ** PV_DEC ).                     &n
*  LV_TAX_BY_TOTAL = LV_TAX_BY_TOTAL * PV_XRATE / ( 10 ** PV_DEC ).                     &n
*                                          &n
*                                          &n
*  "거래통화 합계 환전액과 행마다 환전해 합한 금액이 다르면 차액은                           &nbs
*  "1번째 행에 반영                                     
*  IF LV_AMT_BY_TOTAL <> LV_AMT_BY_ROW.                               
*    CT_INVVIN_2ND_I[ 1 ]-AMOUNT_LC += LV_AMT_BY_TOTAL - LV_AMT_BY_ROW.                      &n
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
*                                          &n
*  IF LV_TAX_BY_TOTAL <> LV_TAX_BY_ROW.                               
*    CT_INVVIN_2ND_I[ 1 ]-TAX_LC += LV_TAX_BY_TOTAL - LV_TAX_BY_ROW.                       
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form EXPORT_HEADER_INVVIN_2ND                                   &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM EXPORT_HEADER_INVVIN_2ND
  USING PS_INVVIN_2ND_H TYPE G_TS_INVVIN_2ND_H.

  DATA(LV_TEXT) = |{ TEXT-M16 } { PS_INVVIN_2ND_H-WAERS_ICON_DC } 1 =|.

  PERFORM PRO_FILL_CELL_DATA USING
  : 5   14   0   PS_INVVIN_2ND_H-VDATU
  , 6   13   0   LV_TEXT
  , 6   15   0   PS_INVVIN_2ND_H-XRATE.
ENDFORM. "EXPORT_HEADER_INVVIN_2ND
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form DELETE_CELL_INVVIN_2ND                                    
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM DELETE_CELL_INVVIN_2ND .
  DATA : LS_ROW TYPE OLE2_OBJECT
       , LS_COL TYPE OLE2_OBJECT.

  "총액 행 제거
  CALL METHOD OF G_EXCEL 'Rows' = LS_ROW EXPORTING #1 = 11.
  CALL METHOD OF LS_ROW 'Select'.
  CALL METHOD OF LS_ROW 'Delete'.

  "헤더 정보를 왼편으로 이동
  CALL METHOD OF G_SHEET 'Range' = RANGE
    EXPORTING #1 = 'L1:O6'.
  CALL METHOD OF RANGE 'Select'.
  CALL METHOD OF RANGE 'Cut'.

  CALL METHOD OF G_SHEET 'Range' = RANGE
    EXPORTING #1 = 'H1'.
  CALL METHOD OF RANGE 'Select'.
  CALL METHOD OF G_SHEET 'Paste'.

  "세액 열 삭제
  CALL METHOD OF G_EXCEL 'Columns' = LS_COL
    EXPORTING #1 = 'L:O'.
  CALL METHOD OF LS_COL 'Delete'.
ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form EXPORT_ITEM_INVVIN_2ND                                    
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM EXPORT_ITEM_INVVIN_2ND
  USING PV_PAYER        TYPE G_TS_INVVIN_2ND_H-PAYER
        PRT_NO_DISP_TAX TYPE G_RT_PAYER_NO_DISP_TAX
        PT_INVVIN_2ND_I TYPE G_TT_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM.
  DATA LS_ROW TYPE OLE2_OBJECT.

  "--* 행 추가 *--------------------------------------------------------
  DATA(LV_LINE) = LINES( PT_INVVIN_2ND_I ).

  IF LV_LINE > 2.
    "시작라인 + 품목 수 - ( 기본라인수 + 기본선택 1행 )
    DATA(LV_ROW_END) = 9 + LV_LINE - ( 2 + 1 ).

    DATA(LV_ROWS_PARAM) = |9:{ LV_ROW_END }|.

    CALL METHOD OF G_EXCEL 'Rows' = LS_ROW EXPORTING #1 = LV_ROWS_PARAM.
    CALL METHOD OF LS_ROW 'Select'.  "- Row선택.
    CALL METHOD OF LS_ROW 'Insert'.  "- Row추가.
  ENDIF.
  "--* 행 추가 *--------------------------------------------------------


  "--* 내보낼 데이터 구축 *---------------------------------------------
  DATA : LT_OLE_I TYPE  TABLE OF CHAR200
       , LV_CAR(60)
       , LV_TAB   VALUE CL_ABAP_CHAR_UTILITIES=>HORIZONTAL_TAB
       , LV_PRICE TYPE DDDDLCURRTYPES-CURR31_14.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS : <LS_OLE_I>        LIKE LINE OF LT_OLE_I
                , <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I> TYPE         G_TS_INVVIN_2ND_ITEM.


  LOOP AT PT_INVVIN_2ND_I ASSIGNING <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO LT_OLE_I ASSIGNING <LS_OLE_I>.

    "--* column B *-----------------------------------------------------
    <LS_OLE_I> = <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-NATION_TXT.
    "--* column B *-----------------------------------------------------

    "--* column C *-----------------------------------------------------
    LV_CAR = <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-NAME && | | && <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-ARKTX.

    <LS_OLE_I> = <LS_OLE_I> && LV_TAB && LV_CAR.
    "--* column C *-----------------------------------------------------

    "--* column D *-----------------------------------------------------
    <LS_OLE_I> = <LS_OLE_I> && LV_TAB && <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-WORK_ORDER.
    "--* column D *-----------------------------------------------------

    "--* column E *-----------------------------------------------------
    <LS_OLE_I> = <LS_OLE_I> && LV_TAB && <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-QTY.
    "--* column E *-----------------------------------------------------

    "--* column F *-----------------------------------------------------
    <LS_OLE_I> =    <LS_OLE_I> && LV_TAB
                 && <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-WAERS_ICON_DC.
    "--* column F *-----------------------------------------------------

    "--* column G *-----------------------------------------------------
    CLEAR LV_PRICE.

    ZCL_SD_UTIL=>CONV_CURR(
      EXPORTING I_IN       = ' '
                I_CURRENCY = <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-WAERS_DC
                I_AMOUNT   = <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-NET_PRICE_DC
      IMPORTING E_AMOUNT   = LV_PRICE ).

    <LS_OLE_I> = <LS_OLE_I> && LV_TAB && LV_PRICE.
    "--* column G *-----------------------------------------------------

    "--* column H *-----------------------------------------------------
    <LS_OLE_I> =    <LS_OLE_I> && LV_TAB
                 && <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-WAERS_ICON_DC.
    "--* column H *-----------------------------------------------------

    "--* column I *-----------------------------------------------------
    CLEAR LV_PRICE.

    ZCL_SD_UTIL=>CONV_CURR(
      EXPORTING I_IN       = ' '
                I_CURRENCY = <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-WAERS_DC
                I_AMOUNT   = <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-AMOUNT_DC
      IMPORTING E_AMOUNT   = LV_PRICE ).

    <LS_OLE_I> = <LS_OLE_I> && LV_TAB && LV_PRICE.
    "--* column I *-----------------------------------------------------

    "--* column J *-----------------------------------------------------
    <LS_OLE_I> =    <LS_OLE_I> && LV_TAB
                 && <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-WAERS_ICON_LC.
    "--* column J *-----------------------------------------------------

    "--* column K *-----------------------------------------------------
    CLEAR LV_PRICE.

    ZCL_SD_UTIL=>CONV_CURR(
      EXPORTING I_IN       = ' '
                I_CURRENCY = <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-WAERS_LC
                I_AMOUNT   = <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-AMOUNT_LC
      IMPORTING E_AMOUNT   = LV_PRICE ).

    <LS_OLE_I> = <LS_OLE_I> && LV_TAB && LV_PRICE.
    "--* column K *-----------------------------------------------------

    IF PV_PAYER NOT IN PRT_NO_DISP_TAX.
      "--* column L *---------------------------------------------------
      <LS_OLE_I> =    <LS_OLE_I> && LV_TAB
                   && <LS_INVVIN_2ND_I>-WAERS_ICON_DC.
